chapters.title: Chapter 2980 Imperium Knights Dispatched! I
paragraphs: As the Existential Omniversal Emperor began to produce Fruits of Existence within his own Dominium, weavings of his actions were spreading outwards- their effects beginning to unfold at this moment.
Across the endless expanse of the Omniverse.

At speeds unfathomably faster than light, in a manner that couldn't be fully captured due to the Existential light covering it...a massive circular vessel crossed the Omniverse towards one of the many, many renowned domains of the Imperium.

Within this vessel, a space the size of a plane of existence was contained within as at the very center of this space, there was an area surrounded by an expanse of a golden sea that currently had a single being and his attendants lined up to his left and right.

Around him, a dense number of illusory screens filtered out weavings of information, his glorious visage and golden hair simmering with a serious expression at this moment as he suffered a loss that he had to report!
|Master, we have received permission to warp in.|
To his right, an attendant at the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm bowed slightly while sending the news.
The golden haired observer nodded as he twisted his hand, a command being activated as the whole vessel disappeared right away.
By the time it reappeared, the blank darkness around everything had begun to be lit up as waves of blue and red auroras began weaving here and there.
It was the glory of an extremely potent Existential Domain under the banner of the Imperium.
As they came closer, the bright red and blue auroras only became more brilliant as far ahead of them, an unfathomable concentration of power and might was gathered.
The golden haired observer sighed with both relief and grimness after returning here, the voice of his vessel echoing out as it began to slow down and come to a stop.
{We have arrived at Cappadocia.}
Cappadocia!
A bustling Existential Domain of the Imperium that held one of the three Existential Lineages of the Imperium!
The vessel of the Observer came to a stop in an empty area as not too far from him, other uniquely shaped vessels were also anchored.

The surroundings were entirely filled with auroras of red and blue light that seemed to stretch out endlessly, with the area ahead of them shining with the most blinding light as this was their destination!
The Observer warped outside of his vessel with his attendants, their figures disappearing soon after as they became wrapped in an existential light.
They were guided by a specified weaving, their bodies transported across the vastness of this Domain as they were directly taken into the foldings of a plane of existence.

At the center of such a plane of existence, an advanced fantastical citadel floated grandly, its exterior pulsing with existential authority as initially, the golden haired observer and his attendants arrived within the walls of this citadel that were bustling with tens of thousands of entities.
But a moment after his arrival, his figure alone became wrapped by a light and disappeared, his attendants being left behind as he was taken towards a central castle atop this floating citadel!

When the golden haired observer appeared again, he found himself standing in a blue hall lined with Planalith Krystallos as decorations, his gaze directed towards the end of the hall that held a red throne behind a crystalline table filled with golden pages.

On the throne, an old man took off his glasses while raising his brows towards the golden haired observer, becking with his hands as a shocking attractive force pulled the Observer forward to stand directly before him!

|I perused through the weavings you've already sent over. An entire Existential Domain perished, and the culprit is a Seed controlled by Omniversal Pillagers...does that make fucking sense to you, Xavier?|
HUUM!
A terrifying pressure descended as a blazing transparent golden light of an utterly heavy Dominium seemed to be emanating from the old man.
It only pressed down lightly on the transparent purple light of the Dominium of the Observer called Xavier, but this Royal kneeled down with a somber expression as he couldn't say anything!
|Hmph, and now you request for the mobilization of the Cappadocia Imperium Knights to track down this...Noah Osmont?|
|Yes, Imperium Martial King. I believe this will be suitable to confirm exactly who is behind this Seed...|
Observer Xavier replied with his head bowed down as the entity he referred to as the Imperium Martial King sneered while shaking his head.
Observers, Knights, Martial Kings!
These were their rankings within the Imperium as Observers traversed to different areas of the Omniverse and were tasked with overseeing the workings of the countless Existential Domains out there.
Knights enforced the rules of the Imperium as it was the highest honor of an Imperium Royal to be chosen as a Knight!

And Martial Kings...one like this entity before Observer Xavier controlled important locations of the Imperium, with Cappadocia Enclave only being one of them as this Entity could actually command and direct Legions of Knights.

This seemingly harmless old man was an amalgamation of terrifying power that Xavier had to bow down to, waiting for the final command as this Entity's voice came out calmly while he stamped a golden page on the crystalline desk.

|The excuse of Omniversal Pillagers behind a Seed is useless. Next time, at least place a suitable blame on something as critical as the disappearance of an entire Existential Domain- this is something the Imperium demands an answer to as due to this...The Red Legion of the Cappadocia Imperium Knights will be mobilized, you're lucky they're stationed here for their vacation.|
Observer Xavier's body trembled at such words!
The Red Legion of the Cappadocia Imperium Knights!
Wasn't this the Legion in charge of overseeing the protection of certain dangerous regions where Omniversal Pillagers frequented?!
|Seeing your expression, you must think it's the genuine Red Legion...no, it is just their Trainee Candidates. But even that will be overkill for something like this.|
The Imperium Martial King snapped his fingers as he saw the shaking figure of the Observer as in the next moment, the hall buzzed and became filled with the auras of 12 powerful entities!
Knights of the Imperium.
Their bodies blazed with Dominiums of purple brilliance as each one could be the head of a Legacy.
And yet they gained much more in their position as Cappadocia Imperium Knights- an entire Enclave standing behind them!
At their forefront was a dazzling armored man and a woman who nodded with respect towards the Imperium Martial King, his command booming out as soon as they arrived.
|Hunt down and capture this supposed Seed- Noah Osmont. His location is approximately...|
HUUM!

A horrific halcyon light of a shocking Soul Dominium rose and flashed 9 times, the eyes of the Imperium Martial King becoming glazed pure gold as he sent streams of lights towards the two leading Knights of the Trainee Candidates of the Red Legion of Cappadocia Imperium Knights.
|Scour that whole area and see what you can find.|
The Imperium Knights nodded with serious expressions as the Imperium Martial King turned his head towards the Observer, his eyes squinting as he spoke.
|You will go with them but first, send for the Archons of the Legacies that let a fucking Seed play them for chumps.|
Another command was given.
But on this day, a small portion of the forces of the Imperium were pointed towards a certain direction.
Towards an Entity that had yet to become well known within the Imperium!

chapters.title: Chapter 2981 Imperium Knights Dispatched! II
paragraphs: 2981 Imperium Knights Dispatched! II
Outside of the complex and vast Existential Domain that was known as Cappadocia.
Auroras of red and blue light stretched endlessly all around as a vessel set off from this place with purpose.
This particular vessel was unique as it seemed like a long cerulean ruler- small in its nature as atop it, the renowned figures that held distinctions as Knights of the Imperium could be seen!
Among these Knights.

Akalusia raised her armored hands to observe the tome like object in her hand that radiated a crimson light, this being none other than a Codex of Extremity as she seemed to be in constant communication with it.
Thereafter, she raised her head behind her to observe the other Knight Commander leading this excursion with her- Knight Palmino.
Exceeding the Neonate Stage and the Sequor Stage, he was like her...standing in the Teleios Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm.
Going from shining with a transcendental white light, to a blazing verdant light, and ultimately the Teleios Stage where their Dominiums emanated a profound purple light.
A stage where their Dominium gained a sense of existential identity that made them move past the identities of nobodies in this vast Omniverse!

Knight Akalusia gazed at all the Imperium Knights at Teleios Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm behind her as she put away the Codex of Extremity in her hands and locked onto the only one who wasn't adorned in their regal crimson Existential Knight Armament.
|Observer Xavier.|
WAA!

Her intent was calm, and yet it held eons of ferociousness and power as the body of the Observer subtly trembled before he moved across the flat open vessel crossing the Omniverse to appear before Knight Akalusia.
|Tell me about this target. Tell me about Noah Osmont.|
Her eyes contained immeasurable might.

Beside her, the second Knight Commander Palmino also gazed over with a cold look as each of the Imperium Knights here were Trainees being bred to join other Knight Legions to enforce the rule of the Imperium across the Omniverse.
Something like a Seed was far beneath them, but they even took this seriously as their vessel pulsed with brilliance before disappearing towards a certain direction!
And in this same direction they were heading towards, coming from another angle...there was another party much smaller than theirs that held a similar purpose.
Moving within the folds of non-existence, the massive body of a draconian entity mounted by an excessively gorgeous Sanctus Princess could be seen moving slowly.
On her forehead, the scripture [S] glowed in a gorgeous verdant light as her green hair pulsed with glory, her intent serene as it rang out.

|The Weavings covering up whatever we're following are uniquely hard to track as I can only confirm this general direction, and it'll be hard work of moving our Dominiums constantly to search for what may be hidden...|
Her intent showed a hint of frustration due to this process taking so long as the Draconic Knight below her asked.
|Shall I call for more Knights on your behalf, Sanctus Princess?|
|No...let's keep things on the quiet side as we were directed. If it's anything major that we can't handle, we will just report and make an exit.|
Her weaving was powerful and unquestionable as the Draconic Knight below her nodded, their search continuing.
And thus, the weavings of a slowly unfolding stage were set as entities with their own desires converged around the general location of one man!
A man who was currently exploring the limits of his Dominium as his will appeared within a magisterial forge filled with dazzling auroras of Loot.

It was his Infinite Existential Forge where the first Fruit of Existence was formed, its surroundings filled with swirling waves of Infinity symbols as towards its center, the dazzling figure of Ruination could be seen.
Noah grabbed the newly formed Quintessential Fruit of Existence in his hands and took a bite as he appeared before the hibernating figure of Ruination.
In her surroundings, silver white Existential Armaments lay half melted as among them, the guns that Basileus Moraine utilized could be seen.

Currently, a transparent white light unique to a Dominium was forming around Ruination as her crimson gold hair now held traces of white- her whole figure surrounded by blazing flames of Existential light!
Noah really looked at her as waves of information arose.

[Budding Primordium Existential Omniversal Armament- Ruination]:: A unique Entity with endless possibilities as currently, she is undergoing a transformation to be the first Primordium Omniversal Armament. Already, her capabilities have become innumerable in their uses as she has become a type of Armament that can take many forms. Possible forms include Sword, Spear, Shield, Vessel, Gun, Flail, Cannon...
The weavings were enough to make Noah look forward to a great future as he looked over everything before nodding and disappearing with a flash of brilliance!

Outside, his Main Body also moved away from the dazzling throne of light and Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed that was producing Fruits of Existence constantly, taking a step to instantly appear within his Existential Omniversal Blacksmith's Forge.

A forge that others would despair at if they entered as an Existential light flowed all around it, with forges and anvils radiating a heavy light of power buzzing throughout as currently...this Existential light was flustered in one area.
An area that showed the fearsome outlines of utterly majestic Automatons that shone with golden blue grandeur.

Noah appeared in front of a line up of these automatons that were the size of Worlds at their smallest, the potent authority of Manadynamics raging and flooding into them from the surroundings as they seemed like efficient killing machines!

Humanoid in form, they looked like massively advanced robotics with the most muscular visage one could have, two pairs of cerulean wings stretching behind them as a pair of eyes holding nine pupils pulsed on their heads!
No nose or mouth could be seen as these were the Existential Automatons that the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed had been building this whole time.
Each one of them emanated terrifying waves of power at the Ninth Gradation of Extremity that almost seemed to be spilling out, seeming even more terrifying than Dikastes of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2982 Buying and Selling! I
paragraphs: 2982 Buying and Selling! I
A light more terrifying than the Dikastes of Extremity.
But even this was oppressed by silent auras of power opposite to the dozens of Existential Automatons Noah was staring at.

This was because behind Noah, there was an invisible army of Existential Illusory Weavings that was kneeling towards Noah and awaiting his commands, many of them being those at the Primordium Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm!

The Automatons were wondrous constructs, but they weren't useful to Noah in terms of Battle as when it came to this, the Existential Illusory Weavings of the enemies he had killed came to the forefront.
But the Existential Automatons...held their own terrifying uses that he planned for as he would begin stretching his fingers across the Omniverse with them.

They were built for such a purpose at this moment as magisterial Existential Omniversal Extremity Passages pointed down and gushed out authority endlessly that flowed towards these Automatons and the Existential Illusory Weavings, their bodies only radiating ever increasing grandeur!
|Step forward.|
HUUM!

His voice boomed out towards a single Automaton as it was met with one of these massive constructs coming forward and kneeling respectfully, the blue wings on its back also bent as it showed it would only ever listen to the commands of a single Master!

And yet...Noah planned to sell these Existential Automatons just like the Dikastes of Extremity were being sold to others on the Existential Imperium Exchange, and his purpose was not Fruits of Existence alone.
He stared at the Existential Automaton ahead of him as its weavings bloomed before his eyes.

[Existential Automaton]:: A construct slightly exceeding the Peak of the Gradations of Extremity. Forged under the banner of many Existential Extremity Authorities, its source was finalized by the weavings of Manadynamics that allowed all the authorities that forged it to be changeable and considered blank existential authorities that can meld with any others...

|Mmm...| Noah nodded while gazing at the details of the Automaton, with Manadynamics coming in as the last piece to make it so that when Noah sold these to others, they could be listed as if they were Unbound from any Existential Extremity Authority and could seamlessly be integrated into any Existential Domains!

This meant that if he were successful, he could have his forged Automatons swirling with his Existential Extremity Authorities...be taken into the homes of powerful Entities from the Imperium without him ever having to lift a finger.
And to complete these entities right now...
|Let Pathogenicity flow to their very core.|
His command boomed out as from his Dominiums, a devilish light erupted out.
It was not yet Existential, and yet...
[The Extremity of Cheats supports the Extremity of Pathogenicity.]
[The Extremity of Loot supports the Extremity of Pathogenicity.]
[The Extremity of Quintessence supports the Extremity of Pathogenicity...]

Apart from Cheats, Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities all propped up the weavings of Pathogenicity as a devilish light bloomed and began to permeate into the Existential Automatons ahead of him!
At the same time that Noah was doing this, part of his was already delved into the Existential Imperium Exchange accessed through the Entry Neonate License.

He had perused fully through the memories of Basileus Moraine who routinely utilized the Entry Neonate License, so he knew exactly what he needed to do as his will appeared in the area termed [My Marketplace]< arriving at an area of immense blank whiteness that seemed like a canvas one could fill up.
In this space, Noah's voice echoed out.
|Add a product.|
The surroundings buzzed as if they sought to establish a connection.
The Entry Neonate License within Noah pulsed as the tight grasp of the Codex of Extremity controlled by Noah and the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed became ever tighter around it!

This was to ensure that Noah would be seen as nothing else other than a member of the Imperium, with the security around the Existential Imperium Exchange being extremely tight as in the unique space he was in, Noah felt a penetrative light flash.
And the result after this penetrative light flashed was a glorious one.
|A new Existential Signature has been detected wishing to list Products within the Exchange.|
|Please state the name you wish to be distinguished with and the distinction of the Enclave connected to the Products to be listed.|
The voice was feminine in nature and entirely robotic, Noah's eyes flashing brilliantly as his own intent weaved out.
|The Weaver of Existence of the Infernal Enclave.|
The Weaver of Existence!
The Infernal Enclave!

His intent listing these spread out as a moment later, a white light flashed as in the center of this blank space, a magic circle began to be etched in real time as it radiated a profound Existential Extremity Authority.
When Noah's eyes gazed at it, Vermillion flames flickered as its identity showed itself.
[The Existential Authority of Spatium.]
He caught mere wisps of its weavings.

He didn't delve any deeper lest his probings be discovered, but this authority was a powerful and heavy one as it dealt with the very existence of space, capable of transporting products vast distances within the Omniverse from one point to another!
|Please place the product or products to be listed in the designated space, and they will undergo preliminary review.|

Before the intent even finished, Noah waved his hands to summon one of his Existential Automatons- miniaturized in nature and still just as terrifying as at this moment, the Existential Extremity Authority flowing across it...was blank.
As if it didn't have a signature.
As if it were unbound.
These...were the means of Manadynamics that stated the very essence of authority could be changed from one form to another!
HUUM!
A dazzling light flashed as soon as the Automaton was placed on the circle radiating Existential light.
And...

|Preliminary Review has discovered an Existential Construct of extremely high quality and unbound by any Existential Extremity Authority. No further review is required as the product can directly be listed on the exchange. Please design a description of your product and set the price before submitting it to be displayed, and thank you for utilizing the Exchange of the Imperium.|
A wondrous reality unfolded.
Noah's smile was innocent and bright at this moment as his intent weaved forward akin to a silent beast lying in waiting...

sentences.text: 2982 Buying and Selling!
I
A light more terrifying than the Dikastes of Extremity.
But even this was oppressed by silent auras of power opposite to the dozens of Existential Automatons Noah was staring at.

This was because behind Noah, there was an invisible army of Existential Illusory Weavings that was kneeling towards Noah and awaiting his commands, many of them being those at the Primordium Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm!

The Automatons were wondrous constructs, but they weren't useful to Noah in terms of Battle as when it came to this, the Existential Illusory Weavings of the enemies he had killed came to the forefront.
But the Existential Automatons...held their own terrifying uses that he planned for as he would begin stretching his fingers across the Omniverse with them.

They were built for such a purpose at this moment as magisterial Existential Omniversal Extremity Passages pointed down and gushed out authority endlessly that flowed towards these Automatons and the Existential Illusory Weavings, their bodies only radiating ever increasing grandeur!
|Step forward.|
HUUM!

His voice boomed out towards a single Automaton as it was met with one of these massive constructs coming forward and kneeling respectfully, the blue wings on its back also bent as it showed it would only ever listen to the commands of a single Master!

And yet...Noah planned to sell these Existential Automatons just like the Dikastes of Extremity were being sold to others on the Existential Imperium Exchange, and his purpose was not Fruits of Existence alone.
He stared at the Existential Automaton ahead of him as its weavings bloomed before his eyes.
[Existential Automaton]:: A construct slightly exceeding the Peak of the Gradations of Extremity.

Forged under the banner of many Existential Extremity Authorities, its source was finalized by the weavings of Manadynamics that allowed all the authorities that forged it to be changeable and considered blank existential authorities that can meld with any others...

|Mmm...| Noah nodded while gazing at the details of the Automaton, with Manadynamics coming in as the last piece to make it so that when Noah sold these to others, they could be listed as if they were Unbound from any Existential Extremity Authority and could seamlessly be integrated into any Existential Domains!

This meant that if he were successful, he could have his forged Automatons swirling with his Existential Extremity Authorities...be taken into the homes of powerful Entities from the Imperium without him ever having to lift a finger.
And to complete these entities right now...
|Let Pathogenicity flow to their very core.|
His command boomed out as from his Dominiums, a devilish light erupted out.
It was not yet Existential, and yet...
[The Extremity of Cheats supports the Extremity of Pathogenicity.]
[The Extremity of Loot supports the Extremity of Pathogenicity.]
[The Extremity of Quintessence supports the Extremity of Pathogenicity...]

Apart from Cheats, Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities all propped up the weavings of Pathogenicity as a devilish light bloomed and began to permeate into the Existential Automatons ahead of him!
At the same time that Noah was doing this, part of his was already delved into the Existential Imperium Exchange accessed through the Entry Neonate License.

He had perused fully through the memories of Basileus Moraine who routinely utilized the Entry Neonate License, so he knew exactly what he needed to do as his will appeared in the area termed [My Marketplace]< arriving at an area of immense blank whiteness that seemed like a canvas one could fill up.
In this space, Noah's voice echoed out.
|Add a product.|
The surroundings buzzed as if they sought to establish a connection.
The Entry Neonate License within Noah pulsed as the tight grasp of the Codex of Extremity controlled by Noah and the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed became ever tighter around it!

This was to ensure that Noah would be seen as nothing else other than a member of the Imperium, with the security around the Existential Imperium Exchange being extremely tight as in the unique space he was in, Noah felt a penetrative light flash.
And the result after this penetrative light flashed was a glorious one.
|A new Existential Signature has been detected wishing to list Products within the Exchange.|
|Please state the name you wish to be distinguished with and the distinction of the Enclave connected to the Products to be listed.|
The voice was feminine in nature and entirely robotic, Noah's eyes flashing brilliantly as his own intent weaved out.
|The Weaver of Existence of the Infernal Enclave.|
The Weaver of Existence!
The Infernal Enclave!

His intent listing these spread out as a moment later, a white light flashed as in the center of this blank space, a magic circle began to be etched in real time as it radiated a profound Existential Extremity Authority.
When Noah's eyes gazed at it, Vermillion flames flickered as its identity showed itself.
[The Existential Authority of Spatium.]
He caught mere wisps of its weavings.

He didn't delve any deeper lest his probings be discovered, but this authority was a powerful and heavy one as it dealt with the very existence of space, capable of transporting products vast distances within the Omniverse from one point to another!
|Please place the product or products to be listed in the designated space, and they will undergo preliminary review.|

Before the intent even finished, Noah waved his hands to summon one of his Existential Automatons- miniaturized in nature and still just as terrifying as at this moment, the Existential Extremity Authority flowing across it...was blank.
As if it didn't have a signature.
As if it were unbound.
These...were the means of Manadynamics that stated the very essence of authority could be changed from one form to another!
HUUM!
A dazzling light flashed as soon as the Automaton was placed on the circle radiating Existential light.
And...
|Preliminary Review has discovered an Existential Construct of extremely high quality and unbound by any Existential Extremity Authority.
No further review is required as the product can directly be listed on the exchange.
Please design a description of your product and set the price before submitting it to be displayed, and thank you for utilizing the Exchange of the Imperium.|
A wondrous reality unfolded.
Noah's smile was innocent and bright at this moment as his intent weaved forward akin to a silent beast lying in waiting...
ready to devour an untold number of things!

chapters.title: Chapter 2983 Buying and Selling! II
paragraphs: 2983 Buying and Selling! II
On a day like no other.
A new entry appeared in the Marketplace of the Existential Imperium Exchange!

[Unbound Automaton Worker]:: 3 Fruits of Existence. Peak Gradation of Extremity, approaching Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm in power. Useful in the management of Existential Domains, or as fodders of exploration, this Unbound Automaton Worker was produced by the Infernal Enclave under the direct supervision of the Weaver of Existence...
The description was laid out simply as the price was utterly ridiculous, with Noah setting up such a high price as the power of this Automaton truly approached the Existential Dominium Realm!
This could expand the uses of a construct greatly as it may not just be left alone to manage an Existential Domain.
There were many dangerous areas within the Omniverse that apart from Existential Domains, they were also a focus for the Imperium to explore as one could obtain Fruits of Existence there as well!
Points of existential entropic singularities where immense danger and opportunity lay- to the extent that even the Dominiums of Imperium Knights could fall there.
|This should be the only place Al-Abalem and Ignatius can go to now...|
Noah's intent rang out within himself as he continued to bring more and more Existential Automatons into the Marketplace and list them on the Exchange.

After losing their own Existential Domains, places like these were the only ones that you could risk your life on to attain Fruits of Existence- and any Legacies that did not own an Existential Domain had to be in these regions!

From the memories he devoured, Noah knew there were many pure battles orientated Legacies with high mortality rates that practically lived in regions such as these, and other Legacies and Enclaves of the Imperium were even more stretched out across the Omniverse in even more dangerous areas where Omniversal Pillagers appeared.
|Not just them, but also those of the Sanctus Populi...|
Sanctus Populi! Omniversal Pillagers! Imperium!

The major factions of the Omniverse swirled in Noah's mind as the weavings of his extremes planned and plotted- looking for the best path to navigate across it all as he didn't want to just be limited to a single faction.
As his will moved and transferred the Existential Automatons, he gazed out in the blank openness as he considered many things.
Dynamis of Extremity were no longer coursing within him, but he did have all of his Extremes flowing in synchrony with each other as the idea of Oraculum was still stronger than ever.
The idea of Indefatigable was stronger than ever!
Thanatos burned just as brightly.
He could feel the weavings of the future and more as when he pondered on cause and effect...

|My name should have been passed to the lower rungs of the Imperium now due to the disappearance of an entire Existential Domain. To follow up on this...would a few Knights be dispatched? A whole Knight Legions?|

He was pondering on how the future could unfold as with the limited memories the Basileus had on the Imperium, Noah knew about the terrifying order of knights within this power and rumors of how ruthless their means were!

Any rebelling Archons who didn't pay tribute to the Imperium, any of those who sided with the Sanctus Populi, or any sort of violations against the Imperium faced the blades of the Imperium Knights that always enforced the rule of the Imperium.

But when it came to this, Noah was not entirely sure of their capabilities to locate him- with the tracing of any Entity at the Existential Dominium Realm being something extremely hard with their records being their own.
But powerful beings could still figure out a general coordinate of an entity so long as they had some form of distinction to go on!
The weavings of his extremes buzzed inside of his Dominium as within, a great deal of possibilities unfolded as at this very moment...
[The Protagonist has ascertained the beginnings of a profound Prophecy!]
One of his most prolific extremes began to move with valor!
Across the endless expanse of the Omniverse.
Inside of an Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain.
Across the Omniverse, there were a great deal of unique domains as among them- there existed Domains that had an extremely short lifeline!
Some would only ever be present for an eon, and the extremely dangerous ones may be present for a mere number of years, months, or even days.

They became known as Unstable Anomalous Existential Domains because they had extremely concentrated levels of Existential Authority within them, and yet during their formation- something wrong occurred as their source quickly became unstable and expressed waves of entropic authority, with such Domains facing a demise soon after.
But they were still Existential Domains as in this process, all of their Existential Extremity Authorities were converged to give birth to Unique Fruits of Existence!

For entities who were able to locate an Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain, it was akin to a dangerous treasure trove- but also one filled with immense dangers as the Existential Authority coursing within such an unstable domain gave birth to even greater anomalies and dangers that could shatter the Dominiums of those at the Neonate Stage in an instant!
Within such a Domain.
A vessel withstood arcs of booming Existential storms all around it that raged with a violet light.

Inside this vessel, a man with an unpleasant expression was surrounded by two Imperium Knights and rows of attendants all around him as he was looking at multiple dredges of deformed Dikastes of Extremity that were returned to the vessel in front of him.
|Every single one of these is fucking useless! Can't even withstand a few seconds of existential bombardment...and these were made by the Spirits of the Forge Enclave? Trash!|
He bellowed out with a sense of anger as this entity...was Imperium Royal of somewhat high standing who was currently exploring an Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain!
|Is there absolutely nothing that can help me explore this before I have to report it above?|
The Imperium Royal sighed while tapping on a radiant Entry Neonate License in his hands, his will entering the Existential Imperium Exchange.

chapters.title: Chapter 2984 Buying and Selling! III
paragraphs: Regions that held Unstable Anomalous Existential Domains were extremely dangerous to delve into as one would not normally use themselves, or in the case of an Imperium Royal, they wouldn't even send their Knights out first.

This was because eons of experiences showed how there could be Existential Distortion in regions such as these that could warp someone into distant foreign spaces, with the weavings shared by the Dominiums of some Imperium Royals before they died showing them being warped into the hunting grounds of Omniversal Pillagers, regions under the domains of other forces, or even areas where Existential Extremity Authorities were nullified!
If such a thing occurred, one could only wait for death.

So when it came to exploring any of these regions, many Imperium Royals would have constructs pave the way for the exploration, and they would map out the dangers of an entire Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain before sending out their Knights or Attendants if need be to collect unique treasures!
|Do I really have to purchase Existential Dominium Constructs? The profits from this whole venture will be greatly reduced after that...|
As he entered the Existential Imperium Exchange and began to sort through the countless items listed there, the golden haired Imperium Royal sighed while questioning his next moves.

His hair shone with a golden lister as his body was round and filled with fat, but his face still gave off a sense of profound beauty and power as he stood at the Sequor Stage of Existential Dominium!
He was known as Imperium Royal Decimara!

The two Knights he was granted from his Enclave were of the same stage, with barely a third of the Attendants having achieved the Neonate Stage as the powers he controlled were very little, and yet he was trying to eat up an Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain that he discovered before having to report it.
His will rapidly perused thousands of products every second as he looked for alternative solutions.
|Come on...any junk that can at least withstand a minute before being destroyed. If I can just map and confirm the safety of the entrance ahead, I can attain droves of Fruits of Existence!|
A sense of urgency was welling up within as he looked through the affordable constructs below the Existential Dominium Realm, and as thousands passed before his eyes...
|Huh?|
He stopped his scrolling due to something that stood out.
Among the listed constructs, many had prices of 1⁄3 or even 1⁄4 a Fruit of Existence, and yet there was actually a Construct listed with a cost of 3 Fruits of Existence!
|Hah? Who the hell is bold? What kind of things would you list for such a price? Unless it shits existential gold...|
His curiosity got the better of him as he clicked on the listing, its details flowing out before him.

{Unbound Automaton Worker}:: 3 Fruits of Existence. Peak Gradation of Extremity, approaching Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm in power. Useful in the management of Existential Domains, or as fodders of exploration, this Unbound Automaton Worker was produced by the Infernal Enclave under the direct supervision of the Weaver of Existence...
Approaching the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm?
These words were extremely bold as the demarcation of constructs between the Gradations of Extremity and the Dominium Realm was an uncrossable one.
For any Entity to say they were about to bridge this with their constructs...
Decimara had a pondering gaze as he knew anything listed under the Existential Imperium Exchange underwent review, and it was hard to push out defective or false products.
He could either continue buying multiple more Dikastes Workers for a fraction of Fruits of Existence, or he could take a risk and buy a single one of these...Unbound Automaton Workers.
As for whether its power truly approached the Neonate Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm? This would be the risk he had to take!
|Bah, fuck it. Come on!|
He clicked on the outline of the golden blue figure and paid the price of three Fruits of Extremity, the space in front of him buzzing as a runic magic circle of immense spatial authority bloomed!
And a moment later...
SHAA!
A glorious muscular Automaton revealed itself before him.
He whistled at its visage as it was bathed in a glorious gold and blue light.
A pair of blue wings stretched out behind it as the moment it appeared, its eyes blazed with nine pupils of glorious light as Decimara nodded his head.
|Nice new design...the Infernal Enclave, is it? Let's see how your product is.|
He waved his hands to take this Unbound Automaton Worker outside, a Fruit of Existence flowing from him and towards its chest as this Automaton absorbed its light and came to life right away.
It appeared inside his Vessel as his attendants and Knights gazed at it with question marks, wondering what their Master had wasted resources on now!

But Decimara paid no heed to any gazes as his Existential Extremity Authority flowed outside of his body and into this Unbound Automaton Worker right away...instantly changing its blank nature as with his eyes, he saw it take on the brilliant purple hue of his Existential Extremity Authority.
The very Extremity of Royalty!
|Good...let's go.|

His eyes flashed with a purple light as the vision of the Bound Automaton Worker became his, its figure that was standing tall pulsing with light a moment later as it was warped outside of the Vessel.
Violet Tendrils of light smashed down all around as the moment the Bound Automaton Worker appeared, its massive muscular body weaved left and right to evade them!
|Oh?|

The eyes of Imperium Royal Decimara lit up as he could see the clouded violet storm ahead and the unstable mirrored planes of existence cracking nearby, his Intent going towards the Bound Automaton Worker to delve deeper into the violet cloud to see what lay ahead.
Yet a second later...
BOOM!

A heavy tendril of Violet light with existential authority smashed onto the gold and blue Automaton as it wasn't able to evade it in time, causing the gaze of Decimara to flicker towards anger as he expected another purchase to be destroyed!
But...
When the violet light faded, the Automaton could be seen...uninjured as tendrils of violet existential light covered its body with its muscles spasming, but it seemed fine.
It even looked like the violet light was absorbed into its body before it disappeared into the weavings of its authorities.
Then, unhindered, it continued.
|Haha! Good Automaton! From the Infernal Enclave eh? Very well!|
With a sense of excitement, the Imperium Royal forged forward.
At the same time.
Unbeknownst to him.
Within the supposedly 'Bound' Automaton Worker, a brilliant colorless light of Quintessence arose!

chapters.title: Chapter 2985 The Eyes of Vassals! I
paragraphs: From the moment the Unbound Automaton Worker was bought from the Existential Imperium Exchange and then warped across vast distances of the Omniverse.

First, the main thing to appreciate was the wonder and might of the Existential Imperium Exchange that could allow the transport of constructs and other things listed on it across such vast distances.
Then, after Noah's Automaton actually arrived within the vessel of the Imperium Royal surrounded by two knights and attendants...
Noah's will was already active as even though the Automaton looked like it was free of any specific Existential Authority, it was filled with Noah's authorities!
It...did not need Fruits of Existence to be active.

And yet those who bought it would treat it like so as when the Imperium Royal Decimara gave a Fruit of Existence to the Automaton, Noah simply allowed it to sink into his flowing Existential Extremity Authorities and bring this Loot back to him!
And when the dazzling purple hue of the Existential Extremity Authority of Royalty flowed from the Imperium Royal before Noah and into the Automaton Worker...
Far, far away from the current location where this Imperium Royal was...a prompt rose before Noah's eyes.
{Your existence has been exposed closely with the Existential Extremity Authority of Royalty.}
{The weavings of Royalty have been grasped by you as you attained the Extremity of Loyalty!}
{Existential Analytical Looter is now analyzing this authority and breaking down its attainment as an Existential Authority.}
In an extremely short period of time.

The most his body was exposed with the authority of the Imperium Royal, he instantly crossed the Gradations of Extremity with this authority and brought it towards the peak, and then Existential Analytical Looter broke it down so that if Noah wished in the future...he could seamlessly take this authority to the Existential level!
This alone was a shocking action in itself, but what it represented for the future was the truly astounding reality.
It meant that for any entities who bought his Existential Automatons, any authority they gave to it in order to bind it would be known to Noah!
It would be granted to Noah!
Their authority. The authority of any existential Domains they became bound to...and even others.
This was clearly expressed when Noah's Automaton Worker was taken outside of the vessel and thrown out into the Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain radiating storms of violet existential light.
When the body of the Automaton was smashed with a thick tendril of this authority...
{Your existence has been exposed closely to an unstable but extremely pure natal Existential Extremity Authority.}
{Your weavings are studying this extreme closely to discern its intent.}
{Existential Analytical Looter is analyzing this weaving closely to discern its intent!}
Natal.
An authority not born and expanded to a boundary by an entity, but from this error of a blooming existential singularity here that caused this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain.
The Existential Automaton Worker would have to bathe in even more of it before Noah could attain this as well, but it was only an inevitability.

Within the Existential Automaton, Noah's will fully rose as he took over its workings, Manadynamics flowing smoothly to change all authorities as if they were of Royalty while Quintessence covered all gaps.

He looked at the billowing storms and clouds of violet white light as even though he was in the comfort of his own Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, one of his tools had already been bought as he instantly arrived at a location where dangers and treasures lay hand in hand.

And what the Automaton could see was relayed back to the supposed new 'Master' that was the Imperium Royal Decimara within the Vessel now far behind Noah, but Noah could control the gaze of the Automaton.

If let's say he bypassed these danger zones of this Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain and came across any Natal Existential Armaments or Fruits of Existence...what was there in reality could be very different to the feedback that the Imperium Royal received!
The possibilities of what Noah could do here...were limitless.
|Let's go!|

The nine pupils of the Existential Automaton shone brightly as they now reflected the full will of the Existential Omniversal Emperor, delving deeper into an Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain as far behind him...
|Shit man, what did this Infernal Enclave produce? It truly nears an Existential Dominium Construct!|
Imperium Royal Decimara lauded the wonders of the Existential Automaton as it pushed deeper into the Unstable Anomalous Existential Domain relentlessly.

He felt like he had come across a possible hidden treasure trove with an enclave very few had heard of yet- because he knew all the renowned Enclaves who could produce rare and truly prized things as the Infernal Enclave was not one of them!

So with shifting eyes and a heavy sense of greed, he looked at his Reserves of Fruit of Existence as a part of his will returned to the Existential Imperium Exchange, locating the listing of the Unbound Automaton Worker as he bellowed out.
|But it all!|
He wanted to monopolize it all.
He wanted the Infernal Enclave he had never heard of to be something only he knew of for as long as possible!
So he set out with the task of buying up everything it listed as at this time, it was only the Unbound Automaton Worker.

What he didn't know was that even if he continued to buy them until all of his resources dried up...Noah could continue making them with the majesty of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as he would never run out!
All of these...were the weavings blooming on the surface of the grand Fable of the Weaver of Extremity.
But below all of this majesty, there was also a foundation built below it that moved with just as much intricacy.
And there were some beings who could describe this foundation much more than any others.
Within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
The Scribe of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was gazing at and recording all the intricacies blooming within this unfathomable domain through her own eyes of a Vassal!

chapters.title: Chapter 2986 The Eyes of Vassals! II
paragraphs: She was adorned in a black veil that covered her from head to toe, her fair skin only visible through her eyes as she felt like she was back during her tenure as a Shadow Guard.
It was a position that benefitted her even now as since she was a close aide to the foremost Queen of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, she was blessed with many things.

Her Frozen Queen had given her Fruits of Existence freely as her own Gradations had risen heavily, where even though she wasn't among the die hard fans of power, she arrived at the Seventh Gradation of Extremity!
And now, she was observing the visible change and alterations of the weavings of Entities who had lived for billions of years as they came to understand just which lands they were currently in.
One of the foremost case studies was the Primogenitor of Steel who was among those that reigned supreme in the Vitalis Hyperversal Domain.

After the battle with the Lesser Mimeisthais and the subsequent Loot that was granted to him and many others, the stage of power of this old entity...finally came to reach the Ninth Gradation of Extremity.
And when the scribe watched his expression, he seemed more dazed and lost for the most part as if he was questioning what he was doing for millions upon millions of years before this!
Apart from him, there were others whose expressions were filled with determination as the choices they took led them to a similar stage.

The visage of the Young Emperor Prince Henry was bathed in the golden luster of an Existential Extremity Authority as he also stood at the Ninth Gradation of Extremity, his gaze far above as if he were looking at a shadow of his father that he could never overcome.
Sis Barbatos, another Queen of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, held a stage of terrifying power that seemed to be half in the Gradations of Extremity, and half outside of it.
Her power was unique as she and the other Queens shared a great deal of strength with the Master, and since his Realm was only becoming more unfathomable, so would theirs!

Then, there were other new entrants like Ishtar, Sargon, and the Cimmerian Architect who had defeated Mimeisthais of their own and attained enough Fruits of Existence to touch upon the Ninth Gradation of Extremity...along with one unlikely contender that The Scribe had been watching closely over the last few days.
The Demon that had fallen from her throne a long time ago...her fair crimson hands now rose as she seemed to be looking at who she was without believing it.
Among those who had made it.
Among those who stood at the peak of the Gradations of Extremity.
The Daughter of Hatred questioned with her own eyes whether she really stood at the Ninth Gradation of Extremity!

Around her, those who had been with her through the past battles were a stage before her but just as happy, with the figure of Ayame coming and hugging Lilith from behind while releasing a bellow of happiness- the weavings of Infinity pulsing around them!
Yes.
Joy.
A rarity in this rat race of more and more power, but some beings could bask in their accomplishments- even if momentarily as at this moment, only half of their Wills were here.

The other half...even the Scribe's will included, were all pulled towards another unique location that seemed to exist between the weavings of Existence and Records of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
The Scribe closed her eyes as she sensed her other half in a place recently designed by the Existential Omniversal Emperor.
In this space, an endless clear sea could be felt all around them as when they opened their eyes, there wasn't any sign of the chains they knew wrapped around them before.
Only an endless blue sea all around as when they gazed far above, they seemed to barely catch a glimpse of an endless sky!
|The Quintessential Gradations of Extremity...|
The Scribe called out with her intent as in her hands, a white book appeared along with a Colorless pen that began to write down everything she could see!

She was in the waters of the Seventh Gradation of Extremity, but the seas were so clear that an innumerable distance above her, she could almost make out the figures of the Young Master, the Primogenitor of Steel, Barbatos, and many others far above her in the next Gradations.

There were hundreds of other Vassals of the Master all around her as they found the blue waters all around them...continued to passively flow into their Existence as they reinforced it and the Concepts within them.
As if even if they didn't do anything, they would continue to be elevated until they eventually reached the Ninth Gradation of Extremity!
Who else but the Master could do this?

The Scribe smiled at such a thought as she wondered, how different was it for the Young Master and others who were swimming in the waters of the Ninth Gradation of Extremity? How much time would pass before they reached the endless skies?
She didn't know for sure, but she knew she had to have this level of power herself in order to continue her work as the Scribe of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
So she also became filled with determination as she began to ascend the Quintessential Gradations of Extremity, the white book in her hands closing as she held it tight!
On the cover of the book, it read...{The Quintessential Fable of the Existential Omniversal Emperor}!
In the dazzlingly vast Omniverse.
|Where the hell is it...|
The voice of a certain Sanctus Princess rang out as she continued to search atop her Draconic Knight for something she knew was in this region to no avail!
Her body was already emanating a heavy Existential light that spread out all around, but she became stern as she began to spread it ever further at this moment.

Unbeknownst to her though...a dazzling cerulean vessel in the form of a Ruler had crossed great distances and was arriving towards the same region she was in to search for the same thing she was seeking!

chapters.title: Chapter 2987 Two Sides Clash! I
paragraphs: A dazzling vessel in the form of a blue ruler was streaking across the dark canvas of the Omniverse, a terrifying Imperium Knight Legion aboard this vessel in addition to the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer Xavier that had taken responsibility for the downfall of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains!

At its forefront, a woman holding a vibrant Codex of Extremity adorned in a crimson armor laced with golden linings could be seen, a man with a similar Existential Armament beside her as behind them, 10 other Imperium Knights followed their lead.
Knight Akalusia and Knight Palmino in the lead, and ten others following behind them.
It was a lineup that would terrify most Archons of common Legacies as all three were on the Third Stage of Existential Dominium Realm- Teleios!
Beside Knight Akalusia, Knight Palmino gazed at the endless expanse they crossed as his intent weaved out.
|Our cause is a glorious one as we have been bred since birth to go against Omniversal Pillagers. To be sidetracked on a mission like this...|
Not all were content with the current mission.

To chase down the weavings of a Seed? A fucking Seed of all of things? Not even a target of Sanctus Populi or Omniversal Pillagers, but something that based on the Intel had possibly attained the Dominium Realm on the last day.
They would waste their time with this?
Hearing the intent of Knight Palmino and gazing at his golden crimson hair, he looked like a shining example of an Imperium Knight with his fair skin and a gaze that seemed to be above all others.
Knight Akalusia herself was of pristine beauty with her crimson gold hair, her gold eyes sharp and filled with sharpness as within her eyes- the same level of pride and arrogance couldn't be seen.
She didn't even turn to gaze at Knight Palmino as she relayed her own intent calmly while gazing ahead.
|We are the Sword of the Imperium. We go wherever we are aimed, and we cut down whatever opposes the Imperium. Our feelings do not matter, Knight Palmino.|
Blazing words of brilliance boomed out- the intent loud enough for Palmino to hear, and for the other 10 Knights and the Royal Observer to hear!
Knight Palmino only became colder at such a reply as at this moment, he scrutinized Knight Akalusia up and down.

|I follow every command as a Knight of the Imperium while putting my feelings aside. When you were appointed to lead alongside me, I left my feelings out of it. But I am curious about your Origins, Knight Akalusia...which Enclave do you stem from that without any prior history, you would be appointed to lead a Legion? A Red Legion at that too. Why-|
BZZT!
The words of Knight Palmino didn't continue.

Knight Akalusia had raised her hand holding the dazzling Codex of Extremity, such an action causing the facial muscles on Knight Palmino to twitch in anger as before anything could be said, they all observed Knight Akalusia to be gazing forward intently as she spoke.
|Feel.|
Feel.
A single intent, but the gazes of all those here hardened as they looked ahead.
Their Dominiums buzzed as they each spread out like a billowing see, silent and deadly as within a moment...
The gazes of the Knights changed heavily.
Far, far ahead of them, they felt a daring and blazing aura similar to theirs.
An aura of the Teleios Stage of Existential Dominium Realm!
And at the moment that the billowing Dominiums of Knight Palmino and the others billowed out and discovered such auras, the other side also discovered them.
Feeling this aura closely, the gaze of Knight Palmino became utterly cold as he bellowed out.
|ARMS!|
A glimmer of brilliance.
And in his hands, a dazzling Golden sword and a crimson shield appeared.

Absolute sharpness and absolute defense came together as behind him, the Knights of this Red Legion became equipped with similar Existential Armaments- a combination of Swords and Shield as some had dual shields or dual swords!
And the moment they were equipped, Knight Palmino didn't hesitate as his figure flickered out of existence.
|Destroy the enemies of the Imperium!|
BOOM!
The distance was long.
But for them, it was also short.

A resplendent existential authority blazed on Knight Palmino as with a single step, the expanse of the Omniverse seemed to flicker beneath his feet as he disappeared, and an instant later...his visage was already in front of a massive Draconic Knight and a gorgeous verdant haired woman gazing coldly above it!
Enemies of the Imperium.
These were the words Knight Palmino shouted out as he was very cognizant of the different auras of the enemies of the Imperium.
And those ahead of them- the visage of the gorgeous woman above a Draconic Knight...was something common for those of the Sanctus Populi.
The visage of Knight Palmino blazed with Existential brilliance as he arrived in front of the two entities, his eyes steeped in immense hatred and honor as his Existential Armament swung down.
He looked into the eyes of the green haired Sanctus Princess and the coldness they showed, along with the serpentine eyes of the dragon beneath her as he spat out with as much vile as he could.
|Heretics.|
And his sword swung down.

A profound purple radiance swung down with it as behind him, the Existential Extremity Authority of royalty congealed to form a very real purple sword that seemed capable of cleaving apart any Dominium of the Teleios Stage with ease- this sword intending to cut down those ahead of him!

The Sanctus Princess was calm at such a scene as she seemed to be looking at both Knight Palmino and the less than a dozen other Knights behind him on their way over...and she then patted the dragon beneath her as his booming intent echoed out.
|Immeasurable Dignity.|
WAA!
The Existential Extremity Authority of Dignity bloomed.

Above the figures of the Sanctus Princess and the Draconic Knight, an interminably massive golden scroll manifested and unfurled, the scripture of DIGNITY written across it as it was radiating a shocking Dominium Rule!
A rule that stated unless you held a higher level of Dignity than me...you could not cut me down!

Absolute sharpness and absolute defense came together as behind him, the Knights of this Red Legion became equipped with similar Existential Armaments- a combination of Swords and Shield as some had dual shields or dual swords!
And the moment they were equipped, Knight Palmino didn't hesitate as his figure flickered out of existence.
|Destroy the enemies of the Imperium!|
BOOM!
The distance was long.
But for them, it was also short.

A resplendent existential authority blazed on Knight Palmino as with a single step, the expanse of the Omniverse seemed to flicker beneath his feet as he disappeared, and an instant later...his visage was already in front of a massive Draconic Knight and a gorgeous verdant haired woman gazing coldly above it!
Enemies of the Imperium.
These were the words Knight Palmino shouted out as he was very cognizant of the different auras of the enemies of the Imperium.
And those ahead of them- the visage of the gorgeous woman above a Draconic Knight...was something common for those of the Sanctus Populi.
The visage of Knight Palmino blazed with Existential brilliance as he arrived in front of the two entities, his eyes steeped in immense hatred and honor as his Existential Armament swung down.
He looked into the eyes of the green haired Sanctus Princess and the coldness they showed, along with the serpentine eyes of the dragon beneath her as he spat out with as much vile as he could.
|Heretics.|
And his sword swung down.

A profound purple radiance swung down with it as behind him, the Existential Extremity Authority of royalty congealed to form a very real purple sword that seemed capable of cleaving apart any Dominium of the Teleios Stage with ease- this sword intending to cut down those ahead of him!

The Sanctus Princess was calm at such a scene as she seemed to be looking at both Knight Palmino and the less than a dozen other Knights behind him on their way over...and she then patted the dragon beneath her as his booming intent echoed out.
|Immeasurable Dignity.|
WAA!
The Existential Extremity Authority of Dignity bloomed.

Above the figures of the Sanctus Princess and the Draconic Knight, an interminably massive golden scroll manifested and unfurled, the scripture of DIGNITY written across it as it was radiating a shocking Dominium Rule!
A rule that stated unless you held a higher level of Dignity than me...you could not cut me down!

chapters.title: Chapter 2988 Two Sides Clash! II
paragraphs: The dazzling scroll radiated immense golden waves of existential authority as opposing it was an extremely real purple sword carrying down its own Dominium Rule of Royalty- that it could cut down anything opposing it.
Royalty and Dignity.
Such contrasting and similar concepts laid down their Dominium Rules as a heavy impact boomed out!
Inside the glorious Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
Noah was in the midst of quantifying the many changes and seeing the production of Fruits of Existence within his body when he instantly raised his head to look towards a certain direction.
His eyes seemed to pierce across the veils of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed and see far outside it, waves of existential authority being felt far in the distance as his eyes became somber!
The authority was heavy.
The Dominiums releasing it were heavy!
The scale couldn't even be easily discerned as even in this far distance, Noah felt that just the raw power of the impact of the Dominium Rules may be able to oppress his extremes!

It may not mean that his Existential Extremity Authorities were weaker than theirs, but their pure raw power contained in their Dominiums- having absorbed eons worth of Fruits of Existence and being reinforced and annealed over and over again...could simply press down and ignore the alteration of existence itself that Noah could impose with his Extremes.
But even while he felt this shocking authority, Noah was simply somber and not fearful.
He closed his eyes and read the weavings of existence.
He knew that in the endless expanse of the Omniverse, it was unlikely for him to come across Entities with the waves of power that he currently felt at random.
There was a high chance these entities were here for him!
But for this clash to occur, they had to be of different factions.
Even with the power they expressed though...
{The Extremity of Conquest pulses with determination.}
{The Extremity of Tyranny welcomed the challenge!}
{The Extremity of Cheats smiles and gazes at the Source of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.}
His extremes expressed their desires.
Yes, the enemies were far stronger than he was.
But he wasn't alone.
His strength couldn't be measured by his Dominiums alone!

Cheats had already pointed to the path forward as Noah's main body appeared in the isolated space of the dazzling multicolored throne that was heavily bathed with Manadynamics at this moment, his eyes locked onto the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as she turned towards him with a bow.
|Master, would you like to try?|
Her words were calm as if she already knew what Noah intended to do.
When the strength of one's enemies was so vast, it was impossible to bridge such a gap- especially so in the Existential Dominium Realm.
But Noah had something no other beings could claim ownership to.
Noah had the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
Among its many expanded capabilities, it still had its defensive and offensive features.

In the past, Noah could wield a spear- an Atlatl that carried the weight of this construct when it was a Haven or Plane. Now, its boons were further expanded as the ways Noah could borrow the power of this construct were utterly unfathomable!
Noah gave a light nod towards the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as he stretched out his hands towards her.
|Come.|
HUUM!

The surroundings began to buzz with interminable existential might as the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed turned into blazing streams of light that flowed towards Noah's hand and began covering his whole body!
{The process of Existential Omniversal Shrouding has begun.}
Shrouding.
It was a unique choice of wording in comparison to Armament or Adornment, but it was more so inclined to protectively wrap around something!
To cloth and veil an object!
At this moment, Noah's visage became shrouded with the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
And with such an action, he sought to carry with him the power of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed itself!

What did such a concept even mean? What did it signify for a being to wield the weight, records, existence, and extremes of an Omniversal Seed? And just how could such a thing compare to the scales of power established by the forces of the Omniverse?
Noah was itching to find out as his body became encapsulated by layers and layers of weavings, a radiant multicolored Armament that had pulsing linings of Cerulean light being formed around him!
It buzzed like a forming engine of unimaginable power, this light extending to form a resplendent spear of light in his right hand and an aegis in his left hand.
His Three Dominiums were contained within as they felt an unfathomably heavy weight pressing down all around them, this weight lessening over time as Noah acclimated until finally...
HUUM!
Blazing blue auroras of wings expanded out behind his back as an instant later, his figure took a single step and disappeared.
Towards the region where a heavy clash has occurred.

Purple and gold seemed to split existence itself as a single Sanctus Princess mounted a Draconic Knight and stood opposite to an Imperium Knight who pulled back his sword- the result of their Dominium Rules shockingly showing the purple sword of Royalty booming and crumbling in front of the DIGNITY of the Draconic Knight!
Its eyes were filled with immense Existential Extremity Authorities as at this moment, violet waves of Honor began to surge around the golden waves of Dignity.

Dignity and Honor. Extremes that the Draconic Knights of the Sanctus Populi were always covered by- and they were extremes that were very hard to overcome by other Lineages unless...it was an Imperium Knight with extremely pure blood of an Omniversal Lineage!

The Sanctus Princess stroked the sacred of the Draconic Knight below as she fearlessly and coldly gazed at the Legion that had lined up behind Knight Palmino, her eyes actually locked onto the golden haired Knight Akalusia who held the dazzling Codex in her hands more than anything else as towards her...she held a hint of caution!

chapters.title: Chapter 2989 Glory! I
paragraphs: An Imperium Knight Legion stood before them!
And yet the Sanctus Princess and the Draconic Knight she stood atop of seemed to hold immeasurable Honor and Dignity before them as there wasn't an ounce of fear.
On top of the Draconic Knight, the Sanctus Princess was one who held many distinctions and titles within the Sanctus Populi.
Sanctus Princess Emilliana.
The Carver of Truth.
She was one of the distinguished Sanctus Princesses who earned the title of Sanctus Protector!
The experiences drilled into her by the Sanctus Populi were innumerable as she read and grasped the weavings of what was occurring in an extremely short period of time.
Especially the presence of a late arriving Imperium Royal Basileus Observer staying back in the far distance!

She instantly affirmed that it wasn't a coincidence that the dogs of the Imperium appeared here. She even went further to deduce that they were in this region just like her...looking for the same thing. Connected to what she had witnessed not too long ago.
And if she could find out more of what they were looking for, she would also know why her weavings pulled her here.
So she stroked the scales of the Draconic Knight below her as her intent weaved out calmly.
|Whatever could the dogs of the Imperium be doing at a place like this? Far from home...far from your cozy abodes.|

Her intent weaved out while the Knight Legion ahead of her got into a circular formation that covered all gaps, their bodies radiating intense waves of existential authority as at her words- the sword and shield in the hands of Knight Palmino buzzed.
His eyes let out utterly chilling murderous light as he spat out his weavings.
|Dogs? Haha, I am going to enjoy splitting apart the Dominium of another Sanctus Princess while their Dragon Knight watches o-|
The words Knight Palmino uttered were filled with arcs of power, but the visage of Knight Akalusia arrived with her Codex in hand as her authority pressed down on everything.
As if everything had to be centered around her.
This...was a direct effect of the Existential Extremity Authority around her as it was so potent that she vastly outstripped all other Knights here.
As if in all existence here, she was the only true Royalty!
Her golden hair shimmered with brilliance as she grasped the Codex in her hands while looking at Sanctus Princess Emilliana closely, her intent weaving out.
|At a place like this...we are naturally looking for someone. Do you happen to know anything about Noah Osmont? About Vitalis and Vacuous?|
Her questions may seem like random words to others, but they were meant to get to the root of their purpose here!
Hearing such a question, any other entity may have given away signs, but Sanctus Princess Emilliana remained as calm as it was.

Uniquely, the pure Existential Authority of Royalty that Knight Akalusia released was capable of radiating an oppressive pressure even on Teleios Stage Entities to bend them to her will, and yet the Sanctus Princess shrugged it off as if it were nothing when she replied.

|The dogs of the Imperium chasing after someone...how unlucky they are. Now, are some of you prepared for the apocalypse of your Dominiums just for coming across someone else today? Or would you rather go your separate ways?|

Dominating weavings bloomed as from the verdant visage of the Sanctus Princess Emilliana, even more profound waves of Dignity and Honor blooming and resonating with the existing ones on the Draconic Knight below her!
Multiple Dominium Rules were seemingly ready to be released.
And they sought to change the landscape of existence itself depending on the answer of the Imperium Knight Legion ahead.

The eyes of the Imperium Knights shone with a chilling light while the visage of Knight Akalusia...unfurled the Codex of Extremity she held in her hands, her eyes falling on it as she spoke out impassively.
|Death is but a part of life. Even though I would rather go about things a different way, the rules of the Imperium are absolute.|
The Sanctus Princess smiled.
|I thought so.|
And she then patted the Draconic Knight below her as in an instant...their bodies resonated as the wavelength of their Dominiums went towards becoming one!
The eyes of the Imperium Knights became stern as they also knew one thing very well.
No entity was more dangerous than a Sanctus Princess mounted on her Dragon Knight.
If one couldn't force them to dismount in the first few strokes of the battle, they were in for a heavy fight!
ROAAR!

The Existential Extremity Authority of Fusion bloomed amidst Dignity and Honor, a verdant purple light blazing all around as even Knight Akalusia pulled back while the Codex in her hands released waves of light- light that went on to cover everything nearby.
It was the start of a heavy battle as it was at this moment...that another entrant to this fight arrived at a far distance.
The target both sides were looking for.
The visage of Noah, bathed in a radiant multicolored Armament and holding an aegis and spear, his cerulean Aurora of wings now released a Colorless light that covered him entirely!
Not even a wisp of his aura could be felt as he watched on from a distance.
{The Extremity of Loots licks his lips at the quality of possible Loot ahead.}
{The Extremity of Tyranny gazes from its high throne towards the weavings of Dignity, Honor, and Royalty in the distance.}
The weavings of authorities being used had their identities ascertained by Noah right away as his extremes began to emanate their desires!
{The Extremity of Cheats urges of Loot.}
{Existential Analytical Looter has been activated on all visible targets!}
{The Extremity of the Protagonist senses a critical opportunity arriving as it utilizes its built up authority to grant itself yet another identity.}
After the Weaver of Extremity.
After laying down prophecies!
The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist moved to do something else with the overabundance of authority it held!
