chapters.title: Chapter 2990 Glory! II
paragraphs: The Weavings of Noah's extremes were churning rapidly as others nearly asked the Protagonist what it was doing when it was already designing a daring new prophecy.
And yet this extreme moved rapidly, heavily connecting its weavings to multiple other extremes!
{The Extremity of Loot, Hero, and Villain are drawn into the fold.}
{The Extremity of Cheats adds itself into the fold.}
{The indomitable Extremity of Extremity makes what is about to be born even more extreme!}
His authorities piled on one after another.
And in the next instant...
{The feature of The Hero's Journey is being actualized.}
{As the Protagonist, you cycle through a sequence of events from a call to adventure, trials and ordeals, death and rebirth, all the way to your transformation that leads to your ultimate reward.}

{On this path, countless cannon fodders are ground down to be your fuel as at this moment, the utmost extreme of the Protagonist seeks for a way to gain the ultimate reward of the enemies you face without having to do too much work.}
{After all, everything should come easy if you are truly a great protagonist.}
{The First Utilization of the Hero's Journey, Loot Marker, can now be activated.}

{So long as you come in contact with the Dominium of your target, they will be marked forever as their very existence begins to leak out and become fuel for you- as you begin to attain the ultimate reward early. If this mark cannot be erased, the very existence of the targeted cannon fodder will continue to leak out until they are no more.}
{If the targets have a high percentage of Analysis with Existential Analytical Looter, this process will become even faster.}
The golden light of the Protagonist shone brightly.
Other authorities supported it with ease as Noah accepted the inflow of information- and he then came to gaze at the Shrouding wrapping around him.
He was ready to go out with his Aegis and Spear.
But seeing the advent of this new feature, he stopped as he thought for a moment before he called out deep within himself.
|Ruination.|
Inside of his soul, a dormant weapon opened its eyes and answered its Master's call.
The weavings of what Noah wanted flowed into the heart of Ruination as a crimson gold light began to bloom in front of Noah- forming into what he wanted!
A long range weapon for him to best utilize the feature of The Hero's Journey.
|A Bow, Ballista, Railgun, or Sniper Rifle, Master?|
The weavings of Ruination echoed out.
And Noah answered simply.
|Let's test out the Bow for now.|
HUUM!
A dazzling crimson gold bow formed before Noah as thereafter, the aegis and spear within his hands turned into a light that covered this crimson gold bow!
The force of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was applied to this weapon as Noah came to grasp it comfortably.

His left hand grabbed the bow as his right hand quickly pulled back the string, his Existential Extremity Authorities leaking and flowing into the stretched string madly as the Shrouding of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed also flowed its terrific light into the bow!
Noah let out a light breath.
His visage was invisible.
Tendrils of existential light continued to flow and accumulate with his outstretched hand holding the bow, and he didn't release it just yet!
He allowed it to continue accumulating power.
The massive and heavy flow of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed continued to amass!
His enemies were clashing as he could allow them to create an even more chaotic battlefield.
And at the most opportune time when the largest number of his enemies were defending against those in front of them...he would strike from the dark!
An instant passed.
The clashes of existential authority became even more intense.

The two shining points of lights seemed to blaze with a verdant and golden light- one fused with a massive Draconic entity as her whole visage was bathed with majesty, the other holding a dazzling Codex of Extremity that was now radiating a profound gold purple light that sought to alter the weavings of the surrounding existence entirely!
It was to the extent that the flows of the Existential Extremity Authority she released...seemed to be resonating with the surrounding weavings of the Omniverse itself.
This...what was this?
Noah's eyes with the bow string outstretched locked onto the dazzling Codex of Extremity in her hands as this was the prime culprit!
The Codex of Extremity...was capable of resonating with the weavings of the Omniverse itself?
What Noah held was not the complete Codex of Extremity, but he was still studying everything that could be done with it.
It seemed he could only truly grasp this with a complete Codex as at this moment, a blinding light of greed flashed within his eyes.
He felt the blooming chaos and bidding Entropy of the battlefield.
And he then closed his eyes.
His Existential Body Dominium pulsed as his fingers trembled from holding back the string of the bow that was supporting the shocking grandeur of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!

His Origin and Soul Dominiums reinforced his Body as he barely managed to keep it together, the Dominium Rule of Quintessence being layered on as it sought to prevent the activation of any other authorities.
A Dominium Rule of Infinity was piled on as the number of arrows he could release would be many!
A Dominium Rule of Loot shone brightly as it made sure the feature of the Hero's Journey could be achieved so long as the requirements were met.
The ebb and flow of entropy reached a shocking level as after some time, Noah opened his eyes once more.
His breathing was so supremely calm as if he were doing nothing important.
And yet multicolored radiance blazed around him as finally...he released the string.
And exactly 15 dazzling arrows were released all at once!
SAA!

They slid across the innumerable string like waves of existence and non-existence as they disappeared, and by the time they reappeared one more...they were in front of all targets waging a war against each other far ahead of him!
All 15 had their Dominiums burning with a shocking purple radiance, some being brighter than others.
The Imperium Royal Observer in the back...shone with the least brightness as Noah was ready to see.
Which of them would he manage to at least touch the Dominiums of and activate the feature of the Hero's Journey?!

His authorities piled on one after another.
And in the next instant...
{The feature of The Hero's Journey is being actualized.}
{As the Protagonist, you cycle through a sequence of events from a call to adventure, trials and ordeals, death and rebirth, all the way to your transformation that leads to your ultimate reward.}

{On this path, countless cannon fodders are ground down to be your fuel as at this moment, the utmost extreme of the Protagonist seeks for a way to gain the ultimate reward of the enemies you face without having to do too much work.}
{After all, everything should come easy if you are truly a great protagonist.}
{The First Utilization of the Hero's Journey, Loot Marker, can now be activated.}

{So long as you come in contact with the Dominium of your target, they will be marked forever as their very existence begins to leak out and become fuel for you- as you begin to attain the ultimate reward early.
If this mark cannot be erased, the very existence of the targeted cannon fodder will continue to leak out until they are no more.}
{If the targets have a high percentage of Analysis with Existential Analytical Looter, this process will become even faster.}
The golden light of the Protagonist shone brightly.
Other authorities supported it with ease as Noah accepted the inflow of information- and he then came to gaze at the Shrouding wrapping around him.
He was ready to go out with his Aegis and Spear.
But seeing the advent of this new feature, he stopped as he thought for a moment before he called out deep within himself.
|Ruination.|
Inside of his soul, a dormant weapon opened its eyes and answered its Master's call.
The weavings of what Noah wanted flowed into the heart of Ruination as a crimson gold light began to bloom in front of Noah- forming into what he wanted!
A long range weapon for him to best utilize the feature of The Hero's Journey.
|A Bow, Ballista, Railgun, or Sniper Rifle, Master?|
The weavings of Ruination echoed out.
And Noah answered simply.
|Let's test out the Bow for now.|
HUUM!
A dazzling crimson gold bow formed before Noah as thereafter, the aegis and spear within his hands turned into a light that covered this crimson gold bow!
The force of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was applied to this weapon as Noah came to grasp it comfortably.

His left hand grabbed the bow as his right hand quickly pulled back the string, his Existential Extremity Authorities leaking and flowing into the stretched string madly as the Shrouding of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed also flowed its terrific light into the bow!
Noah let out a light breath.
His visage was invisible.
Tendrils of existential light continued to flow and accumulate with his outstretched hand holding the bow, and he didn't release it just yet!
He allowed it to continue accumulating power.
The massive and heavy flow of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed continued to amass!
His enemies were clashing as he could allow them to create an even more chaotic battlefield.
And at the most opportune time when the largest number of his enemies were defending against those in front of them...he would strike from the dark!
An instant passed.
The clashes of existential authority became even more intense.

The two shining points of lights seemed to blaze with a verdant and golden light- one fused with a massive Draconic entity as her whole visage was bathed with majesty, the other holding a dazzling Codex of Extremity that was now radiating a profound gold purple light that sought to alter the weavings of the surrounding existence entirely!
It was to the extent that the flows of the Existential Extremity Authority she released...seemed to be resonating with the surrounding weavings of the Omniverse itself.
This...what was this?
Noah's eyes with the bow string outstretched locked onto the dazzling Codex of Extremity in her hands as this was the prime culprit!
The Codex of Extremity...was capable of resonating with the weavings of the Omniverse itself?
What Noah held was not the complete Codex of Extremity, but he was still studying everything that could be done with it.
It seemed he could only truly grasp this with a complete Codex as at this moment, a blinding light of greed flashed within his eyes.
He felt the blooming chaos and bidding Entropy of the battlefield.
And he then closed his eyes.
His Existential Body Dominium pulsed as his fingers trembled from holding back the string of the bow that was supporting the shocking grandeur of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!

His Origin and Soul Dominiums reinforced his Body as he barely managed to keep it together, the Dominium Rule of Quintessence being layered on as it sought to prevent the activation of any other authorities.
A Dominium Rule of Infinity was piled on as the number of arrows he could release would be many!
A Dominium Rule of Loot shone brightly as it made sure the feature of the Hero's Journey could be achieved so long as the requirements were met.
The ebb and flow of entropy reached a shocking level as after some time, Noah opened his eyes once more.
His breathing was so supremely calm as if he were doing nothing important.
And yet multicolored radiance blazed around him as finally...he released the string.
And exactly 15 dazzling arrows were released all at once!
SAA!

They slid across the innumerable string like waves of existence and non-existence as they disappeared, and by the time they reappeared one more...they were in front of all targets waging a war against each other far ahead of him!
All 15 had their Dominiums burning with a shocking purple radiance, some being brighter than others.
The Imperium Royal Observer in the back...shone with the least brightness as Noah was ready to see.
Which of them would he manage to at least touch the Dominiums of and activate the feature of the Hero's Journey?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2991 Glory! III
paragraphs: 2991 Glory! III
The bowstring vibrated.
An immense sense of exhaustion dawned on Noah as instant after, his Dominiums creaked as they could no longer bear the weight of the Existential Omniversal Shrouding!
The dazzling Shrouding began to fade from him as his visage receded further from this area, but his eyes never left the unfolding scene ahead!
Inside of him, Extremity Passages began to surge and seethe as they sought to fill up his Dominiums with power once more.

The Shrouding of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was a terrifying one as its results were about to show themselves. But its cost was just as heavy, and with Noah in the beginning sky of the Primordium Stage of Existential Dominium, he could barely handle it while releasing such a concentrated version of its power like he just did.
But for such a high cost...the effects were even more dazzling.

In the blooming battlefield of existential authority and even something relating to the very Omniverse itself being stimulated by a Codex of Extremity, an attack descended on each entity here at the exact same time.
And yet the reactions to them were all entirely different!

Knight Akalusia seemed to sense the attack the moment it appeared, her gaze placid as she pressed her hand behind her- a sea of boundless purple light of Royalty blooming as the heavy arrow disappeared into it.
Sanctus Princess Emilliana was even more obscene as while facing both Knight Akalusia and Knight Palmino at the same time, she didn't even turn her head towards the attack as she called out!
|Dragon's Dignity.|
HUUM!
Brilliant verdant gold light bloomed as the dazzling multicolored arrow was forced to a stop a distance from her, never even coming close to her or her Dominium!
Noah gazed at this scene unfolding as truly, it was hard.

It was truly hard to bridge the gap of the stages of power across the Dominium Realm as even a tool like the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed could only just barely give a bridge towards this idea!
For the two strongest entities, his attacks never even came close to their Dominiums.
They were too cautious. They were too powerful to allow any variables!
But then, there were others who heldjust a hint of more pride and arrogance in their own power.

Facing the instantly appearing attack, Knight Palmino was in the middle of swinging his sword and cutting apart the weavings of existence itself before him, his eyes flashing as he discerned this attack and affirmed it wouldn't have a major impact on him.
His Dominium could rebuff something like this!
And so...
BOOM!
The multicolored arrow splintered into a heavy singularity of power as his Dominium withstood it easily.
He continued on as per normal.
But he didn't know.
Oh, he didn't know!
[Loot Marker has been applied to a Knight of the Imperium- Knight Palmino!]
Noah's eyes pulsed with brightness as one way or another, Loot Marker was applied to one of the stronger beings here.

And it wasn't over as in the midst of their attacks, the other Imperium Knights handled the newly appearing attacks on their own ways as some swung their Existential Armaments to rebuff them, others allowed their Armors to withstand it, and in the case of the Imperium Royal Basileus Observer Xavier in the far distance not participating in this...
BOOM!
His expression was unsightly as shockingly, half of his shoulder was blown off.
Half!

It was a reality that ascertained Noah's power and the power of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed- that even at its current stage, its output was actually capable of skipping the Neonate Stage and Sequor Stage to be capable of injuring someone at the Teleios Stage of Existential Dominium Realm!
[Loot Marker has been applied to the Observer Xavier!]
[Loot Marker has been applied to a Knight of the Imperium- Knight Rudiger!]
[Loot Marker has been applied to a Knight of the Imperium- Knight Viola!]
Only a single Teleios Stage entity was injured by it.

But others underestimated the nature of this attack as they shook it off with their Dominiums and Armaments alone, half of the Knight Legion moving a distance away while Knight Palmino began to shout vividly.
|A second enemy hidden in the dark- find them and bring them to the light!|
His words boomed commandingly as 6 Knights turned into lights that spread out towards the surroundings.
Knight Akalusia had a stern expression as she controlled the Codex of Extremity, her left hand waving to reveal the endless purple sea containing the shot out arrow as at this moment...
the arrow began to disappear.
But she already felt something from it.
She affirmed there was a third party besides those from the Sanctus Populi here!
'Perhaps...'
A glimmer of a Weaving flashed over here as at this moment, the battle entered a new phase as the different forces shifted.
She was about to begin utilizing the Codex to uncover everything when...
|What?|
The intent of Knight Palmino drew her gaze.
His golden hair flowed brilliantly as at this moment, he was touching his face with a twisted expression.
This was because gradually, in the past instant after withstanding the arrow that was just shot, a marking began to bloom on his face!

It was a pair of eyes and a devilish smile forming on his forehead as a moment later, boundless golden light gushed forth from the devilish eyes as if they were a passage- Knight Palmino feeling the very essence of his Dominium Soul beginning to leak out senselessly!
The devilish smile seemed to be cackling in joy.
The eyes looked like punctured points of his Dominium that gushed out his authority into massive rivers that disappeared into nothingness!
And he wasn't the only one as apart from him, four other Imperium Knights and the Observer Xavier also had similar markings blooming on their foreheads!
Rivers of golden Loot light leaked from them senselessly as a terrifying extreme began to truly express itself...

chapters.title: Chapter 2992 Glory! IV
paragraphs: 2992 Glory! IV
[Entities that have lived across eons have been branded with the identity of Loot Markers!]
[Coming across your Fable, their status can only be reduced to cannon fodder!]

Such dazzling prompts bloomed before Noah's eyes as he saw 6 Imperium Knights spread outwards, one coming towards his direction as wondrously, he was among the Four Imperium Knights including Knight Palmino who were marked.
They did not use means that stopped the advancement of the arrows Noah had shot, and they instead withstood them with their own Dominiums.

On their foreheads, a devilishly gold smile and eyes were branded as waves of golden light leaked out with maddening fervor and disappeared into oblivion, and yet Noah's own Dominium felt these rivers of golden Loot light manifesting within!
[The very Existence of Teleios Stage Entities is being devoured by you.]
[Rewards that would have come at the latter stages of the Hero's Journey are being obtained by you now!]
[Weavings of Records, Existence, and Extremes of Teleios Stage Entities flow into your Dominium.]
The Records of Four Imperium Knights began to flow into Noah's mind.
Their memories.
High level knowledge of the Imperium!
Knowledge of the Legions and of much more!
Noah absorbed all of it as the majority of the golden rivers of Loot light were directed towards his Forge, and from it...the manifestation of Ruination acted like a gateway into the Forge.
The golden light had to pass through her visage.
With a gaze filled with determination, she acted like a beacon and conduit everything had to pass through, the rivers of golden light smashing into her with fervor.
And she flowed with brilliance.
And an instant later, rivers of golden light emanated from her and into the Forge as their quantity and quality...were much greater than before.
And the moment they entered his Forge, the rivers of light flowed towards the many Infinity symbols stretched out across the forge, their light being absorbed into them as in the next moment...
[100 Quintessential Fruits of Existence have been generated!]
[200 Quintessential Fruits of Existence have been generated!]
Noah began to use the very lifeblood of Teleios Stage Entities to forge Fruits of Existence at a rate even Archons would feel jealousy over.
[The Weavings of the Existential Authority of Royalty have increased to the extent that this authority can be taken to the Existential level at any time.]
[The Weavings of the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium are being grasped!]
WAA!
A dazzling royal golden purple glow of weavings entered Noah as the Four Imperium Knights affected by his Marker began to undertake their own shocking actions.
An Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority.
An Authority Exclusively belonging to the Imperium!

Noah didn't feel any sense of this from his Automaton who was absorbing the Authority of Royalty from the Imperium Royal Decimara far from here, but his absorption of the Dominiums of the Teleios Stage Knights of the Imperium granted it!
And it was something that Noah saw first hand in the next moment.
His vision was pulled over towards the center of the battlefield.

Towards Knight Palmino whose hand ripped the skin on his forehead that had the devilish smile that seemed to be laughing at him and the eyes that allowed the authority of his Dominium to leak senselessly.
Such an action caused the weavings of his existence to explode with such unfathomable anger that his golden eyes themselves distorted, an air of a neon light instantly erupting around him!
It stemmed from his very Blood.
It stemmed from who he was.
His intent roared out as a blinding neon light rose all around.
|Daring to blaspheme the Glory of the Imperium!|
HUUM!
The Neon light became so potent that above Knight Palmino, an idol with his likeness formed as its gaze was filled with unfathomable glory.
Blazing with neon light.
An expression as if a form of glory that shouldn't have been challenged was shown as wondrously...even the flow of the weavings of the surrounding Omniverse began to support its brilliance!
Such a scene even gave the visage of the Sanctus Princess Emilliana a sharp pause.
And this idol of Knight Palmino brought its hands together as it uttered out the identity of the single obscene Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority.
|IMPERIUM.|
WAA!
A blinding beam of neon light erupted from its clasped hand and bathed Knight Palmino's figure.
The carving of devilish smile and eyes on his forehead began to burn as if they were never there!
And the idol of Knight Palmino was not done as its blazing eyes turned towards the expanse of utter darkness across the Omniverse.
They turned towards Noah's direction- empowered by the very weavings of the surrounding Omniverse as if the Imperium was cradled by it!
A neon light illuminated everything towards this direction.
And the voice of Knight Palmino thundered out.
|The one daring to question the Glory of the Imperium is there!|
His voice was the command.
And the 6 Imperium Knights converged towards Noah's direction!

The one who was already coming towards his direction and was even branded with his Loot Marker still leaking his Dominium glared out with waves of Wrath as his will spread out to discover any sources of existence here!
At this point in time, Noah could very well retreat as there were a great deal of uncertainties.
The enemies were also extremely powerful ones as he was coming to understand from their weavings and memories!
But he...also liked the challenge and the possible rewards that could come from this as...
[The weavings of Quintessence begin sounding the drums of an unstoppable rise.]
His figure disappeared.
Memories and weavings of Knight Palmino were still fresh in his mind as...
[The Weavings of Plot state that you were always Knight Palmino.]
His body changed.
His Dominium emanated a unique new signature.
His Extremity Passages had seethed with Manadynamics as his Dominium felt refilled to enact multiple more Dominium Rules- the Shrouding of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed returning to him!
And in the next moment, beside the figure of the Imperium Knight near him who was branded with his Loot Marker...
SAA!
A visage of Knight Palmino appeared.
In the heat of the battle, the Imperium Knight only affirmed the visage and existential signature of the Knight Commander he always knew before he continued to direct his authority to find the Enemy!
He didn't know.
Oh, he didn't know!

chapters.title: Chapter 2993 Glory! V
paragraphs: 2993 Glory! V

The Battlefield was a chaotic one as the moment the intent of Knight Palmino spread out was also the time that Noah's visage adorning the looks of Knight Palmino arrived beside the other Imperium Knight!
His Dominium was already facing a leakage as a devilish smile cackled and smiled on his forehead which his very existence leaked out.
He was not in his prime state.
He didn't catch the small minute things that may have given it away!
So the moment he turned his attention forward to continue seeking the enemy that had actually dared to brand him and begin stealing his very own authority...
SAA!
Like a silent snake, a dazzling spear appeared behind him.
A spear carrying the weight of Noah's Dominiums.
A spear carrying multiple Dominium Rules of his extremes.
A spear carrying the very weight and glory of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

It wasn't an attack that was spreading out across 15 different existences this time around as the weight and glory of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was focused on this Imperium Knight in front of Noah alone.
The body of this Imperium Knight had multiple parts lit up brightly under the gaze of the Existential Analytical Looter, the brightest of all beings the his gloriously golden shining head.
And the back of this head was where Noah struck in an utterly obscene and devilish manner!
BOOOM!
Like the heavy thunk of two Singularities colliding.
Akin to an unstoppable force meeting an immovable object!
The glory of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed pressed down.

And the Dominium of its target shuddered as facing ahead, his eyes could only open in unimaginable shock that very quickly transformed into wrath as this being...felt a part of his Dominium actually shatter and crack!
|OOOH!|
He bellowed out and became covered with a blinding light that warped him a distance away, but the deed was done.

Where he used to be, a spear filled with golden blood and thick brain matter could be seen as when the Imperium Knight appeared again, one could see the back of his head blown out as if it were a watermelon, his visage twitching uncontrollably as he stared with a mix of shock and incredulity ahead.
He saw the culprit.
He then saw the visage of Imperium Knight Palmino who had the same likeness as the culprit as everything clicked, but before anything else could be done, this enemy disappeared one more!
And a heavy injury was actually left behind on the body of a Teleios Stage Entity.
Knight Akalusia and Sanctus Princess Emilliana also saw the brief glimpse of this new enemy as their eyes flashed with a profound brilliance!
But Noah was gone just as quickly as he showed himself.
And the reason for this was only visible before his eyes.
[A critical attack has occurred on the target as the percentage of the Existential Analytical Looter has reached 25% for the Imperium Knight, Augustus!]
[The Existential Illusory Weaving V1 of Augustus is now coming to fruition.]
The power, rules, and restrictions of those at the Existential Dominium Realm were different as at his current stage, Noah couldn't just repeat the ease that he initially had with the Mimeisthai.
He had to reach a set percentage of Analysis before he conjured up an Existential Illusory Weaving V1!

So he very quickly made an exit towards the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, reappearing within the bounds of incandescent brilliance where his throne and the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed stood.

His expression was grand, and yet his Dominiums creaked from the pressure of the Existential Omniversal Shrouding as once more, he felt like he squeezed everything out of his body to critically injure an existence two stages above where he currently stood!
In front of him, the visage of the Illusory Weaving V1 was forming with a golden light as this was the grandest accomplishment yet.
[25% of All Damage dealt to the Existential Illusory Weaving V1- Knight Augustus will be passed through to the main body of Knight Augustus.]
Yes.
The Culmination of his achievements after risking being in the same space as the Monsters at the Teleios Stage of Existential Dominium!
Noah stretched his weary Dominiums as he spoke out commandingly.
[Let's make another jump to a different location...and go all out in pressing your glory onto this Illusory Weaving.]
WAA!
The first part of his command was understandable.
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed had warped once before, and it could warp again!
The second part of his command...was a terrifying one!
Noah himself could utilize Existential Omniversal Shrouding to express the power of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed where he was.
He was merely a conduit as to wield it came at a heavy cost.
But the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was a construct that could also be utilized as a weapon in itself, where in the past, Noah had even used to throw it at his enemies!

After a certain incident where something unfortunate occurred and he had to dip into the reversal of the time space continuum to get back to an earlier time, he committed to not using this construct in such a manner as he remained true to it now.
But the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed could express its own offensive features as it so chose.
And if Noah brought a powerful enemy into its bounds...the glory and weight he was only acting as a conduit of before could be pressed down on such an enemy freely!

And what better enemy was there than one who couldn't even attack them? What better enemy than an Existential Illusory Weaving of their true target whom they could damage freely while a portion of this damage passed through?!
HUUM!
The answer was a glorious reality.

Incandescent mountainous passages churning with Manadynamics seethed across the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as with a glimmer of silent brilliance, it warped to another location across the Omniverse.
And at the same time...the heavy weight of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed became focused on an Existential Illusory Weaving of an Imperium Knight Noah had already injured!

chapters.title: Chapter 2994 Glory! VI
paragraphs: 2994 Glory! VI
In the surroundings of Knight Augustus.
One Imperium Knight after another arrived to support and defend him, four of such entities appearing around him protectively!
Each was adorned in shining Existential Armaments as they were a sign of grace and honor, and yet at this moment...
The sight of half the head of a Teleios Stage Knights being split open was a heavy one as they couldn't allow this cowardish enemy that came and went to continue his attacks!

In the distance, Knight Palmino had a burning gaze as even though he had scorched the devilish smile and eyes from his forehead, he could feel wisps of it trying to form once more as including Knight Augustus, there were two other Imperium Knights whose existence was leaking out continuously.
With an interminable gaze, he looked at Knight Akalusia and the 5 other Imperium Knights supporting her as his intent weaved out.
|You got the blasphemous Sanctus filth? I will track down her compatriot.|
His Dominiums buzzed as he already made a decision on the weaving of things.
Without even looking back and focusing on the fused Dragon Knight and Sanctus Princess emanating immense waves of Dignity and Honor, Knight Akalusia replied with a stern gaze.
|They are not compatriots. That unidentified entity may just be the Noah Osmont we're looking for.|
WAA!
Terrific words rang out with her intent as the pupils of Knight Palmino dilated.
Even the figures of the Sanctus Princess and her mount raged with might at such a possibility as in the distance, the figure of Knight Palmino wanted to scoff in incredulity!
Noah Osmont? The Seed involved in the disappearance of the Existential Domain?
She wanted to say that he could be the unidentified entity that could attack all 15 of them at once and even heavily injure a Teleios Stage Imperium Knight?!
Such a thing was preposterous!
Such a thing...
Knight Palmino gritted his teeth until the enamel within them began to break.
The eyes of Knight Akalusia were clear and free of any falsehoods as when gazing at them, Knight Palmino could only see a reflection of himself.
So he ground his teeth further while flashing away in the direction of Knight Augustus.
Could a fucking Seed actually be capable of this?
Could-
BOOM!

His already dilated pupils expanded ever further as just at the time he arrived near the protective encirclement around Knight Augustus, the back half of his head that was just trying to heal caved in once again as his expression greatly shifted!
The Imperium Knights around him exploded with existential authority as even Knight Palmino radiated the Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium towards Knight Augustus.
And yet...
CRUNCH!
His head's skeletal structure continued to be deformed along with his Dominium as if there was a constantly applied destructive force that wouldn't let up until everything about him was broken!
And whatever the source of the damage was...even the encirclement of 5 Imperium Knights could not stop it!
The Dominium of Imperium Knight Augustus buzzed as waves of Existential light rose from him, but the force pressing down was relentless.
Around him, multiple layers of glorious protective layers of royal purple light had risen from the Knights around him, and yet they did nothing to prevent the pressure coming from all around!
The gazes of the Knights turned extremely somber as Knight Palmino came behind the trembling visage of Augustus and placed his hands on his back, his intent booming out.
|Support your fellow Knight. No Knight of the Imperium shall be pushed even close to peril when other Knights are present.|
From his connected hand, immense life force began to flow from his Dominium and into Knight Augustus.

Seeing his deteriorating state, the other Knights also came beside him with their hands outstretched, their Dominiums also radiating an immense force of existence that went on to support Knight Augustus!
At the same time,Knight Palmino actually called out towards the distance.
|Knight Commander Akalusia!|
He...actually lay down his pride and called out towards the only one here holding a vibrant Codex of Extremity!

While a shocking show of support occurred in a certain space, Noah's Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was warped somewhere else entirely while the weight of this construct continued to press down on the Illusory Weaving V1 of Augustus.
The results from this were wondrous all around.
[An ever grander quantity of Loot is coming in from the targets with a successful Loot Marker!]
[The Dominium of one particular cannon fodder is being devoured with Quintessential speed.]
[The very weavings of Imperium Knight Augustus flow into your being.]
[An influx of Existential Authority from different Dominiums is flowing into your marked target to stabilize their Dominium, causing an even grander absorption of authority to take place.]
[2000 Quintessential Fruits of Existence have been generated!]
[5000 Quintessential Fruits of Existence have been generated!]
A scene of glory.

Shining with multiple colors, thousands of Fruits of Existence formed inside Noah's forge as immeasurable Loot light passed through Ruination and became amplified, and it was then turned into grander forms of Loot that when Noah looked at the vast numbers forming...
|Is it not enough to take me to the Peak of the Primordium Stage? Will the death of a Teleios Stage Imperium Knight be enough to move all my Dominiums?|
He didn't follow the same path as others.
While others focused on a single Dominium and rose that to an extreme, he was bringing his Body, Origin, and Soul together as one!
He was challenging a longstanding rule that quite literally stated what he was doing was pointless and useless.
But the sheer number of resources he was collecting were enough to propagate a shocking change!

And in all of this wonder...would be truly be successful in killing a Teleios Stage expert while using the power of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed? Could he actually gain a silent assassin at the Teleios Stage at this moment in time?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2995 Existential Destroyers! I
paragraphs: His path was always a quick one.
He achieved in an extremely short period of time what took others millions of years!

The secret to this was nothing grand- with him simply devouring the years worth of work others already did, amplifying it further in quantity and quality, and then devouring all of this and assimilating it into himself.
What he was doing now with a terrific entity at the Teleios Stage of Existential Dominium Realm was exactly this as after putting in the work and amassing thousands of Fruits of Existence...
|Hoo...take it all in.|
He sat back on his grand multicolored throne after leaving it for barely just a few seconds.
And yet he looked like an Emperor who was returning from a grand venture and deserved his much needed rest!
The moment his intent weaved out, his Body, Origin, and Soul moved.
{Your Dominiums face a Quintessential amount of nourishment as they begin fully traversing your Primordium Stage of Existential Dominium Realm.}
His body began to blaze with golden flames.
His Origin pulsed with its Aletheian Havens, his Extremity Veil vibrating as his Soul...annealed ever further.

His Dominiums began to progress and expand as if they were ancient engines, with his intent being to see just how far he would go as while he was in the midst of this, prompts of continued and increased attainment of more fruits of Existence from the Imperium Knight Augustus came!
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed applied its shocking weight on the Existential Illusory Weaving V1 of Augustus, and he remained strong even now.
At such a time...
|Hmm?|
Noah raised his brows as he felt the tingling of weavings.
And it was actually the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed that released its intent towards him.

|I am receiving the weavings of a message from one of the Teleios Stage Entities we targeted. They seemed to have backtracked the source of the attack on them and intricately sent out an intent across it- fishing for the most part. Shall I receive and convey it?|
The Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed turned towards Noah on his high throne and asked.
Noah tilted his head while tapping his throne as he felt the expansion of his Dominium and replied.
|Any possible dangers from doing this?|
|No, Master. I have even forged a thousand proxies of myself so far across different points of the Omniverse- and I can receive her intent on any of these proxies for extra measures.|
WAA!
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed showed its wonders and what some may call paranoia as it had already been laying doing many points of countermeasures!
After listening to it, Noah waved his hands to produce a small portion of his will.
|Take my will to the proxy you will receive this intent within. The weavings of Existence show yet another possible favorable pathway there...|
Weavings of a possibility.
It could be something, it could be nothing.
But there was no harm in following up on it!
A glimmer of brilliance flashed as Noah's will entirely disappeared, traversing across weavings of Existence and Non-existence until it appeared in a field of incandescent green.
A vibrant miniature Aletheian Haven of Prana spread out all around, carrying a trace of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
Noah's will manifested within such a space as the intent of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed spread out.
|I'm allowing the transmission of the weaving now.|
Her voice became faint at the end as in the next moment, an intent filled with Honor and Dignity came through.
It formed into the visage of a gorgeous woman with verdant hair, her green eyes filled with hues of gold and even a hint of purple as she gazed around her before coming to lock onto Noah's figure.
|An arrow wasn't the welcome I expected to receive when I set off looking for a hunch.|
Her voice was calm as it echoed out, Noah listening to it while being even calmer as he waved his hands to conjure a green throne which he sat on while continuing to gaze at her calmly.
As if to tell her to state her business!
The formed weaving read the atmosphere of the surrounding reality while developing a sense of the personality of the entity before her as her intent continued.

|Not too long ago, the name Noah Osmont arose from the mouths of the Imperium as the culprit for the decimation of an entire Existential Domain. Of course, any words said by a member of the Imperium have a 90% chance of being a lie or a distorted version of truth. I followed a hunch to ascertain this truth as the Knight I sent off to attain information from the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius tell me one thing, and your current actions against the Imperium Knights tell me another. But putting all weavings together creates an impossible story for the one known as Noah Osmont.|
As she spoke, she waved her own hands- her authority weaving to fork a draconic scaled throne that he sat on while a green dress adorned her manifestation.

|The one known as Noah Osmont was apparently just a weak Seed, and yet the perspectives of the Basileus of Al-Abalem and Ignatius is that this weak Seed was the one that destroyed an Existential Domain. And that same weak Seed...has just released an attack I find interesting, and gone even further to critically injure an Imperium Knight, not fitting the story of an Existential Destroyer. Putting it all together paints a story that makes me wish to complete my duty as a Sanctus Princess...to have located a talent capable of standing against the Imperium- the Existential Destroyers, and to point them towards the Sanctus Populi.}
Her purpose was made clear after a number of words.
Her beauty was enough to recruit millions of men, but Noah paid no heed to it as he continued to gaze at her calmly!
And the visage of the Sanctus Princess Emilliana was even more unfettered at this moment as she continued!

|How much do you know about the Imperium? About the Existential Destroyers? About the ones who incarcerated an entire Omniversal Lineage and their branches to become Seeds in endless cycles within Domains where the only thing that mattered was profits?|
WAA!

And that same weak Seed...has just released an attack I find interesting, and gone even further to critically injure an Imperium Knight, not fitting the story of an Existential Destroyer.

Putting it all together paints a story that makes me wish to complete my duty as a Sanctus Princess...to have located a talent capable of standing against the Imperium- the Existential Destroyers, and to point them towards the Sanctus Populi.}
Her purpose was made clear after a number of words.
Her beauty was enough to recruit millions of men, but Noah paid no heed to it as he continued to gaze at her calmly!
And the visage of the Sanctus Princess Emilliana was even more unfettered at this moment as she continued!
|How much do you know about the Imperium?
About the Existential Destroyers?
About the ones who incarcerated an entire Omniversal Lineage and their branches to become Seeds in endless cycles within Domains where the only thing that mattered was profits?|
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 2996 Existential Destroyers! II
paragraphs: The words the Manifestation of an entity uttered out in front of Noah were heavy ones that may make any layman shocked!
The Imperium held another name on their banner- but it was not one they took on themselves.
Existential Destroyers.
The destroyers of existence itself.
Entities who incarcerated an entire Omniversal Lineage and every possible branch that was a part of such a lineage to be Seeds inside Existential Domains!

|If you are truly what they term a Seed from one of these Existential Domains, then somewhere in your blood...there may lie trace amounts of an Omniversal Lineage long forgotten through time. The distinction of a Seed is demeaning to your existence- and the existences of countless others. You are no Seed, nor am I some filth that should merely be something to be butchered under the swords of the Imperium.|
HUUM!
As she spoke, the adornments around her became more and more pristine, waves of verdant golden light wrapping around her figure as she seemed an entity who held honor and dignity deep in her bones!
An entity steeped in royalty!

She actually told Noah that he may have a trace of an Omniversal Lineage inside him- with his blood running the possibility of being descended down from eons upon eons...or he may also be entirely disconnected and simply stemmed from a natal lineage within his natural Existential Domain.
At such words, Noah couldn't help but smile.
And the distinguished visage of a royalty continued.

|I am Emilliana- one distinguished as a Sanctus Princess from the Sanctus Populi. A Bastion for the people. A Bastion for all of those who cannot defend themselves. You may already know much of what I speak of, or you may not know in a limited fashion. I know not the extent and truth behind what happened to the recently destroyed Existential Domain, nor do I know much about you. But for being capable enough and even more crucial- brave enough to strike against the Imperium in the way you are doing now, I have to do my duty as a Sanctum Princess and offer you the grace of protection. You are aware of what they will do regarding you now?|
Her words ended with a question.
An important one as she was insinuating the gravity of the situation Noah found himself in by being brave enough to actually target and attack Knights of the Imperium!
Injuring a Knight alone was enough to condemn one to death and destruction with surety.

Having the Dominium Blood of a knight on One's hands? Actually killing an Imperium Knight or important members of the Imperium within their Royals, Enclaves, or Legacies? There was nowhere one could hide in the Omniverse to escape their pursuit after such actions.

|Nowhere under the light and darkness of the Omniverse will provide a shield or shade for you. Sometimes, it will even feel like the Omniverse itself is against you. As if it favors and bends under the will of the Imperium. That is how much authority they have gained over the eons due to their cruel actions, to the extent that under the banner even Omniversal Authorities become their tools.|
WAA!
She uttered words that minutes ago may have caused Noah to have a genuine surprise.
Before he attained years' worth of memories and weavings of the Knights of the Imperium.
Before he began draining the existence of Knight Augustus and the lifeblood of those choosing to support him at this moment.
Omniversal Authorities.
The inkling he had seen from the one holding a complete Codex of Extremity- Knight Akalusia!
The one who made moves to the extent that it seemed even the surroundings of the Omniverse themselves were inflating and enhancing her will and existential authority!
The memories of Knight Augustus flowed into his mind as they carried weavings of information relating to this.
And Sanctus Princess Emilliana spoke of such matters while extending her hand towards Noah.

|I know not your circumstances, but I can always carry out my duties as a Sanctus Princess and offer you a shade amidst all of this. Any power we have that stands against the Imperium, all the closer we come to liberating all those that have been oppressed over the eons. The Sanctus Populi is able to obscure the gaze of the Imperium and take you under our banner- to protect you from the persecution and death before it fully comes raining down. But...I seem to have spoken a great deal here. What say you, Noah Osmont?|
The Sanctus Princess finished her monologues and gazed towards Noah for a reply.
She offered shade from a threat that was about to get immeasurably worse.
A threat one couldn't so easily escape across the Omniverse!
And yet towards such a reality, Noah only smiled as he was about to weave his intent.
He...was about to.
HUUM!

His manifested Will in this space buzzed in the next instant though, a heavy air of ancientness suddenly emanating from him that caused the weaving of the Manifestation of Sanctus Princess Emilliana to be bewildered before her eyes opened in shock!

Noah only captured a glimpse of this as he was focusing on himself- moreso on his main body that after beginning the devouring and assimilation of thousands of Fruits of Existence coming from the lifeblood of Teleios Stage Knights of the Imperium....
{Your Existential Dominium Soul, Existential Dominium Body, and Existential Dominium Origin have attained enough substance to truly embark on the theorized pathway of your Realm.}
Such a prompt came as his Main Body in the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed became surrounded by a refulgence of brilliance.
And many, many more prompts followed.
{Your three Dominiums resonate and attain an existential convergence that gives way to the Existential Primordium Dominium Core!}
{A culmination of your achievements.}
{A culmination of your existence!}
Inside Noah's existence- his Origin, Body, and Soul became superimposed as they enacted Noah's Primordium Dominium Core.
In the center of his existence.
Between all of his three Dominiums!

chapters.title: Chapter 2997 Primordium! I
paragraphs: The essence was so palpating that Noah's figure rose from his resplendent throne- tendrils of existential authority following his rise and flowing into him as his arms and legs spread out.
HUUM!

Tremendous waves of existential authority converged around him as a circular Singularity formed with essence coursing in from all directions, everything directed towards a point that was Noah's absolute center!
This was the location of the Existential Primordium Dominium Core!

The very extreme of his Body converged towards it, along with the extreme of his Soul and Origin. It seemed like three sharp points converging towards the very center of himself, and the circular Singularity surrounding him showed a wondrous manifestation of three equal triangles coming together.
All of it accumulated together into a dazzling core.
It shone with a dazzling milky white luster.
It was the Existential Primordium Dominium Core!
{An Unfathomable Achievement!}
{Your Dominiums have formed a type of Omniversal Singularity at the very core!}

{The Existential Primordium Dominium Core is a pathway not yet entirely understood with your current weavings and the weavings of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, but it currently seems like a starting point for the grander Omniverse.}
It was something Noah was stumbling onto that was so fantastic that his weavings did not fully understand it- nor did the weavings of even the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
But how did it truly come about? What factors contributed to its fruition? His choice of elevating all three Dominiums since the very beginning? Other people in the past eons may have done so too!
The Quintessential Fruits of Existence? His Foundation? Or something else entirely?
The answer did not rise yet as at this moment, weavings of what this buzzing Omniversal Singularity began flowing into Noah's mind.

{The Existential Primordium Dominium Core will absorb all incoming Existential resources and distribute them across your three Dominiums- elevating them to the same extent as if they were a single collective Dominium.}

{The cost of elevating the Existential Primordium Dominium Core is still much higher than other Dominiums of the Soul, Origin, and Body, with your stage of Primordium being tremendously different from the Neonate Stage of Existential Dominium Realm.}
The wonders of this unique Omniversal Singularity continued to flow within Noah's mind as both he and the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed had to unveil the weavings of its mystery.
While this occurred, a unique aura was released from Noah that even his sectioned wills and clones expressed!
An aura that in a proxy Haven stretched out somewhere in the Omniverse, a part of his will that was meeting with the intent of a certain Sanctus Princess also emanated.
And at that moment, her gaze had changed.
She was stern and earnest before as even with her high position as a Sanctus Princess, she didn't consider herself of insurmountable importance compared to others.
She didn't show a hint of arrogance towards Noah.
She spoke to him as an equal regardless of their positions!
But she still has her power. She still had her backing.
Even if she was trained not to be arrogant towards others and to practice a sense of humility, there was still a certain sense of royalty and wonder entrenched deep in her bones.
Yet at this moment, within the depths of her soul, she found this royalty being shaken by the aura that Noah radiated!
This...wasn't this an aura that the Elder Queens of the Sanctus Populi emanated? A sense of awe and power of those getting intimately close to the Omniverse itself?!
How was...?!
Her eyes found themselves vibrating as her words leaked out.
|You...| And yet before she could even finish, the unique aura Noah emanated was retracted and faded away a moment later as if it never existed.
He looked at her and released a devilish smile as he nodded.
|Sorry about that. We were talking about the shadow that can be provided by the Sanctus Populi...although the thought is a nice one, I do not think I will need it.}
HUUM!
Boundless tyranny rose with his very being as he spoke such words.

Anyone hearing them would have to bend down and understand that he was saying the wonders of the Imperium- the might that countless others feared and could not even escape...he was stating that he wasn't among those who were fearful.
He wasn't among those who would worry and tremble over the swords of the Imperium!
His words shook Sanctus Princess Emilliana from her trance as she refocused.
She wanted to ignore the aura she just felt, she wanted to alter the words she wanted to say, she wanted to even address it further!
But seeing his dismissive demeanor, she swallowed most of her words and proceeded carefully.

|I won't call you foolish, nor will I question how you can confidently say such things, but what say you regarding the aid and knowledge of the Sanctus Populi? You will have to undergo a process of verification, but the means and power of the Sanctus Populi are for the people. For the good of the people. Salus Populi Suprema Lex Esto!|
WAA!
The good of the people was the supreme law!
The Sanctus Princess Emilliana uttered this as Noah squinted his eyes and nodded.
|While I may not necessarily need protection, there is no harm in the power of numbers and expanding my horizons.|
His words were simple!
But what they would come to mean...what they would come to signify for this Omniverse...nobody had yet even fathomed!
And as such words were stated, far away from this proxy of a Haven, there was still the ongoing battle between the Red Legion of the Imperium and the main body of Emilliana and her Dragon Knight.

Facing her, the eyes of Knight Akalusia suddenly shifted and became somber as even though she had the upper hand, the situation of Knight Augustus in the distance and the intent of the enemy before her caused her heart to feel a great sense of unease!
What had just happened?

chapters.title: Chapter 2998 Primordium! II
paragraphs: The flow of the battle held a certain direction.
Knight Akalusia could read this flow very well, and knew that when it began to change, it was never a positive sign!
Especially so when she was tapping into an Omniversal Authority to achieve what she wanted, and yet no progress was made.

Very few people of their stage understood Omniversal Authority, but those who were especially in tune and knowledgeable would know that if you have a battle starting and you were the only within it who was influencing Omniversal Authority in some way and yet you were still losing...then this wasn't a battle that you were intent on winning.

If even you being the only one tapping into its influence and still, the flow of the battle wasn't yours, then this was the universe telling you that in this particular case, you were going against the flow of the Omniverse, and whatever authority required to change this flow would either come at an unfathomable cost, or it would be entirely impossible to achieve.
This...was a unique knowledge on Omniversal Authority!

In all battles she commanded this Imperium Legions in, they could always readily influence and tip the scales of the flow of the Omniverse to their favor and finish them in the victory of the Imperium.
As a holder of the Codex of Extremity within this Legion, she knew.

Thus, she also had to be the one to make heavy and decisive choices when she understood the very flow of the Omniverse was currently against their actions and they did not have sufficient authority to change it!
She didn't have to grasp the intricate changes of it or understand what exactly made this Sanctus Princess special, but she had to make the choice!
HUUM!
The Codex in her hand shone and released millions of rays of white and purple rays of light that looked like a rain of existential light that covered everything.
At the same time, she released an undeniable and commanding intent towards all Imperium Knights under her.
|Disengage in the battle and retreat at once. Take care of the injured and regroup, and the mission parameters will be reassessed after we report.|
A heavy set of words.
A decision other leaders would rarely have the guts to make!

Yet she made it right away as in the far distance, Knight Palmino who had his hands supporting Knight Augustus who continued to have his Dominium oppressed and crushed down had his gaze change greatly.

The Imperium Knights around him were the same as wondrously, when Knight Palmino would have otherwise argued or questioned the choice of Knight Akalusia...he simply hardened his gaze this time while sending out a command of affirmation!
|Lets go! Under our watch, none of us will ever come close to experiencing a Dominium death!|
His life force and weavings bubbled endlessly as they flowed into Knight Augustus, he and the other Knights retreating in a formation while still providing him support.

On the other side of the battle, the five knights supporting Knight Akalusia against the Sanctus Princess also flashed into a glimmer of brilliance and disappeared, and the waves of white and purple covering everything obscured their weavings greatly!

At a certain point, the Sanctus Princess fused with the Dragon Knight seemed to have sensed something as her hands wielding palpable Dignity and Honor came down, her eyes weaving across existence to lock on the disappearing visage of Knight Akalusia as within them...she could see calculation and immense intent.
An intent that said she truly wasn't done with all of this and all of them!

But after the surge of purple white brilliance began to fade...so did all waves of existential light as when Sanctus Princess Emilliana gazed ahead of her...the members of the Imperium Legion were nowhere to be seen.
Her gaze was calm as it had always been.
The Sanctus Maximum had already told her when her time of death would be, and it was not here. So Emilliana was never worried since this battle began.
But still, for it to end this way...she was once again shown the decisiveness of Imperium Legions and what made them so deadly.
They could come and go rapidly as after they pulled back and reassessed, they would send a terrifying enough force to accomplish their prior mission!
|A stellar display if there ever was one, Sanctus Princess.| The intent of the Dragon Knight below her came out as their fusion came to an end, but the gaze of Emilliana was difficult to read.
Her verdant tendrils of hair flowed on her fair skin once more as her gaze became sharper while looking ahead.

|Maybe so...maybe so. Let us change our course. We shall be heading back to base and taking with us a guest and possible Knight to join our Sanctus Populi. Send a message to the other Knights to retreat, and I shall alert our Sanctus Elder Queen Mother.|
|Oh? Who has the honor of being escorted by Sanctus Princess Emilliana?|
Honor.
During their fusion, their intents were one, but the Sanctus Princess was always in control as the Dragon Knight did not know everything!

The gaze on Emilliana was difficult as she replied about the Entity joining them towards their base, an entity she was trying to fully understand- especially after his eruption of an aura that she had only sensed on Elder Queens.
|The one joining us is...Noah Osmont.|
WAA!
A name that had been uttered a few times today.
Yet every time it was uttered, the circumstances so greatly changed to the extent one would wonder that when it was mentioned next...just how different would the weavings of existence be?!

The answer was entirely unknown as back in his own Domain, Thousands of Fruits of Existence swirled around Noah's main body as they were shredded into pure multicolored light that surged into the Primordium Core at the center of his body, his three Dominiums shuddering with brilliance and becoming even more intense as many sets of prompts continued before him.
Of particular importance...related to a certain Knight facing the weight of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed constantly.
{The analysis of Knight Augustus has reached 80%}
{The percentage of damage passed to the main body of this marked target has Quintessentially increased.}
{Enough of his weavings have been devoured to grant the collapse of a Dominium, and yet the weavings of other Entities are supporting him!}
{The Weavings of those stabilizing the Dominium of Knight Augustus begin flowing into you!}

|Lets go!
Under our watch, none of us will ever come close to experiencing a Dominium death!|
His life force and weavings bubbled endlessly as they flowed into Knight Augustus, he and the other Knights retreating in a formation while still providing him support.

On the other side of the battle, the five knights supporting Knight Akalusia against the Sanctus Princess also flashed into a glimmer of brilliance and disappeared, and the waves of white and purple covering everything obscured their weavings greatly!

At a certain point, the Sanctus Princess fused with the Dragon Knight seemed to have sensed something as her hands wielding palpable Dignity and Honor came down, her eyes weaving across existence to lock on the disappearing visage of Knight Akalusia as within them...she could see calculation and immense intent.
An intent that said she truly wasn't done with all of this and all of them!

But after the surge of purple white brilliance began to fade...so did all waves of existential light as when Sanctus Princess Emilliana gazed ahead of her...the members of the Imperium Legion were nowhere to be seen.
Her gaze was calm as it had always been.
The Sanctus Maximum had already told her when her time of death would be, and it was not here.
So Emilliana was never worried since this battle began.
But still, for it to end this way...she was once again shown the decisiveness of Imperium Legions and what made them so deadly.
They could come and go rapidly as after they pulled back and reassessed, they would send a terrifying enough force to accomplish their prior mission!
|A stellar display if there ever was one, Sanctus Princess.| The intent of the Dragon Knight below her came out as their fusion came to an end, but the gaze of Emilliana was difficult to read.
Her verdant tendrils of hair flowed on her fair skin once more as her gaze became sharper while looking ahead.
|Maybe so...maybe so.
Let us change our course.
We shall be heading back to base and taking with us a guest and possible Knight to join our Sanctus Populi.
Send a message to the other Knights to retreat, and I shall alert our Sanctus Elder Queen Mother.|
|Oh?
Who has the honor of being escorted by Sanctus Princess Emilliana?|
Honor.
During their fusion, their intents were one, but the Sanctus Princess was always in control as the Dragon Knight did not know everything!

The gaze on Emilliana was difficult as she replied about the Entity joining them towards their base, an entity she was trying to fully understand- especially after his eruption of an aura that she had only sensed on Elder Queens.
|The one joining us is...Noah Osmont.|
WAA!
A name that had been uttered a few times today.
Yet every time it was uttered, the circumstances so greatly changed to the extent one would wonder that when it was mentioned next...just how different would the weavings of existence be?!

The answer was entirely unknown as back in his own Domain, Thousands of Fruits of Existence swirled around Noah's main body as they were shredded into pure multicolored light that surged into the Primordium Core at the center of his body, his three Dominiums shuddering with brilliance and becoming even more intense as many sets of prompts continued before him.
Of particular importance...related to a certain Knight facing the weight of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed constantly.
{The analysis of Knight Augustus has reached 80%}
{The percentage of damage passed to the main body of this marked target has Quintessentially increased.}
{Enough of his weavings have been devoured to grant the collapse of a Dominium, and yet the weavings of other Entities are supporting him!}
{The Weavings of those stabilizing the Dominium of Knight Augustus begin flowing into you!}

chapters.title: Chapter 2999 Primordium! III
paragraphs: It was a wondrous development.

Knight Augustus himself continued to face the onslaught of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as his Dominium maintained a constant state of absorption, and now even those supporting him had their weavings grasped by Noah!
It was a battle of time and power to decide whether in the very near future, Noah would have a Teleios Stage Knight of the Imperium under his banner.
And as his Existential Primordium Dominium Core stabilized, even more Fruits of Existence broke down and turned into streams of essence that were assimilated into it.
Noah was still learning about it.
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was still learning about it.
And more of its weavings revealed themselves as Noah continued to devour the eons worth of work of multiple Imperium Knights.
He found that his Existential Extremity Authorities...were attracted to the Primordium Core uniquely.
Like they could be attached there and utilized in some way!
{A feature of the Primordium Dominium Core has been unveiled.}

{The weavings of specific Existential Extremes can be utilized to have their Dominium Rules preset and saved within the Primordium Core, ready to be unleashed at any time with a delay or usage of authority thereafter.}
The pull his extremes felt was explained as Noah's eyes opened wide.
In life, one had to utilize their authority to pay down their power or alteration of existence.
An Entity at the Existential Dominium Realm could utilize his extremes at extremely high levels by releasing Dominium Rules.
One had to pay a heavy cost to release Dominium Rules- their existential reserves of their Dominiums slowly being utilized over time!
Yet at this moment, the usage of Noah's Primordium Core stated that he could set Dominium Rules inside this core in advance, and release them at any time at no cost.
It was akin to saving already cast skills and having them in reserve, and one was capable of releasing as many as they chose in any manner!
How many Dominium Rules could Noah preset in the Primordium Core? Was there a limit? Could he set tens or hundreds of terrifying Dominium Rules and then release them against an enemy all at once?
The possibilities for what this could be were endless as...
{Let us start with Loot...}
Noah spoke out commandingly as he began to tweak with his newly forged Primordium Core by sending the Weavings of Loot into it and presetting Dominium Rules!

The more he utilized it, the more he would come to understand it as at this moment, the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed looked at his blinding visage and the resplendent milky white light of the Primordium Core around him, her intent weaving of with glory.

|With this Primordium Core, I sense a closeness with the Omniverse far more than before. If this Primordium is considered an Omniversal Singularity, then once it matures and sprouts to the next stage...you may just begin to touch upon weavings of Omniversal Authorities.|
The intent of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed foretold of a glorious future, also going forward to show just how different Noah's realm was compared to others!
The Dominiums of others may not touch upon something as the influence of Omniversal Laws until possibly long after the Teleios Stage.
And yet Noah would very likely be touching up on this just on the first stage of Primordium!
At the center of all authorities, Noah smiled at the words of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as he voiced out his own intent.
|What do you think of this Sanctus Princess Emilliana?|
The entity to entrench Noah into the intricate workings of the Omniverse.
He asked about her as the Manifestation of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed replied...
|She is a good prospect for a Dual Cultivation partner. We have to see the resonance and utilization of the Dominium Realm.|

Noah blinked at the reply of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as this wasn't the intent behind his question, smiling wryly thereafter as the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed felt his true intent and answered again with a straight face!

|The path she provides will entoil us further into a faction within this Omniverse, but it is clear who the enemies are as what is left behind is to understand what purpose all these factions truly have.|
WAA!
Yes.
All factions had their purpose.
Their true purpose they kept to themselves.
The purpose they spoke of to others and preached.
Sometimes, they were one and the same, but more commonly- they always deviated!
|Very well. Let us go observe what lies in store for the Sanctus Populi...|
His body buzzed with a wondrous light as part of himself left...and didn't leave at the same time.
His Dominium Soul parted, and yet he sensed a unique entanglement with his Primordium Core as he felt like every part of himself was still there!
It was yet another boon of the Primordium Core that he had to understand!
The arcs of battle still remained in the surroundings as the visage of Sanctus Princess Emilliana and her Dragon Knight were the only thing that remained.

At this moment in time, her Dragon Knight had transformed into a dazzling young man whose eyes burned with unfathomable valor, a purple robe draping over him as he stood behind Emilliana akin to a protector that would die before even a hair on her was ever touched.

Their two figures didn't remain alone for long as within moments, the weavings of existence flashed and the figure of a devilishly majestic Emperor appeared, his fair skin shining with untold splendor as he was adorned in a sharp white dress shirt and obsidian dress pants- with the Extemity of Quintessence choosing not to adorn an Emperor's Robe or his battle outfit of simple sleek obsidian pants and a bare chest.
It was his Dominium Soul arriving before the Sanctus Princess Emilliana and her Dragon Knight as adorned like a manager of an investment fund, Noah appeared before them with a smile.

His dark hair flowed back wildly as he couldn't suppress the unique air around him, even the Dragon Knight beside Emilliana looking at him with caution as he sensed something he couldn't fully explain!
|Sanctus Princess. Dragon Knight Alder.|
His eyes shone with untold brilliance.
He arrived before the members of the Sanctus Populi as he was about to be led into the Domains of one of the main factions of this Omniverse!

chapters.title: Chapter 3000 Primordium! IV
paragraphs: As his Dominium Soul arrived before the figures stemming from the Sanctus Populi, adorned in a sleek laid back white dress shirt and obsidian pants, Noah was still doing many things in the background as he prepared.
Even as his Primordium Core continued to form and express its wonders, some of Noah's extremes continued to carry out their own weavings!
One of the more prominent ones who was the one to also spearhead the feature of the Hero's Journey and its subsequent Loot Marker- it was the Protagonist.
Around this same time.
Within the Primordium Core of his Dominiums where many Existential Extremity Authorities were already laying down preset Dominium Rules.
An intent roused its head with heavy fervor.
{The Protagonist states that the time to unveil another prophecy has come.}
One of the main movers among Noah's extremes rose once more as gorgeous golden flames began to wrap around his body and spread out all around!
{The Extremity of Cheats gazes towards Loot with a sense of doubt and questions whether the theorized prophecy is balance breaking enough.}
{The Protagonist disdains to even give an answer as it lets results speak for themselves!}
HUUM!
{The Weaver of Extremity and Existence is laying down a new prophecy!}
The surrounding weavings shook.
And of Noah's Dominiums...the Existential Primordium Dominium Core spun with low and immeasurably heavy rotations.
It was all according to plan.
DUM!
A beat began to resound.
DUM!
Heavy and thick, one couldn't escape it across all of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
{The Protagonist begins the flow of an undeniable prophecy.}
{Robbed Honor and glory become commonplace, their process undeniable once in place.
To ends of existence to the beginnings of extremes, a pioneer rises that has never been seen.
Legacies and Enclaves are many in between, but which can stand against an Omniversal engine?
Twist and turn, and turn again, until what is rare becomes all the same.
Weaving of-...}
HUUM!
The prophecy was proceeding smoothly with the voice of the Protagonist echoing out.
It was proceeding smoothly.
But then out of nowhere, Noah's slowly turning Existential Primordium Dominium Core buzzed and radiated a heavy milky white luster.
And Noah's surroundings began to tremble.
And such a trembling spread far and wide, even coming to flow outside of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed itself.

The flow of existence and nonexistence in this space shockingly became affected as an unfathomably heavy aura descended, with the voice of the Protagonist that had been ringing out valiantly doing so once more after the pause...but it was distinctly different!

As if another influence has descended as from the altered flow of the surroundings of existence and nonexistence itself- from the Omniverse itself...the blooming prophecy gained a form of an influence from the very weavings of the surrounding Omniverse.
{Twist and turn, and turn again, all existence and non-existence shall bend all the same.
Twist and turn, and turn again, serfs and kings shall feel the same pain.
Twist and turn, and turn again, till the wheel of existence deviates and shatters from pulsing veins.
Twist and turn, and turn again, till a new Realm resonates with eons reign!}
WOO! WOO! WOO!
The surroundings trembled!
The weavings of the Protagonist were tumultuous!
Its prophecy was altered in the latter half, a repetition of words being used that it did not design!

The influence of the surrounding lands and Omniverse itself seemed to step in and add to this as after its statement, even Noah himself had to sit down and understand what the latter half of the prophecy referred to.

His gaze was somber as within his forming and expanding Primordium Core, the golden essence of the Protagonist temporarily became heavier than any others as it congealed and flowed with heavy immensity.
Twist and turn, and turn again, all existence and non-existence shall bend all the same.
This was the start of the deviated prophecy.
All existence and non-existence shall bend all the same!
Serfs and kings shall feel the same pain! Till the wheel of existence deviates and shatters from pulsing veins! Till a new Realm resonates with eons reign!

They were a set of heavy words that Noah treated in his mind over and over again, but they didn't give away any true meanings as the words that the Protagonist had prepared and designed itself in the first half of the prophecy...their wonders were already beginning to show.
What the Protagonist stated was not just a premonition of what the future would be.
It was a usage of its authority to push for that future, to apply a corrective Existential Extremity Authority to make that future a reality by all means.

And so since its conception, its authority became even heavier as this Prophecy dealt with weavings of the Omniverse itself, and the Primordium Core that was an Omniversal Singularity made it so that even the influence of the Omniverse was applied to this prophecy!
{Robbed Honor and glory become commonplace, their process undeniable once in place.}
The first part of the prophecy.
Simple in nature and not at all complex to grasp.

The heavy toiling and turning of the Primordium Core at the center of Noah's existence pulsed and radiated out a terrifying pressure to apply the corrective Existential authority to ensure the flow of this line of the prophecy!
Far away from Noah.
Across the Omniverse, on a crimson and blue ruler, a certain Legion retreated as 11 were surrounding a single visage of an Imperium Knight whose expression was becoming worse and worse.
|Augustus, hang in there...we will arrive in Cappadocia soon and obtain help.|
Besides the handsome yet heavily injured figure of Imperium Knight Augustus, a female Imperium Knight looked at him with concern and care.

Her silver gold hair and eyes were reddened with anger and a small sense of fear as they hadn't recently come across a heavy attack like this, the devilish face and smile branded on the forehead of Augustus and two others seeming very menacing at this moment!
Facing the weight of something he couldn't even understand, Augustus looked at the companion showing the most care as he was about to muster up a slight smile to let her feel at ease when...
....CRACK!
Augustus' forehead split open and caved in.
A heavy and unstoppable process fully began.
Robbed Honor and glory become commonplace, their process undeniable once in place...
