chapters.title: Chapter 3001 Merely the Teleios Stage! I
paragraphs: Sewing the blooming scene, the silver gold haired Imperium Knight became dazed as she saw the engulfing crack spread across the forehead of Augustus and cave downwards, his life force and the life force she and others released being devoured at a shocking pace and disappearing towards oblivion!
In Imperium Legions, most of the time was spent training and on missions as a lot of the time, complex weavings form between the Knights within these Legions.
Emotional entanglements. Eons of history and rapport.
To some, the existence of the other being becomes critical to their mental support.
The beautiful visage of the silver gold haired female Knight held a relationship close to this with Augustus as seeing his handsome face becoming caved in under pressure while his Dominium Soul...
CRACK!
|Ah!|
She released a wailing bellow as she saw his Dominium Soul crack.
Even as multicolored Tendrils of life force flowed from the Dominiums of her, Knight Palmino, Knight Akalusia, and many others...they couldn't stabilize and patch up Augustus any longer!
He had been analyzed too greatly.
The damage he could receive was that much more compared to before as his Dominium could not hold it!
And with the advent of a single line of a new prophecy...
|No! No Imperium Knight shall fall! Hold!|
The gaze of Knight Palmino was utterly furious as his body erupted with the wondrous glow of the Imperium, his eyes maddened as the hands of Knight Akalusia came to move him back!
She then went forward with the dazzling Codex of Extremity in her hands as she sought to even summon the influence of the Omniverse around them.
But before this could fully unfold...
BOOM!

The cracked Dominium became interminably unstable as instead of accepting the life force of the Imperium Knights around it, it began releasing a gluttonous devouring force that tried to ensnare itself on all those around Augustus!
It even pulled towards the weavings of the Codex of Extremity in the hands of Akalusia.

Seeing such a scene, Akalusia gritted her teeth and closed the dazzling book in her hands, a heavy repulsive authority being released from her that shook away all Knights in the surroundings and pushed them all opposite of Knight Augustus.

Knight Augustus that at this moment, with his Dominium caving in from an unbearable pressure and his face splintered and folding in itself...turned to look towards the silver gold haired female Knight in a daze until a moment later...
BOOM!
An existential boom akin to a vanquished existential singularity bloomed.
It was blood red gold as after its emergence, it collapsed into itself as everything became devoured and disappeared into oblivion right after!
{Robbed Honor and glory become commonplace, their process undeniable once in place.}
Their process was undeniable once in place.
In real time, a prophecy began to apply its corrective measures with shocking accuracy and precision!
The Knights gazed forward with dazed expressions, Knight Palmino's expression seeming utterly ugly as every part of his body trembled!

On his forehead, he could feel the devilish smile and eyes trying to fully return and establish themselves while on two other Knights, their Loot Markers became much brighter and potent at this moment!

|No...no!| The silver gold haired companion of Knight Augustus wailed in a guttural howl that stretched out all around, her intent entirely sorrowful as seeing her gaze and the gaze of other Knights, Akalusia couldn't help but feel a surge of anger in her heart.
She knew the culprit.
The one who had thrown the arrows.
The one they were seeking in the beginning.
With her molars grinding in her jaws, she called out his name.
|Noah...Osmont!|
HUUM!
His name acted like a trigger on all dazed Knights here.
Palmino seemed like a raging bull as feeling the Mark on his forehead and two others seeking to become ever brighter, he bellowed out.
|To Cappadocia...now!|
Before any other situation occurred.
Before anything else worsened!

chapters.title: Chapter 3002 Merely the Teleios Stage! II
paragraphs: What a glorious thing!

Hours after this advance into the Existential Dominium Realm, he went ahead and utilized his Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed to entirely skip over the Neonate, Sequor, and Teleios Stages as an entity of such a Realm was slain!
Floating above his throne, Noah took a moment to take the gravitas of such an action.
Of such an achievement.
And all he could say for it...
|Merely the Teleios Stage...nothing much!|
WAA!
Merely the Teleios Stage!
He skipped to slay an entity of such a stage, and when it came to him, he didn't just leave them at that.
He first devoured their eons' worth of hard work.
And he then put records of what they used to be at work as at this moment, the dazzling illusory figure of an Imperium Knight was actualized, a sentient light flowing within his eyes.
The moment this light came to, his will became focused on the man before his eyes as in a swift motion...
HUUM!
The illusory weaving of the handsome visage of Knight Augustus came to bend down and Kneel before Noah!
|Master.|
The intent was thick and powerful.

Even at this point, waves of heavy Existential Extremity Authorities from Noah and the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed continued to fill up this Illusory Weaving in front of Noah as its realm was far too high.
Its breadth was immeasurably wide!
{The Existential Extremity Authority of Royalty can be redesigned under the Illusory Weaving of Knight Augustus and brought to the Existential Level under it.}
{The Extremity Authority of Honor can be redesigned under the Illusory Weaving of Knight Augustus and brought to the Existential Level under it.}
{The Extremity Authority of Dignity can be redesigned under the Illusory Weaving of Knight Augustus and brought to the Existential Level under it.}
An array of prompts arose.
Towards the kneeling Imperium Knight paying obeisance to him, Noah gazed at him calmly as this was a tool that allowed many more things to become possible.
To start off...
{There are some who chose to be my enemies...Legacies that thought themselves far above all else.}
WAA!
The moment these words rose, the Illusory Weaving of the Imperium Knight Augustus rose along with them as his intent burst out!
|The enemies of the master deserve nothing else but a swift conversion to become Loot!|
A sound intent.
Noah smiled at it and nodded as he gave out his command.

{The Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius still exist. Wipe them out silently and efficiently. Basileus Anaine...can be spared due to her prior actions. As of this moment, you will take the lead as the Commander of my Illusory Legion. Illusory Commander Augustus!|
HUUM!
Existential authority seethed.
The newly appointed Illusory Commander became even more servile as he bowed ever deeper.
|I heed the Master's commands.|
With existential authority still flowing into him like an endless sea.
With a body that other entities could not even see!
An invisible Imperium Knight disappeared.
And more prompts cascaded over Noah's eyes.
{The action of decimating the Dominium of a Teleios Stage Existential Dominium Realm Entity is not a light one.}

{Apart from all of his Records, Existence, and Extremes being funneled to become amplified authority to be converted to Quintessential Fruits of Existence, you have attained a Quintessential Dominium Core that can be utilized to stimulate the formation of an Entity's Dominium.}
A magisterial singularity began to form within Noah's forge.
It was a loot so blinding that...
{The Extremity of Cheats gazes at the newly appearing Loot with anticipation and an itch to alter!}
Some of Noah's extremes began to lock onto the wondere continuing to bloom around Noah!
Within the Existential Domain of Cappadocia.
As one of the central Domains under the banner of the Imperium, it was something unique and not akin to the Existential Domains where Seeds were cultivated over eons.

Forces of the Imperium moved to and fro in many places here, with there being designations of Planes of Existence where certain Enclaves occupied, and some of the more potent branches of Legacies even had their own designated Planes where their Basileus were stationed!
And then, there were general areas where the Basileus of different Legacies mixed in along with others of the Imperium.
In a Plane of Existence filled with vibrant blue galaxies.
Atop a central point of the largest galaxy, a massive construct surrounded by vessels going back and forth, and even many more parked in place could be seen.
The construct was circular in nature, seeming like a disk of blue light that had countless grand structures and buildings atop it!

Among these many structures, there was a famous one known as the Pearl of Cappadocia where many Legacies, Enclaves, and other forces gathered for entertainment and to soothe one's weary Dominium through many methods.
The Pearl of Cappadocia was a massive structure designed like a ship, and it floated on a stellar cloud of stars as it had multiple layers and floors.
On the 899th floor of the Pearl of Cappadocia.
Attendants floated on a gold sea of dazzling light, carrying with them trays that held refined drinks made from Fruits of Existence.

There were wide golden tables rising from the gold sea below that were occupied by many powerful Entities at the Existential Dominium Realm, many of them belonging to Enclaves or Legacies as they mingled and discussed amongst each other.

On a particular table, the visage of Basileus Anaine could be seen with many other Basileus of the Legacy of Al-Abalem, and unlike the cheery gazes of other Entities across the floors of the Pearl of Cappadocia, their gazes were dark!
Every now and then, gazes would be thrown their way as the discussions taking place were all the same, talking of the downfall of Al-Abalem and Ignatius as the events of Vitalis and Vacuous spread!
In a corner of this unique space.
Belonging to a powerful Entity that used to hold some of the highest rights to Cappadocia, an Entity silently appeared as his visage was not visible to any others!
It was the arrival of a soldier- a commander sent forth by a man who always remembered cause and effect!

chapters.title: Chapter 3003 Attacks on Cappadocia! I
paragraphs: 3003 Attacks on Cappadocia! I
Being the Illusory Weaving of Knight Augustus, the Illusory Commander Augustus knew very well all the protective measures within Cappadocia and how to bypass them.
All he did afterward was remain with his Innate weaving of not even being visible in existence to other entities and overseeing authorities!
And then, he followed the weavings of his Master to arrive at those whose extremes and records he was entangled with.
Silently, he observed the remnant forces of the Legacy of Al-
Abalem on the 899th floor of the Pearl of Cappadocia around a luxurious golden table where drinks made of Fruits of Existence flowed within golden chalices.
Only Basileus Anaine and other members of the Legacy of Al-
Abalem were here, with the Archon Basileus Al-Abalem himself not being present!
But the Illusory Commander Augustus was not worried about this.
A man had to start somewhere.
And when he moved, he had to guarantee results!

He closed his eyes as he remained invisible while surrounded by swathes of Basileus from different Legacies and Enclaves, most being in the Sequor Stage of Existential Dominium Realm as the second most common was the lowest Neonate Stage, and there were a few prominent heads of Teleios Stage on the leading seats of some clusters.
The moment a move was made, an exit had to be made right after!
The Illusory Commander Augustus closed his eyes at this moment as he felt the weavings of his Master.
Within the great stretches of Cappadocia, he could sense the few Knights affected by the Loot Marker and the Observer they dragged along with them.
The intent of his Master's prophecy rang in his mind as he sensed the progression of these marks.
[Robbed Honor and glory become commonplace, their process undeniable once in place.]
The process was undeniable.
His former self had met the inevitable fate as he was reborn under a grand new light under the glory of the Weaver of Extremity!
He could feel that even with the help they came to Cappadocia to seek, another Teleios Stage brethren would be joining him soon enough.
But the power of the Imperium clustered here, there were those who could still reverse the terrifying power of his Master!
So the Illusory Commander Augustus waited patiently to strike.
At the most opportune time.
While waiting...
|Come forth to aid in accomplishing the commands of the Master.|
His weavings traversed across space and time to reach the Illusory Weavings of Neonate Stage Basileus his Master had already killed- those who joined the ranks of his Master first but he now led.
All of them would answer his call as the result of their mission was to grow the numbers of their Legion even more!
But since they couldn't hide as well as him at his current stage, their mission would be elsewhere.
There was also the Vacuous side of Entities, the side where his Master had granted additional advice due to the complex weavings of the Great Usurper mixed in with these forces!
Within Cappadocia.
In a restricted area filled with gloriously pulsing seas of existential authority.

The auras of powerful entities in the Sequor and Teleios Stage could be felt as they belonged to the powerful Legions stationed within Cappadocia, with the eyes of many Knights currently gazing towards the Existential Panacea Sea where one of the prized Imperium Knight Healers could be seen.

The Existential Panacea Sea was verdant gold and filled with an overabundance of life, and a massive Willow Tree rose from its very depths as some of its many branches were currently wrapped around three Imperium Knights and the Royal Observer Xavier.

The figures of Knight Palmino and Akalusia were standing in front of this massive tree as within moments, a terrifying aura far exceeding the Teleios Stage of Existential Dominium Realm appeared in the surroundings!
It was the appearance of an aged man with white gold hair and a pair of glasses, his demeanor of an old man entirely destroyed by his absolutely shocking might.
It was the Imperium Martial King overseeing many of the operations of the Existential Domain of Cappadocia!

The moment he arrived, Knight Akalusia and Knight Palmino bowed down along with the rest of the Knights in the surroundings, but the gaze of the Martial King wasn't even on them as he was locked onto the three Imperium Knights and the Observer Xavier.

His eyes instantly lit up with wrath as he saw the looks of agony on the Imperium Knights who were getting their Dominiums actively devoured, the efforts of the massive tree and its massive life force behind them not even being able to help.

Then he also saw the visage of the Royal Observer who had his face split and caved in the middle already, the rest of his body seemingly about to follow as when the Imperium Martial King appeared, Xavier and the others adopted looks of great hope- they hands reaching out to be saved!
They all wanted to be saved.

But looking at their state, the Martial King instantly moved his body towards the three Imperium Knights as Observer Xavier instantly despaired, the wavering of his intent instantly becoming critical as his Dominium instantly began fracturing and caving into itself, the cackling of the devilish smile and eyes on his forehead flaring victoriously!

It seemed like the ultimate insult before these Imperium Knights as their Dominiums buzzed, with the might of the Martial King erupting on his aged body as his hands descended on the first two Knights who were branded- blinding light erupting out and beginning to erase these brandings as the authority seemed undeniable!
Those who would be saved would be saved.
And those who would perish as the Protagonist prophesized would perish!

But at such a moment when one of the major powerhouses within Cappadocia was making a move to resolve an issue, and while many eyes were drawn towards the return of the Red Legion and the death of an Imperium Knight...an Illusory Commander made a move!

In the midst of her thoughts.
In the midst of her weavings.
She felt her silver white hair flicker and weave as if a heavy wind was whipping all around her.
Her head rose in confusion as an instant later, her eyes were only able to capture a flash of brilliance she had seen once before.
This light of brilliance...was already on the heads of all Basileus of Al-Abalem apart from her!
Some of its Tendrils were colorless, others an endless blue, and others shining a brilliant hue of purple.
But she could have sworn that she had seen this light before.
The moment this thought came, her eyes were only just able to capture the implosion and fracturing of the bodies and Dominium Souls of all the Basileus of Al-Abalem around her.

All of them were either at the Neonate or Sequor Stage of Existential Dominium Realm, and even Anaine could say that the brilliance of the authorities raging around her may be no less brilliant if not exceeding her father!
It meant this was someone at the Teleios Stage, and a tremendously powerful one at that as the moment an instant passed, a few dozen Dominiums were instantly crushed!
Basileus Anaine rose up in shock as around her, exclamations and bellows rose from nearby as a great number of existential authorities erupted out!
|WHO!|
|DARING!|
Countless intents overlapped.
But no enemy could be seen.
The only thing apparent...was the lone figure of Basileus Anaine.
She was frozen in place with her authorities buzzing, preparing to fight for her own life but...
Nothing else came. No enemy could be seen even as powerful Royalties of the Imperium rose around and spread their Dominiums out in shock!
And far from the Pearl of Cappadocia.
In another region within the Haven of Cappadocia.
The figure of Archon Basileus Ignatius was meeting with the Veiled Herald of Flames- the right hand woman of the Archon Basileus Lethith as she was smiling while enacting different plans!
|Under Al-Abalem, you lost everything. So why would you not join our cause? My Archon has great ambitions...|
Her weavings were enticing as Ignatius had a difficult expression, and just when he was about to reply...his gaze changed as he turned around and bellowed out!
|YOU!|

He bellowed out behind him where the few dozen remaining Basileus of his Legacy remained, and he sensed the invisible enemies he had come across before instantly appearing around his forces and striking out!
All of the Illusory Weavings were of the Neonate Stage as they couldn't escape the gazes of Teleios Stage Entities.
The Dominium Soul of Archon Basileus Ignatius instantly erupted to defend in anger, the Veiled Herald of Flames also standing up with sternness.

But before she could even move, her pupils widely dilated in the next moment as in the corner of her eyes, she saw the erupting image of Ignatius who was radiating his Dominium in the distance...she saw his face caving in and nearly being destroyed as a silent and invisible attacker of much greater power than the ones they could currently sense in the distance attacked!

The Illusory Commander Augustus had warped through the weavings of Cappadocia through the prepared Legions of Illusory Weavings of Basileus, instantly appearing in this space as it judged the best entity that could fall to him at the Teleios Stage.
The answer turned out to be Ignatius.
BOOOM!
A heavy battle broke out here as at this moment, a single Entity in the distance was the one benefitting from all of this!
Far away from the attacks being carried out in Cappadocia.

Adorned in his sleek white dress and obsidian pants, Noah's Dominium Soul reflected the vision of what his main body saw- a scene of wondrous prompts since another Teleios Stage Entity fell to his whims!
[Another Dominium Soul of a Teleios Stage Entity has been shattered by your means and the means of your Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!]
[Swathes of immense Records, Extremes, and Existence are flowing into you.]
[The Records, Extremes, and Existence of Observer Xavier are fully analyzed and understood.]
[The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Observer Xavier, has begun to form.]
[The Records, Extremes, and Existence Basileus Loraine are fully analyzed and understood.]
[The Existential Illusory Weaving V3- Basileus Loraine, has begun to form.]
One after another.

After another Teleios Stage Illusory Weaving joined his ranks, many more at the Sequor and Teleios Stage followed as for his advent into the larger Omniverse now, he was truly giving the imperium a warm welcome!
But at the same time, amidst all of these gains, there were also some losses.
Losses like Noah feeling the permanent erasure of his Loot Marker on the three remaining Knights.
Losses that told him that even though his Prophecies were powerful and applied great existential corrective measures, they could also be opposed when a great power stood opposite them!
But it didn't matter.

His silent legions moved quickly as he even expected an Archon to quickly join his ranks, the seas of existential authority that had just converged to support the Illusory Weaving of the Royal Observer Xavier already being warped away to appear within the distant battle against Archon Basileus Ignatius- because this battle had to be quick to ensure a clean destruction of an Archon's Dominium and the subsequent retreat before terrifying forces of the Imperium got a hold of his Legions.

Amongst those being destroyed in the Legacy of Ignatius, the Illusory Weavings under Commander Augustus purposely avoided a few Basileus similar to how Basileus Anaine was left untouched- these Basileus showing with their eyes a deeply hiding flow of blue tendrils of light that belonged to none other than the Great Usurper!
For these entities, Noah left alone as to him, attacking them would be akin to kill stealing.
And there were plenty of fish in the vast Omniverse!

chapters.title: Chapter 3005 Enemy of the Imperium! I
paragraphs: 3005 Enemy of the Imperium! I
As a Fisherman harvested his gains from afar...
The Imperium Martial King of Cappadocia was aflame with anger.
|This was a simple mission...|
His hand lifted from the stable visage of Knight Palmino as his aged gaze hung onto him and Knight Akalusia closely.
The Loot Markers were entirely erased from the foreheads of the remaining Knights with the shocking power of the Imperium Martial King, but two forces of the Imperium had fallen nonetheless.
An Observer, and a Knight!
A Knight stemming from a Trainee Red Legion that was being trained to succeed one of the genuine Red Legions of the Imperium to fight against Omniversal Pillagers!
How could one fall so easily?
In front of the willow tree full of an overabundance of existential life force.

In the surroundings, the Existential Panacea Sea shone with a splendorous green gold light that reflected on the many knights observing respectfully in the distance, and the Red Legion that at this moment...dropped to their Knees towards the Imperium Martial King.
Imperium Knights Akalusia and Palmino were included among them as Akalusia offered her Codex of Extremity while kneeling and voicing out her intent.
|The cause of failure was all on me, Martial King.|
The offering of the Codex of Extremity from the hands of the Knight Commander was extremely symbolic as more often than not, it was them relinquishing command and asking to be punished!
To any other Knight offering such a symbolic action, it may have gone through.
But for Imperium Knight Akalusia...
|Bah...get up. Tell me what happened.| The Martial King sighed wryly as if he were looking at his very own flesh and blood, the identity of Akalusia being extremely special!
Her gold locks of her brimmed with power as her immeasurably gorgeous visage remained kneeling while replying.

|We tracked Noah Osmont and discovered a Sanctus Princess without her entourage- just a single Knight. During our battle with them, we were faced with attacks that were the ones to cause our losses- and I have high confidence that the source of these attacks is this same Noah Osmont.|
Her words were filled with confidence.
As if what she said could be nothing but the truth!
The Imperium Martial King heard this name mentioned once more as his body pulsed with shocking waves of power.
Eons worth of accumulation seemed to be contained in his eyes as he muttered calmly.
|Noah Osmont.|

The name reverberated out across the golden green sea around them filled with an overabundance of life, the Knights of the Red Legion still kneeling as they waited for the verdict of the Martial King.
|He will no longer be regarded as a Seed, and the mystery of his background can be affixed to the Sanctus Populi.|
HUUM!
The surrounding weavings of existence trembled at his words alone as the flames of rage within Knight Palmino were fed freely and growing evermore.
The aged visage of the Imperium Martial King was suffused with a golden light as he continued.

|Place his name and everything to do with his Weavings as an Enemy of the Imperium. The reward for his Existential Capture or Death is currently set as either a Number of Shares from the Cappadocia Enclave or a not yet defined number of Fruits of Existence.|
The gaze of the Martial King became piercing.
As if he could see the strung up existence of the one known as Noah Osmont right before him already!

|Cappadocia shall declare an Existential Crusade against this Noah Osmont as any Legion will be welcomed, and you can destroy anything in your path to him, whether it be the Sanctus Populi or something else.|
HO!
The Knights of the Imperium in the surroundings smacked their chests and kneeled to give their affirmations.
HO!
Knight Palmino and Akalusia used their hands to smack their chests and chant in affirmation!
HO!
It was the call of the Existential Crusade of Noah Osmont!
Someone who dared to murder the Knights of the Imperium!
But before this moment could be taken in all that fully, the gaze of the Martial King flickered as he disappeared in a whisp of golden light right away.

When he reappeared, he was already within the 899th Floor of the Pearl of Cappadocia, gazing at the unfolding chaos of multiple Basileus with their Dominiums shattered and broken, and no enemy who did so in sight!
The gaze of the Martial King twinkled as he waved his hand, his aura spreading out as all the chaos around calmed.
Basileus of Legacies and Enclaves calmed and looked forward respectfully as the Martial King twisted his hand, the weavings of Records and existence seemingly flowing in reverse as in moments...
The shattered bodies of the Basileus reformed in an illusory manner. Even Basileus Anaine watched as an illusory version of herself came to sit back down on her seat- right before the attack!
The scene paused.
The hand of the Martial King burned with a golden light as before the Basileus died an instant later within the scene, his golden light came down to bathe over everything as a moment later...
Another figure was highlighted!
Shockingly, he stood right behind Basileus Anaine when he attacked, and yet she was left untouched.
But his sword moved out with multiple Existential Extremity Authorities as he cut down all Sequor and Neonate Stage Basileus of Al-Abalem not including Basileus Anaine!
Most astonishing of all was when the eyes of the Martial King and others in the surroundings landed on the visage of this attacker.
He was shining with a transparent light, but that face...that likeness...was that not Knight Augustus?!
The pupils of the golden haired Martial King pulsed as he knew this was one of the Knights to fall under the same being he had just released an Existential Crusade against.
His death was confirmed.
Now, his weavings were being used to wipe out Basileus of the Imperium? In his Cappadocia? While he himself was here?!
HUUM!
The surroundings trembled.
And the Martial King uttered out in a heavy tone.
|Noah...Osmont!|
A name was uttered out again.
It would be uttered many times in the near future, and each time the intent around it would be starkly different

chapters.title: Chapter 3006 Enemy of the Imperium! II
paragraphs: 3006 Enemy of the Imperium! II
The illusory figure of the long-dead Knight August was observed by the Imperium Martial King as golden tendrils of light flashed with his eyes!
Utilizing the death weavings of his Knights to carry out such brazen attacks in his home?!

This Osmont continued to spit on the honor of the Imperium freely as after the Martial King viewed the past weavings of Existence with his own terrifying Existential Extremity Authority, he turned his eyes towards the only Basileus of Al- Abalem to survive this brazen attack.
|You.|

As he spoke, he waved his hands and caused space to fluctuate as the visage of the silver haired Archon Basileus Al-Abalem appeared- this entity having been in a meeting with the Martial King regarding the loss of the Existential Domain he managed before things turned chaotic!

The moment Al-Abalem arrived, his eyes shook at the scene of Blood of his Legacy and the visage of Basileus Anaine alone as the first words he heard thereafter were from the Martial King...addressing Basileus Anaine.
|Why were you the only one not targeted? Why did Osmont leave you behind?|
There was a lot to unpack from the two questions.

Especially if you were Archon Basileus Al-Abalem who just arrived and saw nearly all of your people dead, these two questions first stipulated the ridiculous idea that somehow, the Seed Noah Osmont was involved in this, and that all of this had occurred...with his daughter being the only one he didn't slaughter!
And now, the Imperium Martial King was gazing at her coldly and seeking an answer.

Her vibrant face paled under such pressure as even before she could answer, the gaze of the Imperium Martial King flashed again, even greater anger being seen within his eyes before he disappeared again.
He was disappearing and reappearing quite a lot in the past few minutes as he left everything behind, the eyes of Al-
Abalem blazing as they questioningly looked at Basileus Anaine!
As for where the Martial King has disappeared to...
In an entirely different region within Cappadocia.

The aged Martial King appeared amidst a roiling sea of carnage, the figures of those from the Legacy of Ignatius lying dead with their Dominiums shattered, stellar blood filled with the weavings of Existence flowing freely as if a dense number of planes of existence had perished!

The most shocking thing was the visage of Archon Basileus Ignatius who was now staring blankly forward, his body cleaved by an existential light of Apocalypse as his Teleios Stage Dominium was collapsing in itself and experiencing an end.

The owner of this light faded just as the Martial King appeared, with this aged man roaring out and swinging his hand as wondrously, a manifestation of a golden hand cleaving down formed above the planes of Cappadocia.
This golden hand even shockingly reflected outside of the auroras of blue and red of this Existential Domain as if it could cleave entire Existential Domains themselves!

It struck out towards the spot where the enemy who had just struck down Archon Basileus Ignatius disappeared into- flowing its the crevice of records, extremes, and existence even though the enemy was no longer there!
That was the last action the Martial King committed before his rage calmed a moment later.
As for whether he managed to hit anything...nobody knew at this moment!

He looked around at the lifeless Dominium of a past Archon Basileus, and then also saw how there were a few Basileus from the Legacy of Ignatius still left alive, most of them shocked and unable to comprehend what just occurred before them.
Why were they left alive? Did the enemy simply run out of time? How was this connected to Basileus Anaine being left alive on the side of Al-Abalem?
Such inquisitive questions rang out in the mind of the Imperium Martial King as before he could begin his investigations...
SHAA!
A figure of another aged old man with white gold hair appeared while yawning, gazing at the lifeless Dominiums around as he asked lazily.
|Who's causing all this ruckus, Reperiel? I'm at a critical point grasping that feisty Omniversal Authority...|
The old man's voice was heavy and suffocating as it emanated towards the active Martial King- Reperiel!

Martial King Reperiel turned towards this newly appearing aged old man who seemed to also be in his prime just like him, his angered chest falling as he spoke calmly while beginning to reverse the weavings of this location.
|A new Enemy of the Imperium. He was an apparent Seed just in the last few weeks, and yet as of today, he had butchered Teleios Stage Knights and an Archon Basileus.|
|Oh?| The laziness in the eyes of this aged entity faded at such words.
Especially at the words of an Archon Basileus!
This was because his identity...was also that of an Archon Basileus- but one of the more powerful ones across the Imperium that ruled over many, many Existential Domains
Archon Basileus Alderon.
Leader of the Legacy of Alderon that was etched deeply into the Imperium!
He stroked his white gold beard as his golden robe shimmered, his intent echoing out.

|Interesting. So either an old fool hiding his identity and playing tricks, or an anomaly, or someone with a unique Omniversal Destiny cutting apart everything in his path. How are you planning on handling it?|
A flicker of interest had risen in the eyes of Archon Basileus Alderon.
The pressure of his eyes alone could grind thousands of Teleios Stage Entities to dust, and yet he was showing interest in this issue!
Martial King Reperiel raised his brows, his eyes shining as he replied.
|I was going to leave it to Imperium Legions and Legacies to hunt him down, but it seems you have another thought?|
|Mmm...| Archon Basileus Alderon smiled with a deep cunning light as he continued.

|We haven't gone hunting ourselves in quite a while, yes? Why don't we also join in and sure that we aren't just sending nutrients to this anomaly we don't know much about? We can just go and nip everything in the Bud before things start to bloom, and the kid may even hold surprises...|
Imperium Observers. Imperium Knights. Imperium Martial Kings.
These were the set stages of status within the Imperium as when it came to Archon Basileus, it wasn't set.
Most were at the same level or status as Knights, and then there were Archon Basileus whom even Martial Kings had to consider as peers or pay respects to them.
The newly appearing Archon Basileus Alderon was one such being as hearing his words, the Martial King Reperiel had his eyes shining with an inquisitive light before even he...gave a nod of agreement!

He was disappearing and reappearing quite a lot in the past few minutes as he left everything behind, the eyes of Al-
Abalem blazing as they questioningly looked at Basileus Anaine!
As for where the Martial King has disappeared to...
In an entirely different region within Cappadocia.

The aged Martial King appeared amidst a roiling sea of carnage, the figures of those from the Legacy of Ignatius lying dead with their Dominiums shattered, stellar blood filled with the weavings of Existence flowing freely as if a dense number of planes of existence had perished!

The most shocking thing was the visage of Archon Basileus Ignatius who was now staring blankly forward, his body cleaved by an existential light of Apocalypse as his Teleios Stage Dominium was collapsing in itself and experiencing an end.

The owner of this light faded just as the Martial King appeared, with this aged man roaring out and swinging his hand as wondrously, a manifestation of a golden hand cleaving down formed above the planes of Cappadocia.
This golden hand even shockingly reflected outside of the auroras of blue and red of this Existential Domain as if it could cleave entire Existential Domains themselves!

It struck out towards the spot where the enemy who had just struck down Archon Basileus Ignatius disappeared into- flowing its the crevice of records, extremes, and existence even though the enemy was no longer there!
That was the last action the Martial King committed before his rage calmed a moment later.
As for whether he managed to hit anything...nobody knew at this moment!

He looked around at the lifeless Dominium of a past Archon Basileus, and then also saw how there were a few Basileus from the Legacy of Ignatius still left alive, most of them shocked and unable to comprehend what just occurred before them.
Why were they left alive?
Did the enemy simply run out of time?
How was this connected to Basileus Anaine being left alive on the side of Al-Abalem?
Such inquisitive questions rang out in the mind of the Imperium Martial King as before he could begin his investigations...
SHAA!
A figure of another aged old man with white gold hair appeared while yawning, gazing at the lifeless Dominiums around as he asked lazily.
|Who's causing all this ruckus, Reperiel?
I'm at a critical point grasping that feisty Omniversal Authority...|
The old man's voice was heavy and suffocating as it emanated towards the active Martial King- Reperiel!

Martial King Reperiel turned towards this newly appearing aged old man who seemed to also be in his prime just like him, his angered chest falling as he spoke calmly while beginning to reverse the weavings of this location.
|A new Enemy of the Imperium.
He was an apparent Seed just in the last few weeks, and yet as of today, he had butchered Teleios Stage Knights and an Archon Basileus.|
|Oh?| The laziness in the eyes of this aged entity faded at such words.
Especially at the words of an Archon Basileus!
This was because his identity...was also that of an Archon Basileus- but one of the more powerful ones across the Imperium that ruled over many, many Existential Domains
Archon Basileus Alderon.
Leader of the Legacy of Alderon that was etched deeply into the Imperium!
He stroked his white gold beard as his golden robe shimmered, his intent echoing out.
|Interesting.
So either an old fool hiding his identity and playing tricks, or an anomaly, or someone with a unique Omniversal Destiny cutting apart everything in his path.
How are you planning on handling it?|
A flicker of interest had risen in the eyes of Archon Basileus Alderon.
The pressure of his eyes alone could grind thousands of Teleios Stage Entities to dust, and yet he was showing interest in this issue!
Martial King Reperiel raised his brows, his eyes shining as he replied.
|I was going to leave it to Imperium Legions and Legacies to hunt him down, but it seems you have another thought?|
|Mmm...| Archon Basileus Alderon smiled with a deep cunning light as he continued.
|We haven't gone hunting ourselves in quite a while, yes?
Why don't we also join in and sure that we aren't just sending nutrients to this anomaly we don't know much about?
We can just go and nip everything in the Bud before things start to bloom, and the kid may even hold surprises...|
Imperium Observers.
Imperium Knights.
Imperium Martial Kings.
These were the set stages of status within the Imperium as when it came to Archon Basileus, it wasn't set.
Most were at the same level or status as Knights, and then there were Archon Basileus whom even Martial Kings had to consider as peers or pay respects to them.
The newly appearing Archon Basileus Alderon was one such being as hearing his words, the Martial King Reperiel had his eyes shining with an inquisitive light before even he...gave a nod of agreement!

chapters.title: Chapter 3007 Enemy of the Imperium! III
paragraphs: 3007 Enemy of the Imperium! III
A Martial King was not an entity to be looked down upon.
Nor was an Archon Basileus who oversaw dozens or hundreds of Existential Domains!
Such entities enjoyed vast swathes of wealth and resources that allowed them to be where they were today, and to further maintain such a state by only getting more powerful.

They were Entities who weren't just touching upon influencing a semblance of Omniversal Authorities- but they were actually studying them and how to utilize them in greatly altering their extremes and existence.
Imperium Martial King Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon.
The first thing these entities did in the location where an Archon Basileus had perished was to collect all of those that had survived as an investigation had to be carried out!
The weavings of existence and extremes flashed as Dominiums were warped here and there.
And after three minutes passed...
|Alright, now we have all relevant parties here.|
In a golden hall with a single throne at its very end.
Towards the very center of Cappadocia, it was within a plane of existence that the Martial King took as one of his abodes.
Currently, the figures of Basileus Anaine, Archon Basileus Al-
Abalem, the remaining Basileus of Ignatius, and even the Veiled Herald of Flames and Archon Basileus Lethith were all warped to this location!

Imperium Knights Akalusia, Palmino, and many others could be seen lining up this Hall as in front of the throne, the Martial King stood beside Archon Basileus Alderon as he locked onto Basileus Anaine, his fingers tapping out.
|I have no patience to go back and forth with you all, so just do not resist while I read through your Records.|
The most shocking thing one Entity could do to another.
The reading of the Records contained within their Dominium as they would have to leave everything bare for another person to do that!
Basileus Anaine gritted her teeth, but she couldn't really deny a Martial King when she was merely in the Sequor Stage, and this entity far exceeded the Teleios Stage!
A golden light came to bathe over her Dominium.
And only a second passed.
Thereafter, the Martial King harrumphed as a heavy pressure cascaded down, Basileus Anaine's knees sinking into the floor as golden blood gushed out of her mouth!

Thereafter, the Martial King said nothing as he tapped his finger towards Al-Abalem and the remaining Basileus of Ignatius, and even the one that was meeting with Ignatius before he died- the Veiled Herald of Flames!

His will entered their Dominiums as he perused through them feely, seeing a great deal of information before he let out another harrumph an instant later- the Basileus of Ignatius and even Archon Basileus Lethith and his right hand woman also falling to their knees while gushing out blood!
Only Archon Basileus Al-Abalem was left alone standing.
The Martial King gazed at all those here with immense disappointment in his eyes, his intent weaving out while looking at those who merely bore his pressure.

|Scheming behind the scenes is one of the reasons we are all here today. This Anaine had the chance to capture and eradicate Noah Osmont within the weavings of Records, but she didn't take it so she could further her own insurrection against her father, while even working with Lethith to get her piece of the pie when things were done. Well now...|

|...You will be stripped of your position as Basileus, your Dominium suppressed for the eons to come as you will be sent to the Cappadocia Existential Mines. Spend your days unearthing Singularities of Existence.|
WAA!
His words first caused Al-Abalem to look at Basileus Anaine with incredulity, and the punishment was even more shocking!
Cappadocia Existential Mines!
What really made this Existential Domain special and required an Imperium Martial King to be here!
Basileus Anaine gritted her teeth at such a verdict, but she wasn't the only one.
The Martial King turned to stare at the remaining Basileus of Ignatius as his eyes flashed.

|I cannot sense what your fault is in all this, but if Osmont left you alive, you are connected to his weavings in some way. You all will spend the next few eons with your Dominiums suppressed and in the Cappadocia Existential Mines.|
As he spoke, the Martial King tapped his fingers once more, causing Anaine and the Basileus of Ignatius to disappear while their Dominiums gained a shocking sense of suppression!
Only the shocked visage of Al-Abalem and a few others remained while the Martial King continued to give out his verdicts!
|Lethith...for contributing in the rise of this Osmont, you will be reduced to overseeing a single Existential Domain as...|
Heavy words rang out one after another.
Along with them, new possibilities arose.
Within the depths of Cappadocia.

Molten blue and red mountains stretched out gloriously all around galaxies swirling within them as at the base of these mountains, extremely hard and reinforced metalloid singularities seemed to make up the base of the mountains.
Around this area, prisoners and miners were condemned to eons of work with their Dominiums oppressed to a fundamental level!

The Basileus of Ignatius and Anaine appeared in such a place as in front of them, Imperium Knights with whips as Existential Armaments could be seen, one immediately coming towards them to brief them on their new lives here.

But of the transported Basileus of Ignatius, the one of the very center let out a laugh as tendrils of blue light began to fill his eyes- an old consciousness being rapidly erased and devoured as a new one settled in!
From him, barely audible whispers could be heard!
"Haha, a suppressed Dominium for me to easily take over? Thank you for the gift, old friend!"
The voice of the Great Usurper, Noah Eckert, could barely be heard as his eyes radiated a blue light while rising to gaze at everything around him.
The massive mountains made of singularities.
At their base, many prisoners and miners with their Dominiums suppressed could be seen.
Some at the Neonate Stage.
Some at Sequor.
And some even at the Teleios Stage!
In the body of a Basileus, the Great Usurper smiled as he seemed to have arrived at a paradise.
There were so many suppressed meals just waiting for him to eat up!

chapters.title: Chapter 3008 Merely the Dominium Realm!
paragraphs: 3008 Merely the Dominium Realm!
The tide of fate was unique as one person's misery may just be another person's tremendous boon.

While the Great Usurper experienced a tremendous boon in Cappadocia, far away from it, the Extremity of the Protagonist was calculating his own gains while his Dominium Soul was already following the lead of two Entities towards another location!

Before him, waves of existential authorities of his concepts swirled as he looked at the body of his Illusory Commander Augustus that was nearly cleaved in half, its Dominium nearly shattered by the strike of someone who should have been the Martial King of Cappadocia.
His body was already gone, with only a trace of his weavings remaining- but even this was utilized to nearly destroy the Dominium Soul of a Teleios Stage Entity!
Noah couldn't match up to such a being yet as he looked at everything else around him.

While waves of authorities flowed into the Illusory Commander Augustus to heal his Dominium, the kneeling body of the Illusory Weavings of the Observer Xavier and even...the Archon Basileus Ignatius could be seen.
A total of three Teleios Stage Entities!
A past Archon, a Knight, and a Royal Observer!
These were currently Noah's most powerful forces as under them, the other Basileus he had killed and looted joined their ranks to form his Dominium Stage Legion.
These were his forces.
But apart from these, he also had other Vassals- and they could embark on the same glorious path as himself.

He looked at the Quintessential Dominium Cores he received with every death of a Teleios Stage Entity as he thought about his family and vassals, disappearing soon after from the restricted domain space in the depths of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed...and arriving near the rotating Aletheian Havens along the massive Extremity Vein of this construct.

Towards the very peak of the Extremity Vein where the battle with the Mimeisthais had occurred, the Vassals all remained as they acclimated to the Quintessential Gradations of Extremity and the endless Dominium Sky that was out of reach far above!
At this moment, Noah appeared amongst them.

His aura was existence defining as the moment he arrived the stellar rivers of essence in the surroundings began to coil with him becoming the center as sparkling Singularities bloomed and faded just from the sheer existential light around him.
The Primogenitor of Steel and others turned to gaze at him with somber looks.
Barbatos and others smiled as they basked in his light.
Dr. Hall, The Emperor Penguin, Hyperion, and Enders kneeled and bowed to pay their respects!
The Cimmerian Architect, Svetlana, Sargon, and Ishtar gazed forth with complex emotions and a sense of awe.
Ayame, Erikson, and Lilith could only gaze from afar as they seemed to be thinking of the past.
Noah appeared in such a place and became the absolute center of attention as he called out far ahead towards an entity that was already coming towards him.
This body of his was currently adorned by a purple gold Emperor's Robe as he seemed like an ancient eonic king being paid respect by his people, his intent weaving out.
|My Son.|
HUUM!
With his call, the visage of Henry that was coming from afar instantly arrived before his father and tried to kneel.
But Noah's hands grasped his shoulders and observed his son fully.
At the 9th Gradation of Extremity.
His body was surrounded by the Existential Extremity Authority of Destiny.
An Authority recorded in the Creed of the Existential Omniversal Emperor as Noah himself could access it at any time and officially brand it into himself!
|Our lineage...is one of excellence and Quintessence.|
As he spoke, he waved his hands to reveal a deeply purple flower that seemed like it was made up of trillions of planes of existence glimmering like galaxies.
It was the Quintessential Dominium Core that came from defeating a Teleios Stage Entity.
Noah took such a thing and pushed it towards the chest of his Son freely as his eyes began to tremble with emotion.
|Our Creed is one that will stand out across the Omniverse, so none of us can be weak. You, my son, cannot be weak.|
HUUM!
Around Henry Osmont, the Extremity of Nepotism vibrated and began to change- seething towards the Existential level.
If what was happening wasn't the ultimate form of Nepotism, what was?
The existence of the son of Destiny buzzed as he felt the waters of the Gradations of Extremity getting extremely far away.
His gaze turned up as he found he could catch a glimpse...of an endless sky.
BOOM!
At such a moment, his existence began to give off a different aura.
Of a step forward towards the Primordium Dominium Realm!
In the distance, others looked at this scene as the intent of the Weaver of Extremity blazed out.

|My Creed is not one that excludes. Soon after our stabilization, we will begin the process of Omniversal Expansion as all hands will be needed. Perform well, and boundless Loot shall be yours. If you have my Lineage, transcending the Ninth Gradation and entering the endless Dominium Skies is only a matter of time...those who achieve it within the next day will attain the titles of Quintessential Commanders and be the leaders of my Legions.|
WAA!
His words caused his people's hearts to shudder and their souls to buzz!
His words were extremely potent as they were simply what the Protagonist knew to be true from his own Prophecy!

[To ends of existence to the beginnings of extremes, a pioneer rises that has never been seen. Legacies and Enclaves are many in between, but which can stand against an Omniversal engine? Twist and turn, and turn again, until what is rare becomes all the same!]
Thinking of this, Noah turned towards his people and the two remaining Quintessential Dominium Cores in his hands as he continued.

|My Creed...the Lineage of the Existential Omniversal Emperor will soon be mixing with forces that have lived for eons. Even if we have lived for decades or thousands of years, we cannot be any lesser. So burn with Quintessence...reach the Dominium Skies, and form your Dominium Skies. Thereafter, an endless expanse awaits.|
The words of the Protagonist rang out grandly.
TRING!
The Bard of Quintessence began to play a tune of melody and wonder as the people and the very Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed entered another stage!

chapters.title: Chapter 3009 Sanctus Populi! I
paragraphs: 3009 Sanctus Populi! I
The Bard of Quintessence put in some overtime.

A tune of glory and wonder rang out within a section of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as the Son of Destiny was transforming his existence and stepping into the Primordium Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm enacted by his Father!
Within his Blood, there was a shocking lineage of immense purity.
And such a lineage also flowed within them, even if it weren't as pure.
They could feel it.
The Bard of Quintessence could feel it.
There was a shocking amount of untapped potential flowing within them!
And as they had this thought...
HUUM!
Their wills were drawn towards the Existential Omniversal Emperor once more.
This was because as his son transformed, Noah came to a point of his own transformation.
The flow of all surrounding authorities seamlessly resonated with him at the very center- where it seemed they came alive with every breath he took!
When Noah checked within his Dominium, he was the reason.

Devouring the eons worth of Loot light of multiple Neonate, Sequor, and Teleios Stage Entities after he amplified it all...was enough to bring him towards the peak of his Primordium Stage of Existential Dominium Realm!
[The Primordium Sky has almost been scaled.]
[The corrective effect on the Existential Extremity Authorities currently present within your Dominium has begun to be actively displayed.]
[You are raising all three Aspects of your Existence harmoniously and with immaculate balance, allowing for the corrective effect on your Existential Extremity Authorities to be even more profound.]
[Your extremes are becoming more capable of altering the existence around you with less of a cost on your resources!]
[The unknown weavings of your Primordium Core are slowly coming to fruition.]
[To completely scale the Primordium Sky, nearly ten times the amount of resources are required compared to the resources it took to arrive at the precipice.]
Even more information flowed into him.
If he was about to finish scaling the Primordium Sky after devouring and assimilating thousands of Quintessential Fruits of Existence from his enemies, where would he be ranked?
With the tremendous amount of resources required for completion, would he be comparable to peak Sequor Stage? Or could he even compare to a Teleios Stage Entity?
There was still much to learn and analyze as Noah smiled.

To him, everything was perfectly normal, but to those in the surroundings, his aura was becoming even more unfathomable as just with his presence alone, they felt their own extremes flowing based on him as they sought to converge only on his Dominium Sky!
|You don't have a lot of questions regarding who I am and exactly where we are going?|
A sonorous voice rang out.
At times, it was said that one could hear the beauty of someone just from their voice alone.
This entity only furthered this stereotype as with her verdant hair shining brilliantly, the Sanctus Princess Emilliana was following a unique weaving of Existence that was built of Dignity!
In front of her, the Dragon Knight Alder had a stern expression as he seemed to be following the very extreme weavings of Dignity towards a certain location.
Beside her, Noah in his sleek suit was studying this mode of transportation closely as it relied on traversing across an Extreme and going towards its Source.
The Source of the Extremity of Dignity.
This was much more interesting to Noah than the weavings he had already uncovered of Emilliana as he replied calmly.

|I will learn what I need to learn in due time, but I do hold curiosity about where exactly the Sanctus Populi is. The whole Omniverse is covered under the glory of the Imperium, so where exactly and how exactly could one hide from their gaze over the eons?|
His words and deep voice also furthered the stereotype of a handsome man behind a confident voice as towards this, Emilliana's eyes flashed while she shook her head.
|No...not every part of this Omniverse is covered by the vile light of the Imperium.|
|Oh?| Noah raised his brows as Emilliana pointed ahead- towards the pulsing light of Dignity.

|The Imperium has carved out a great deal of this Omniverse, but they alone do not have the power to do that. And even if it is in points of existence under their vile light...those powerful enough can live under the light and shadows of a single Existential Extreme that had been elevated so much to become intricately linked to the Omniverse. In this case, we are going towards the Sanctum of Dignity.|
WAA!
Living...inside of an Existential Extreme!
What did such a thing even mean?

|Accessible by those granted the specific rights of Dignity, nobody else can enter unless led through by both a Knight and a Sanctus Princess. Unless someone with certifiably grander Dignity possibly forces their way in. But in this Omniverse, who else can have higher Dignity than the Sanctus Populi? Than the Dragon Knights protecting the will of the people across it?|
As she spoke, the blinding golden light around them seemed to reach an Apex.
A singularity of Dignity bloomed in front of them, and their figures warped entirely into it as they delved towards the Source of the Existential Extremity of Dignity.
They reappeared within the Sanctum of Dignity.
|Welcome.|
With her verdant hair gaining a golden sheen.
With Dragon Knight's expression easing as if he were finally in a safe space.

|The Sanctum of Dignity...one of the core locations of Sanctus Populi, and where we can have you undergo verification. If you can successfully become a Dragon Knight, you can attain even more knowledge and-|
BOOM!
An unimaginably heavy impact ricocheted ahead of them.
The surroundings were only just unfolding before Noah, and yet an impact of power that caused his Dominium Soul to feel a great sense of oppression rang out!
Far exceeding the Teleios Stage.
Bathed with an intense light of Dignity!

Far ahead, nine massive statues of Dragons could be seen as they glowed with a cosmic light, and at this moment...the figure of a powerful Entity far exceeding the Teleios Stage smashed onto the wing of one of the nine dragons- the auras of many, many Entities of the Existential Dominium Realm actually watching in the surroundings as spectators!
The gaze of Sanctus Princess Emilliana flickered as she seemed to understand what was going on instantly, a sigh escaping her lips as she waved Noah for them to also go forward...

chapters.title: Chapter 3010 Sanctus Populi! II
paragraphs: 3010 Sanctus Populi! II
The nine Dragons each shone with a different color, the central one being bright gold and brimming with immense dignity.
Each of them were the size of Planes of Existence, and behind these massive statues of Dragons, clusters of thousands of Planes of Existence could be seen!
Some contained in small points of singularities akin to grains of sand.
Some outwardly expressing their grand stature.

And at the very center of the statues of nine dragons, there was an equally titanic golden arena that looked much more like a Coliseum- and this was the location where an entity exceeding the Teleios Stage had been thrown out of to smash onto one of the dazzling statues of Dragons!

In the surroundings, Entities in the forms of Dragons or Humans were abundant as they all seemed to be observing what was occurring in shock, the identity of the being who was smashed onto the Dragon statue being someone they all had to revere.
Someone of much higher status than some Sanctus Princesses!
Emilliana's sigh became stern as she also realized this, her intent weaving out towards those far ahead to grasp just what had occurred.
Moments later, a Dragon Knight appeared near them as they made their way over towards the massive golden arena, bowing towards Emilliana as he voiced out.
|Sanctus Princess...it seems your younger sister has angered the Elder Queens so much so that Elder Queen Ariana sought to discipline her. But this is the result...|
The rankings within the Sanctus Populi were simple.
While the Imperium had Observers, Knights, and Martial Kings, the Sanctus Populi held Knights who served under the Sanctus Princesses, and the Sanctus Princesses who answered to the Elder Queens!

The power of Elder Queens was utterly terrifying as they were at times equated to the Martial Kings of the Imperium- with all of them having begun influencing or grasping Omniversal Authorities one way or another.
They all had long since exceeded the Teleios Stage as they had stepped on the Teracosm Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm.
Teracosm!
One's Dominium would gain a heavy golden sheen at such a stage as the night they wielded delved more so towards the Omniverse.
And yet...an Elder Queen of the Teracosm Stage currently had her visage imprinted on one of the Nine Sanctus Dragons depicted within this endless stretch of the Sanctum of Dignity.
The culprit...was Sanctus Princess Emilliana's younger sister.
A sister even she had difficulty with as her power was something very few truly understood.
|Unfilial!|
BOOM!

A screech boomed out from the Dragon statue at the center as a beautiful older woman in her prime floated out, blazing golden flames wrapping around a unique Dominium Origin as the Existential Extremity Authority of Dignity burned much too bright around her at this moment.

Those at the Sequor Stage couldn't even handle looking at her as she seemed like a burning sun, only those at the Teleios Stage being able to glance at her figure without feeling their retinas burning!
Noah's eyes brightly locked onto her as he felt a slight burning sensation, but he moreso locked onto the target of this Elder Queen.

A young woman who seemed to share some features with Sanctus Princess Emilliana could be seen at the very center of the vast golden arena, her expression calm and devoid of emotions currently as her beauty far exceeded all others here.
Her head held gorgeous locks of green and gold hair, her nose sharp as her eyes seemed capable of piercing the secrets of the Omniverse themselves.
She had a single white blue sword in her hands that coursed with liquefied Dignity and another Existential Extremity Authority that seemed capable of freezing one's Dominium at a glance!
|You won't take any Dragon Knights under you! You won't take any missions as a Sanctus Princess! What good are you just staying here and wasting away?!|
The roar of the Elder Queen boomed out as all of the surrounding weavings of existence seemed to be supporting her.

Yet the gorgeous young woman on the golden arena didn't pay her any heed, the shocking sense of oppression bearing down on her actually being withstood as if it were nothing...and she flicked her sword up once again.

The horrific power of the Elder Queen pressing down all around was actually cut through with such a simple stroke, existence becoming frozen as the Teracosm Stage Elder Queen was smashed by an unseen force once more, Singularities of frost and utmost coldness exploding around her as she was flung back to the same impression she made before on the dragon statue!

Silence reigned in the surroundings briefly before a billowing golden mass of power filled with wrath rose up from the indentation of the statue, the power of an enraged Teracosm Stage Entity about to run wild when at such a time...
|Elder Queen Ariana...please lessen you anger.|
The voice of Sanctus Princess Emilliana rang out.

Her arrival was quickly caught by others as they paid respects- the men in the surroundings particularly paying their loyalty by bowing as this was also part of the critical structure of the Sanctus Populi.
Sanctus Princesses. Elder Queens. Sanctus Elder Queen Mother. Sanctus Empress.
All positions were held by female entities as the men supported them as their Knights!
As Sanctus Princess Emilliana was acknowledged, the Elder Queen who was actually getting whooped by her unruly younger sister harrumphed, her power gradually calming as her intent continued.
|Nobody else can talk sense into her...if you fail to do so too, I will fucking get the Empress involved if I have to. All this power, and what does she do with it? Useless!|
With a glimmer of light, the Elder Queen finished her words and disappeared.
In her place was utter silence, as well as the nonchalant and calm figure in the arena holding an icy blue sword.
Noah went on to stare at her as his Dominium buzzed.
Sanctus Princess Emilliana stared at her supposed younger sister as she held her own complex emotions!
Just like her, her sister was also at the Teleios Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm.
And yet...she could freely battle against Teracosm Stage Entities as she was someone famous amongst the Sanctum of Dignity!
Famous as one blessed by the Omniverse.
Famous as one with great destiny, with a power so unique that others could not even compare.
An Omniversal genius.
And yet...she also came with her own bundles and stacks of problems!

chapters.title: Chapter 3011 Osmont's Proof of Dignity! I
paragraphs: 3011 Osmont's Proof of Dignity! I
Strands of hair shining green and gold, her forehead holding a brilliant Scripture of [S] that seemed like a beam of curved light- immense coldness emanating from it as it was pure white.
The same white covered her icy blue blade as it felt like her eyes were looking at everything with the same wavelength.
As if the golden floor below her and the figures of Dragon Knights around her were one and the same.
Not to say she thought herself above them.
There wasn't even a sense of superiority in her eyes!
Yet to her...it all just seemed the same.
None of it seemed to matter!
Sensing the Elder Queen that was bothering her gone, she was about to leave when a moment later.
|Little Sister.|
The voice of Sanctus Princess Emilliana buzzed in her ears.
And she came to a stop as she turned back to see the figure of Emilliana, Dragon Knight Alder, and a new face come before her.
She looked at each of them in turn, giving a nanosecond of a glance on each being- but uniquely...her gaze returned for a double take on the visage of Noah as she titled her head!
She tilted her head akin to having a sense of confusion, and before she could clear up this confusion...
|Little Sister.|
The voice of Emilliana rang out again.
|Mmm?| And this terrifying Teleios Stage Entity who could seamlessly smack a Teracosm Stage Entity before them only turned towards Emilliana and nodded.
Emilliana sighed as she waved her hands for the gathered Dragon Knights in this area to disperse, walking closer towards her younger sister as her voice echoed out.
|Eventually, the Elder Queen Mother will and even the Sanctus Empress may get involved. Can you not just give them a little bit of what they want? Just to pacify them here and there.|
The words were tired and pleading ones as if she had done this many times before.
And she had truly done this far too many times before!
The one before her was referred to as an Omniversal Genius.
The Terror of Dignity.
The day she was born, the Elder Queen Mother overseeing the Source of Dignity trembled and was injured as this source was nearly automatically transferred over to her.
She attained an Existential Extremity Authority 24 hours after she was born, and attained the Existential Dominium Realm a day later.
She crossed the Neonate, Sequor, and Teleios Stages in the weeks that followed- only for her to remain in the Teleios Stage in the years that followed!
Others speculated this was merely her choice.
Because even at that stage, she could shockingly defeat Elder Queens at the Teracosm Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm.
She was Sanctus Princess Sona.
The Terror of Dignity, and also...the Sloth of Dignity.
Towards the words of Sanctus Princess Emilliana, Sona shook her head calmly as a barely audible intent leaked out from her.
|At the end...none of it will matter.|
Barely audible.
Yet Emilliana and Dragon Knight Alder were calm as if they had heard this too many times.
But Noah...he felt the weavings of his extremes buzzing as the flow of Oraculum pulsed with an unknown resonance!
|Today, you defeat Elder Queen Ariana. Will you battle the Sanctus Elder Queen Mother next? The one who raised you and gave you everything you have?|
These words caused a sense of emotion to slowly come to the surface, but it was quickly ground down as Sanctus Princess Sona was about to shake her head again.
But at this time, Sanctus Princess Emilliana's eyes shone with ingenuity as she turned to stare at Noah, a smile blooming on her face before she turned towards her sister once more!
|How about this? Do one thing to pacify them, and I can vouch for them to leave you alone for the next eon.|
WAA!
These words caused the brows of Sanctus Princess Sona to rise.
Unbothered for the next few eons? This was undoubtedly something sweet!
Seeing the slight interest in her eyes, Emilliana pointed to Noah beside her and continued.
|I have someone here needing to undergo verification and a test of Existential Knighthood. I was going to do it...but how about you take my place?|
An idea bloomed as the moment she heard it, Sanctus Princess Sona soured as she shook her head- changing her mind!
|I said it before and I will say it again, I will not take any Knights under me or anything of the sort.|
There was clear defiance and reasoning in her eyes as she was rejecting the idea right away, but Emilliana pressed on.

|Just a test of his Knighthood. Nobody said anything about you taking him under your Banner. You would have participated in one of our Sanctus Rituals since you became a Sanctus Princess, and the Elder Queens have nothing to come bother you with at least for the next eon.|
Silence reigned.
The entity that was Sona squinted her eyes as she came to gaze at Noah calmly once more, with Noah returning the same calm energy she gave off as moments later, Sona sighed while waving her hands!
|Alright, let's get it over with.|
The wheels of existence turned.
A decision unfolded along with a new reality as Sanctus Princess Emilliana nodded, her visage rising up as her intent began to weave out to the masses that had begun to disperse.
|I will express how the ritual of Sanctus Knighthood normally goes, and you will repeat after me...|
Her intent began to expand out and became louder, reaching out towards the masses in the distance!
|Who here wishes to test their Dominium and come under my Banner as a Knight?!|
WOO!
Bursts of golden Dignity rose from her as her intent weaved out.

And moments later, multiple men came forward and kneeled by the dozens as Sanctus Princess Emilliana looked at them closely, her fingers tapping out towards three as she chose two Teleios Stage Entities and one at the Sequor Stage!
|You three, come forward.|
She then turned towards Noah and Sanctus Princess Sona who shook her head as if she had seen this too many times and did not need to see it again.
|Observe the test of Sanctum Knighthood, and what it takes to be verified.|
