These words caused the brows of Sanctus Princess Sona to rise.
Unbothered for the next few eons?
This was undoubtedly something sweet!
Seeing the slight interest in her eyes, Emilliana pointed to Noah beside her and continued.
|I have someone here needing to undergo verification and a test of Existential Knighthood.
I was going to do it...but how about you take my place?|
An idea bloomed as the moment she heard it, Sanctus Princess Sona soured as she shook her head- changing her mind!
|I said it before and I will say it again, I will not take any Knights under me or anything of the sort.|
There was clear defiance and reasoning in her eyes as she was rejecting the idea right away, but Emilliana pressed on.
|Just a test of his Knighthood.
Nobody said anything about you taking him under your Banner.
You would have participated in one of our Sanctus Rituals since you became a Sanctus Princess, and the Elder Queens have nothing to come bother you with at least for the next eon.|
Silence reigned.
The entity that was Sona squinted her eyes as she came to gaze at Noah calmly once more, with Noah returning the same calm energy she gave off as moments later, Sona sighed while waving her hands!
|Alright, let's get it over with.|
The wheels of existence turned.
A decision unfolded along with a new reality as Sanctus Princess Emilliana nodded, her visage rising up as her intent began to weave out to the masses that had begun to disperse.
|I will express how the ritual of Sanctus Knighthood normally goes, and you will repeat after me...|
Her intent began to expand out and became louder, reaching out towards the masses in the distance!
|Who here wishes to test their Dominium and come under my Banner as a Knight?!|
WOO!
Bursts of golden Dignity rose from her as her intent weaved out.

And moments later, multiple men came forward and kneeled by the dozens as Sanctus Princess Emilliana looked at them closely, her fingers tapping out towards three as she chose two Teleios Stage Entities and one at the Sequor Stage!
|You three, come forward.|
She then turned towards Noah and Sanctus Princess Sona who shook her head as if she had seen this too many times and did not need to see it again.
|Observe the test of Sanctum Knighthood, and what it takes to be verified.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3012 Osmont's Proof of Dignity! II
paragraphs: 3012 Osmont's Proof of Dignity! II
The test of Sanctum Knighthood!

Within the Sanctum of Dignity, this test was closely related to this concept itself as one was tested on the compatibility of Dignity with their very Existence- along with the potential of their Existence with the Sanctus Populi, and revealing whether any harmful intents existing within one's Dominium against the Sanctus Populi.

The crux of it was a Sanctus Princess participating as they already held high prestige with the Existential Extremity Authority of Dignity, and they could see if there was any resonance between them and those taking the test of Knighthood.
As if to express this, the figure of Sanctus Princess Emilliana rose high above the arena, her hands waving upwards to reveal a massive clear gold mirror that reflected the surface below.
An Existential Armament that uncovered any veiled intent against the Sanctus Populi.
She then looked at the three Entities she had chosen below as she called out!
|A test of one's existence. A test of one's character. A test...of Knighthood! Come!|
HUUM!

Along with her words, the mirror above her fluctuated as her own body released tremendous waves of Dignity, golden light beginning to form below her feet as it constructed...a set of stellar gold stairs.
And these stairs continued to form downwards towards the Trainee Knights below, forming a staircase of one thousand massive stairs that vibrated with an astounding sense of Dignity.
Looking down, Emilliana called out again.
|Come.|
A set of stairs.
Those with a high level of Dignity may be capable of climbing a tenth of such stairs, and even this was enough to allow one to be a Dragon Knight.
To have an equivalent potential of Dignity that was a tenth of a Sanctus Princess was already an astounding feat- since Sanctus Princesses were those with extremely high Dignity!
With hardened expressions, the weavings of golden Dignity erupted around the three chosen Trainee Knights as they began their ascent!
Their Dominiums erupted with every ounce of their potential.
Their weavings of Extremes coalesced around them to push them higher!
But most of all, a profound sense of Dignity rose from their bodies as quickly, all three scaled 50 steps.
Then, the pacing began to slow.
One Trainee Dragon Knight took the lead.
It was a man with a bald head and golden goatee, Dignity surging around him and painting his fair bald head golden.
He took wide strides to cross 100 steps, and only began to slow down as he neared the 150th step!
At this junction, he could go no further even as veins began to rise below his skin, his Dominium Origin sending out waves of existential authority to no avail.
He stopped at the 150th step.
His Dignity could only match up to 15th percent of Sanctus Princess Emilliana.
But even this was astounding as the other two...one stopped short of 100 steps as the Sequor Stage entity could even cross past the 90th!

Their bodies then reflected a unique light as a great deal of information about them was reflected in the eyes of Emilliana, her voice echoing out soon after towards the Trainee Dragon Knight that had reached the 150th step.
|Arise, Dragon Knight Raishi!|
HUUM!
Glorious hymns played as the golden stairs disappeared.
Waves of Dignity surged as from the three, only a single Knight was chosen!
His expression showed tremendous joy and pride as he nearly took on his Draconic form, brilliance shimmering on his body as he kneeled.
There were other parts of the ritual that still remained, but Emilliana looked towards Sona as if she had shown the way, her figure descending as she nodded lightly.
|Go ahead, Little Sister.|
Without batting an eye, Sanctum Princess Sona began to rise up, countless weavings of existence and extremes that others couldn't even fathom surging within her as her thoughts were her own.
When she reached a high enough point, she gazed down as she once more and with actuality...locked onto Noah's figure.

The top buttons of his white dress shirt were loose as his muscular visage seemed about ready to rip the shirt off, his obsidian pants glimmering with brilliance as he gazed up towards her with unbound regality.
It was only when those in the surroundings really took this scene in did this reality begin to settle in.
A new entrant into their Sanctum of Dignity was undergoing his Sanctum Knighthood, and the one to take the lead on it...
was none other than Sanctus Princess Sona.
This...was a deadly blow as they wondered if this new entity had offended Sanctus Princess Emilliana for her to suggest this, or if there was something else they didn't know about!
And truly, not many knew the workings behind the scenes.
Emilliana wanted to confirm the aura she felt briefly from Noah that she only ever felt from Elder Queens.
And the terrifying entity above...was simply thrust into this situation as her goals were something others may never understand.
But the case remained the same when it came to this Knighthood.
Wasn't he...being set up for failure?
When it came to Dignity, none were higher than Sanctus Princess Sona.
She had almost wrestled control of the Source of Dignity from the Elder Queen Mother just the day she was born!
Climbing up towards her Dignity?
It was hard to truly say since unlike other Sanctus Princesses, she had never undergone a test of Knighthood, but they could already see the Weavings of what was about to happen!

Far above, the figure of Sanctus Princess Sona gazed down towards Noah's utterly stable figure- her apathetic eyes gaining a sense of light once more as she saw the weaving that confused her before she was distracted.
She focused on it now as around her, threads of Dignity began to rise.
Threads.
And yet the moment they emanated out, the statues of the 9 Dragons in the surroundings began to tremble.
The Dominiums of Teleios Stage Dragon Knights that had long since undergone their Knighthood began to tremble with a sense of oppression!
This...was unquestionable and unbound Dignity just beginning to rise in thin threads

chapters.title: Chapter 3013 Osmont's Proof of Dignity! III
paragraphs: 3013 Osmont's Proof of Dignity! III
At this moment, it was as if even the statues of the Nine Dragons were paying attention to her!
All eyes were on her and her calm visage as she radiated an unbounded sense of Dignity!
Many Sanctus Knights had believed they knew and understood a fair bit about the abstruse and mysterious Sanctus Princess Sona who lived within their Sanctum of Dignity.
Today, they found out that they merely held a glimpse.
HUUM!
Along with the thick Tendrils of Dignity she released, a stellar set of stairs began to unfurl below her feet as they were exquisite in nature.
They didn't seem illusory- with each one being more massive than the last as to scale them...oh!
Sanctus Princess Sona replicated what Emilliana did, and in such a shockingly grand fashion as within a short instant, 1,000 luxurious golden steps inlaid with heavy dignity formed.
All the way to the feet of none other than Noah.
One entity above.
One entity below.
The Sanctus Princess Sona gazed at this unfolding reality with a mixture of apathy and calmness, her golden blue pupils now starting at Noah.
There was something about him she couldn't put her finger on.
Something on the edge of lips, and yet she couldn't quite grasp it.
It was an interesting weaving, and it was one of the reasons she went along with Emilliana's ruse!
Now, she gazed at the man below her. Was an interesting Weaving it, or was there more?
Her eyes were clear. She neither favored nor hated the man before her as she spoke lightly.
|Express your Dignity.|
Express your Dignity.
The first words that Sanctus Princess Sona utilized to address the Weaver of Extremity!
Following the ritual of Knighthood, Noah needs to now take these steps towards the Sanctus Princess to express just how his Dignity compared to hers.
To test the potential he had on himself and towards the Sanctus Populi.
But...he was Noah Osmont.
He now stood at the bottom of stairs as truly...was he someone who had to climb stairs for others?
HUUM!
In his body, deeply entrenched Tyranny began to rouse and pulse as tendrils of purple light around his body.
The weavings of what made him denied such an action.
His selfishness.
His tyranny.
His Quintessence.
His standing as the Protagonist!
The surroundings began to buzz as they saw the new one not take a single step, his Dominium instead beginning to give off a sense of unique pressure that they couldn't quite put a finger on.
Sanctus Princess Emilliana watched closely.
Sanctus Princess Sona raised her brows above as a light began to shine from the depths of the blue and gold.
She could sense his defiance.

She could sense a unique weaving rising within him that seemed to be so deeply filled with Dignity...even though it seemed this being had not fully expanded and flowed into the intricate weavings of this concept yet!
This caused the apathy in her eyes to fade as a bit more light shone through.
How could someone express this unique sense of Dignity even before they deeply delved into the weavings of its extreme?
Could there be something here?
Could-...!
A light of interest had only just begun to increase within Sanctus Princess Sona when she saw the right foot of this entity below her rise.
And the light of interest instantly faded.
It seemed that there was nothing new here.
He, just like all the others...did not even know what he didn't know.
Sona was about to close her eyes when...

She and all others saw the astounding scene of the visage of Noah not taking a step forward- but him simply bringing his foot down right where he was as this single action seemed to carry great weight and moment!
At the same time, his intent weaved out as it caused many gazes to change.
|My Dignity is not something that can be measured in such a manner.|
HUUM!
Who was he?
The Ninth Infernal Lord. The True Emperor of Quintessence! The Weaver of Extremity! He was Noah Osmont!
BOOM!
The instant his foot came down, the stairs built from an astounding sense of Dignity vibrated as starting with the one directly in front of Noah....it began to rise.
It rose along with his figure!
After the first stair, the ones following it also began to rise As his body was emanating a profound sense of magnetism towards the very makeup of Dignity on these stairs!
[Your very existence is immeasurably compatible with the Extemity of Dignity.]
[Your Foundation supports it.]
[Your Dominiums exude it.]
[Your Extremes, Records, and very Existence emanated it.]
[Your existence is grasping the Existential Extremity of Dignity directly as an Existential Authority.]
He didn't expand the concept to Extremity.
But when he attained the effect of Dignity...it was as an Existential Extremity Authority!
What could express Dignity more than this?
What could show a glimpse of the unfathomable Dignity that his existence held if not this?!
WU!
Illustrious golden light erupted from him amidst the Tyrannical purple, tendrils of Cerulean waves of Infinity mixing in as each one held its own weavings of Dignity.
A Colorless light of Quintessence spread as what else could be as dignified as it?
Every part of him seemed to show and express Dignity as the stairs that were descending all began to change from his end- rising along with him as they now formed a semilunar curvature.
Those watching were first astonished, and when his intent truly settled in, a sense of stifling anger arose.

But they could do nothing except watch as horrendously massive waves of Dignity erupted from Noah like serpents- and as if they were sentient, they grabbed onto the stairs and hoisted it upwards until the semilunar shape began to straighten out!
Until in a shocking expression of reality, the 1,000 stairs showed no descent as they became supremely flat.
As if it were a walkway.

Then, the astounding visage of the Weaver of Extremity releasing Serpentine tendrils of Dignity all around stepped on this golden path, his arms stretched out as if he were sending a challenge as his intent weaved out.
|Express your Dignity.|
The Weaver of Extremity spoke such words towards the Sanctus Princess Sona, his figure walking forward as his momentum rose boundlessly!

chapters.title: Chapter 3014 Osmont's Proof of Dignity! IV
paragraphs: 3014 Osmont's Proof of Dignity! IV
Her existence was a unique one.
She wasn't apathetic to everything because she thought herself above others.
She didn't participate in the workings and rituals of the Sanctus Populi not because she couldn't be bothered to, but because she had seen thighs others simply couldn't fathom!
The day she was born, she felt such immense pain that in trying to eliminate it, she nearly stripped away the source of the most powerful Existential Extremity Authority in the Domain she was in.

She saw too many things as on the Elder Queen Mother, on the Elder Queens, on the Sanctus Princess...all those she came across- their Dominiums were marked with an unbearably heavy darkness of oblivion and damnation.
They were all marked for destruction.

Bearing such knowledge the day she was born was a weight others couldn't even fathom, but it was her first years of life when she moved madly to prevent this fate, grasping weavings others couldn't even think of, connecting even to Omniversal Authorities...even with all of this, she found that nothing changed.
She looked further ahead.
She saw some possibilities.
Of people like her.
Those referred to as blessed by the Omniverse.
Those known as Omniversal Anomalies.
She theorized weavings of existence with such entities included, and tried to foresee far into the eons to come...but nothing changed.
Thus, she grew despondent.
She had all this power.
She had capabilities that this Sanctum of Dignity didn't even know half of.
And yet even with all of this power...she was essentially powerless.
No matter how much she tried to change things, it didn't matter!
So what use was all this power?
It grew to the point that she even stopped annealing her Dominium and let it be.
Whether she remained in the Teleios Stage or Teracosm Stage or further above, nothing changed.
So why bother?

This was the reason for her nonchalant and apathetic demeanor as to the Elder Queens, this was an affront to her blessings and power as they wanted her to do something- not Knowing she had tirelessly tried to do many things for them to no avail.
And now, here she was.
Doing something.
A process of Knighthood.
The light of apathy in her eyes was gradually drowned out by a light of interest the moment her expectations were defied- the moment this being made it clear he would not climb up!
He instead forcibly altered the weavings of Dignity she had laid down and made a pathway from the descending stairs- Dignity that Sona could see he was expressing for the first time truly!
And when he began walking towards her grandly as his intent told her to express her own Dignity...she finally understood something.
She finally realized what the thing she just couldn't put her thoughts on...the thing that caused her confusion when she first saw him.
All entities she looked at across this Dominium and those she studied the weavings of outside of it had a darkness.
A Shadow of Damnation.
She had seen it so much all of her life that she had actually blanked out...when she saw a being that didn't have this shadow.
Yes.
He didn't have the Shadow of Damnation!
Such a reality could mean many things as the moment she ascertained it...
BOOM!
Her figure flung forward with horrific speed and power across the golden path of Dignity.
BOOM!
From her body, solidified waves of golden Dignity erupted out in shockwaves that spread all around, the figures of Sanctus Knights feeling their Dominiums shuddering as they were flung back!
Only Sanctus Princess Emilliana and Dragon Knight Alder were among those nearby in this region who remained still even as their gazes changed.

In the distant space above the Nine Dragons statues, the visage of The Elder Queen Ariana that had just left reappeared, her gaze stern as moments later, other Elder Queens began to appear beside her!
All entities at the Teracosm Stage of Existential Dominium Realm.
One was shrouded in a purple light as she gazed down while her intent weaved calmly.
|That child actually did something for a change?|
The weaving was only meant for the Elder Queens who had come to observe the shocking fluctuations they felt.
And yet wondrously, far down on the golden path of Dignity, Sona heard the whispers of these intents easily as she felt all sources of Dominiums nearby.
Yes, she was doing something for a change.
Because she had to confirm.

She had to see if this Entity before her was an entirely new Omniversal Anomaly she hadn't come across before, and whether anything would change with the weavings she had seen before if he was incorporated.
The first test she sent out was uniquely still a test of Dignity.
Any Anomaly had to have an extremely high value as this entity before her had to be distinguished from a common existence to an uncommon one.
And as Teleios Stage Entities in the surroundings were knocked back from the shockwaves of pure Dignity she released...
HO!
The bustling visage of the entity opposite to Sona continued on the golden path of Dignity as if the shockwaves weren't even felt by him!
It didn't mean he was more powerful than Teleios Stage Entities- it only meant that when it came to Dignity, he far surpassed such beings!
'Good.'
The light in Sona's eyes began to shine even brighter.

She had shot forth with such blinding speed that she reached the halfway mark of the golden path of Dignity, and the Entity opposite to her had also reached the halfway point as they came inches away from each other- their dignity buzzing and warping the surrounding space as it felt like two fields were trying to establish their rulership!

Around her, shockwaves of Dignity burst constantly as from the entity opposite to her, snake like tendrils of Dignity supported by royal purple and colorless lights raged madly- some of these tendrils even beginning to form a throne behind him as if to show off his majesty!
She looked at this being closely.
And he seemed to be looking at her closely.

Sensing the deep waves and reserves of Dignity before her, she nodded to affirm that he at the very least had passed this benchmark- her eyes grasping as much of his weavings as she could as her intent weaved out.
|The name is Sona. You are?|
The weavings within this intent were simple.
And the one she asked pulsed with brilliance as he replied just as simply.
|Osmont, Noah Osmont.|
Behind him, unfathomable reserves of Dignity raged as Sona looked at them calmly while nodding, her next words being anything but simple.
|Osmont, do you want to join an Initiative?|
A question.
A question about something that no Elder Queens or Sanctus Princesses would even understand.

This was the result of Noah's Dignity being tested as around the two of them who were nonchalantly clashing with heavy waves of Dignity, Dragon Knights, Sanctus Princesses,and distant Elder Queens were gazing with calculative eyes carrying varying levels of shock!

sentences.text: 3014 Osmont's Proof of Dignity!
IV
Her existence was a unique one.
She wasn't apathetic to everything because she thought herself above others.
She didn't participate in the workings and rituals of the Sanctus Populi not because she couldn't be bothered to, but because she had seen thighs others simply couldn't fathom!
The day she was born, she felt such immense pain that in trying to eliminate it, she nearly stripped away the source of the most powerful Existential Extremity Authority in the Domain she was in.

She saw too many things as on the Elder Queen Mother, on the Elder Queens, on the Sanctus Princess...all those she came across- their Dominiums were marked with an unbearably heavy darkness of oblivion and damnation.
They were all marked for destruction.

Bearing such knowledge the day she was born was a weight others couldn't even fathom, but it was her first years of life when she moved madly to prevent this fate, grasping weavings others couldn't even think of, connecting even to Omniversal Authorities...even with all of this, she found that nothing changed.
She looked further ahead.
She saw some possibilities.
Of people like her.
Those referred to as blessed by the Omniverse.
Those known as Omniversal Anomalies.
She theorized weavings of existence with such entities included, and tried to foresee far into the eons to come...but nothing changed.
Thus, she grew despondent.
She had all this power.
She had capabilities that this Sanctum of Dignity didn't even know half of.
And yet even with all of this power...she was essentially powerless.
No matter how much she tried to change things, it didn't matter!
So what use was all this power?
It grew to the point that she even stopped annealing her Dominium and let it be.
Whether she remained in the Teleios Stage or Teracosm Stage or further above, nothing changed.
So why bother?

This was the reason for her nonchalant and apathetic demeanor as to the Elder Queens, this was an affront to her blessings and power as they wanted her to do something- not Knowing she had tirelessly tried to do many things for them to no avail.
And now, here she was.
Doing something.
A process of Knighthood.
The light of apathy in her eyes was gradually drowned out by a light of interest the moment her expectations were defied- the moment this being made it clear he would not climb up!
He instead forcibly altered the weavings of Dignity she had laid down and made a pathway from the descending stairs- Dignity that Sona could see he was expressing for the first time truly!
And when he began walking towards her grandly as his intent told her to express her own Dignity...she finally understood something.
She finally realized what the thing she just couldn't put her thoughts on...the thing that caused her confusion when she first saw him.
All entities she looked at across this Dominium and those she studied the weavings of outside of it had a darkness.
A Shadow of Damnation.
She had seen it so much all of her life that she had actually blanked out...when she saw a being that didn't have this shadow.
Yes.
He didn't have the Shadow of Damnation!
Such a reality could mean many things as the moment she ascertained it...
BOOM!
Her figure flung forward with horrific speed and power across the golden path of Dignity.
BOOM!
From her body, solidified waves of golden Dignity erupted out in shockwaves that spread all around, the figures of Sanctus Knights feeling their Dominiums shuddering as they were flung back!
Only Sanctus Princess Emilliana and Dragon Knight Alder were among those nearby in this region who remained still even as their gazes changed.

In the distant space above the Nine Dragons statues, the visage of The Elder Queen Ariana that had just left reappeared, her gaze stern as moments later, other Elder Queens began to appear beside her!
All entities at the Teracosm Stage of Existential Dominium Realm.
One was shrouded in a purple light as she gazed down while her intent weaved calmly.
|That child actually did something for a change?|
The weaving was only meant for the Elder Queens who had come to observe the shocking fluctuations they felt.
And yet wondrously, far down on the golden path of Dignity, Sona heard the whispers of these intents easily as she felt all sources of Dominiums nearby.
Yes, she was doing something for a change.
Because she had to confirm.

She had to see if this Entity before her was an entirely new Omniversal Anomaly she hadn't come across before, and whether anything would change with the weavings she had seen before if he was incorporated.
The first test she sent out was uniquely still a test of Dignity.
Any Anomaly had to have an extremely high value as this entity before her had to be distinguished from a common existence to an uncommon one.
And as Teleios Stage Entities in the surroundings were knocked back from the shockwaves of pure Dignity she released...
HO!
The bustling visage of the entity opposite to Sona continued on the golden path of Dignity as if the shockwaves weren't even felt by him!
It didn't mean he was more powerful than Teleios Stage Entities- it only meant that when it came to Dignity, he far surpassed such beings!
'Good.'
The light in Sona's eyes began to shine even brighter.

She had shot forth with such blinding speed that she reached the halfway mark of the golden path of Dignity, and the Entity opposite to her had also reached the halfway point as they came inches away from each other- their dignity buzzing and warping the surrounding space as it felt like two fields were trying to establish their rulership!

Around her, shockwaves of Dignity burst constantly as from the entity opposite to her, snake like tendrils of Dignity supported by royal purple and colorless lights raged madly- some of these tendrils even beginning to form a throne behind him as if to show off his majesty!

You are?|

|Osmont, Noah Osmont.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3015 The Initiative! I
paragraphs: 3015 The Initiative! I
Too many things worthy of note occurred.
One was the fact a new entrant actually had such shocking levels of Dignity to the extent it seemed to match someone as terrifying as Sanctus Princess Sona!
The other was of course the expression of Dignity from Sona herself, which only further amplified the shock regarding the being she faced.
The ritual of Knighthood was flipped over.
The stairs were never ascended.
The whole test of dignity was changed!
And as the two came face to face, their Dignity pulsed and emanated off of each other as all existence around them trembled.
At that moment, the Elder Queens in the far distance reacted and moved.
Who was this new entity?
How could his Dignity match someone who nearly wrestled the Source of Dignity away from the Elder Queen Mother? This had to be ascertained first and foremost!
Yet the moment they began to move...
The eyes of Sona flickered as she turned to gaze towards their direction, feeling like something critical was about to be sidetracked.
Her intent weaved out calmly as a unique power erupted from her, forming into an icy blue bubble in this region.
|Let's filter out what isn't important first.|

She didn't care for the rituals or what reaction those within the Sanctum of Dignity would have towards what had just occurred- and she needed to truly understand this being before her if the reality she had affirmed over and over again could change!
So she let him know of her intent.
And the icy bubble enveloped everything around them with a speed even Teracosm Stage Entities wouldn't easily grasp.
And...
POP!
With a flash of blue light, they disappeared.
Sanctus Princess Emilliana was astounded.

Elder Queen Ariana arrived on the walkway that now began to crumble along with a few other Elder Queens, her body trembling with visible anger as she couldn't sense Sona and the newly appearing entity with any of her weavings- her capabilities showing they far outstripped hers!
|SONA!|
Her bellow of anger was the only thing that reverberated out as a proof of one's Digbity turned out to be something far more than anyone imagined.
A moment after her eruption of anger, Elder Queen Ariana turned her blazing gold eyes towards the figure of Sanctus Princess Emilliana sharply.

The moment the icy blue bubble popped, the figures of two Entities disappeared from the Sanctum of Dignity that was contained with the source of an Existential Extremity Authority...and they actually went towards the Source of another Existential Extremity Authority!

Being capable of containing immense amounts of existence within the source of a concept showed how far along one was, with the prerequisite being someone powerful enough at the Teracosm Stage of Existential Dominium Realm.
Yet Sona defied this once more as they warped across existence and extremes to arrive at a new place.

All around, an icy blue expanse could be seen as stellar freezing galaxies rotated above and below, an immeasurably icy coldness spreading into one's Dominium naturally as they may feel a biting cold if they couldn't withstand it.
This...was within the Source of one of her main existential extremes.
The Source of the Existential Extremity Authority of Psychros!
Her gaze was studying the Weavings of many things as she turned to really look at the being she had brought here after asking him about joining her initiative.
An Initiative to stop what she could already see with her own eyes since eons ago.
It wasn't some ridiculous Apocalypse that she saw the weavings of.
The Omniverse was existentially stable.
Its workings too pristine for others to even fathom as a possibility of destruction for it was truly an impossibility.
It was them.
The Sanctus Populi.
Others.
The Shadow of Damnation covered them as this seemed to be their Omniversal fate! One that she couldn't even begin to change.
If she were to truly succeed, she would need to have enough power to do so. If she wasn't enough, there would have to be others.
Now, if there was someone who didn't even have this Shadow of Damnation on them, then she simply had to attain his services among others!
She may actually begin to follow the past weavings she foresaw and look for other anomalies- other Entities that may hold a similar uniqueness to her.
This was the Initiative.
Her initiative.
But first...Noah Osmont.
|You seem to freely be doing whatever you want.|
His voice echoed out as he moved around the Source of Psychros freely- as if its coldness didn't even have the chance to permeate into his existence!
Sona looked at this scene as she nodded with a reply.
|Yes. When you know what I know, you have to move as you wish. Otherwise, you get bogged down by unnecessary things easily.|
As she spoke, she looked at him up and down as if he were some interesting case study, nodding her head here and there as Noah raised his brows at such a demeanor!
Sona then stopped doing such actions and started straight at Noah, her icy gold blue eyes seemingly calculating the best way to move forward with this being as after a while, she continued.

|I asked you about joining an Initiative, but that may have been too many steps forward. You'll need some background...but the extent of it is that for a great deal of time now, I've glanced at the weavings of those like me. Those like you. Entities with some sort of pull with the Omniverse. I did so in order to change something unfavorable that is coming, but none of the theorized weavings have been successful so fa-|
|Hold on...|
Before she continued any further, Noah stopped her with a sigh as he asked with a sense of doubt.
|Don't tell me it's another Apocalypse. The Omniverse about to end and all that.|
His words caused the eyes of Sona to twitch as she shook her head in denial.
|No. The Omniverse is far too stable- something that very few can even comprehend. But it is an unchangeable path of Damnation that I've seen for the Sanctus Populi.|
Her words were calm even though she talked about such grave issues.
|But not just them.|
|The Imperium.|
|The Omniversal Pillagers.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3016 The Initiative! II
paragraphs: 3016 The Initiative! II
Her words were shocking ones!
She included the Sanctus Populi, The Imperium, and the Omniversal Pillagers all in one.
|I sense the weavings of Damnation on all of them without fail, and no matter what weavings I try to carry out, nothing can be changed so far. And thus...I came up with the idea of an Initiative.|
|An idea to create a force strong enough to overcome whatever it is that is set to bring damnation to all forces indiscriminately.|

|Though even with that idea, nothing has come of it as of right now. And yet on this day, I meet someone that unlike all of those I have seen and peered into...you do not carry the mark of Damnation. Your demise is not a thing that has been set in stone. So naturally...you may be a critical piece that may finally change the results of the millions of possible weavings I've discerned so far. Thus, I asked you to join my Initiative.|
After speaking this far, she silently stared at Noah as if she were waiting for him to take it all in.
And yet...he didn't show her much of a reaction of shock or concern, even when she told him of such shocking things!
Seeing this unfolding reality, the fair visage of Sona actually smiled with satisfaction while continuing.

|Good, you're the pragmatic type- likely wondering what you can obtain out of even a situation like this. I like that better than if you had been someone with a sense of righteousness who directly jumps into saying they will do what they can to save everyone. So, what could an Omniversal Anomaly like you want?|
HUUM!
Her eyes pulsed with liquified waves of Dignity.
She waved her hands to reveal golden circles of light all around her that showed different things within them, her intent pointing to each one.
|Various undiscovered and unexplored Unique Existential Domains that will have their dangers, yes, but also their boons.|
She pointed towards multiple circles of golden lights that showed different locations across the Omniverse, untouched by others and bustling with unknown wonders!
|A Teracosm License for the Existential Imperium Exchange, A Carapace of an Existential Pillager, or bundles of Unique Fruits of Existence...you can take your pick.|
The golden circles around her rotated like treasured circles of lights as among all of them, there was one blinding one that was clear and transparent.
It didn't show anything.
She brought such a circle to float behind her as in an instant, it was her face reflected in it.
|Even that may be possible for you attain- depending on how the weavings unfold.|
On that treasured circle of light, there was only her reflection.
Noah looked at this with a smile as his intent weaved out.
|You would even put yourself as a prize I would want? Are you planning on offering yourself to every anomaly you come across in order to get them to join your Initiative?|
WAA!
His words were sharp as Sanctus Princess Sona shook her head as if expecting them.

|Across the Omniverse, many things vary and change, but the nature of a Man remains the same. In the very depths of your drive for power and wonders, there lies a deep desire to dominate the most beautiful things in the Omniverse. A weapon. An extreme. A Record. A Woman. Such a desire is even more intense in men who stand out amongst others- thus, I know this method may work for you. And among the many beautiful things out there, very few surpass me.|
She spoke such brazen words with utmost confidence that any common being would be left dumbfounded!

|And as for offering myself as a prize for others, just that question there shows your need for possessiveness. To have something be yours and yours alone. Regarding that, I've already discerned which methodologies I need to utilize to attain the services of other Anomalies and bring them into the fold. Whether they stem from the Omniversal Pillagers, Sanctus Populi, or the Imperium.|
A mighty confident Sanctus Princess voiced out.
And Noah blinked at her before replying with sharp eyes.
|Who's to say that you are something I consider an ultimate prize? I have many partners that I can confidently say are no less than you.|
A challenging light arose.
And the dazzling figure of Sanctus Princess Sona placed her hand on her lips as she laughed genuinely for the first time.
As if this laugh alone answered the question regarding whether she was an ultimate prize!
|Look at me.|
She pointed to herself.
Her gorgeous visage.
Her dazzling existence.
Her icy gold aura!
|No, really look at me. Past the extremes, look at...this.|
HUUM!
Her body began to buzz in a shocking manner as the existence surrounding them...began to bend and distort around her.
The space within the Source of Psychros was seemingly bending to her will as she wasn't using any existential authorities to cause such actions!
She was pulling...on the weavings of the Omniverse itself.
|What Teracosm Stage Entities begin touching on.|
WAA!
|What I began to touch upon days after I was born.|
|Omniversal Authorities...something that many only hear about but cannot grasp. I can also lead you towards that as yes...I am the ultimate prize.|
Her level of confidence was utterly astounding to the extent that within Noah's mind...
[The Extremity of Tyranny appreciates the nature of the Entity before you.]
[The Extremity of Cheats states that she seems broken enough.]
[The Extremity of the Protagonist sneers and states that she needs to know her place as an extra in his Fable- that the Weaver of Extremity cannot just come under someone else's fold!]
[The Extremity of Extremity questions whether this being is merely an extra.]

The weavings of his extremes were also jumping on board with their own opinion as Noah took a moment to lock his gaze with the incredulous being before him, his intent weaving out moments later as he thought of the subject of Omniversal Authorities.
|You have my attention.|

paragraphs: 3017 The Initiative! III
She has his attention!
When Sona heard this, she nodded calmly as in the next moment, she proceeded to sit down where she stood.
Around her, intense weavings erupted out as she began to do something very few would understand!
|I have to get a glimpse of the weavings of future possibilities with you in the picture. While I do so...can you entertain me with more information about yourself?|
HUM!
From her small figure, a blazing golden light shot up with this Source of Psychros and melded with...the surrounding space itself.
Melded with the very Omniverse!
With her gorgeous figure bathed in such a shocking light, she closed her eyes while still speaking to Noah.

|For you to not have a mark of Damnation that even entities far stronger than you across the Omniverse have, it must mean you have something far outside the scope of what many would imagine...something that would routinely cause others to be shocked or in denial. Of course, this is your big secret so I won't peer directly into it, but I am curious about it since it should greatly affect things from here on out.|
Her eyes were closed as she did something profound, her Dominium Soul buzzing with existential authority as she continued!

|So...what could it be? I'm open minded- I won't suddenly start convulsing in shock and stutter while telling you how impossible what you have is. Nor can I steal or try to make it mine- it's nearly impossible to steal the Omniversal fortune of others...|
She stated that she wouldn't suddenly break down frothing at the mouth just from Noah stating what his power was.
At such an idea, Noah shook his head while replying.
|What if I don't feel comfortable telling you such sensitive information?|
|Then, I'll tell you about some of the Omniversal Anomalies we need to recruit, and you can compare yourself with them.| Her reply was sharp even though she was multitasking.

|Our first target for the Initiative is actually a pair- twins from the Imperium. A brother and sister whose Dominiums are linked in such a way that even if you cut one of them up and destroy them entirely, they would regenerate everything right after. So long as one of them among the pair is alive and well, the other cannot die. The two of them uniquely have Omniversal Magnetokinesis, giving them a semblance of Omniversal Authorities as they have already begun to sense the vibrations and string-like minute structure of the Omniverse.|

|Another is an Omniversal Pillager that thrives on devouring Extremes, Records, and Existence. To an extent, it can gain the power of the one it devours right away- along with all of their Extremes. This is a tricky one to get as I'll have to cross Existential barriers even moreso than the twins from The Imperium. Then, there is...oh?|
HUUM!
Her words came to a stop.
The dazzling S on her forehead shone brightly as the golden beam of light emulating from her and into the space above receded into her body.
And she opened her eyes while blinking with utterly profound light!
She then looked at Noah silently.
She was multitasking.
She had said she was observing the weavings of existence yet to occur that always remained the same before no matter what she tried.
It seemed that at this moment...she had seen something.
And it was something so profound that a sigh of relief and many emotions leaked from here a moment after.
As if she was releasing a heavy weight she couldn't change for too long!
Her fair left hand then propped her chin up with immeasurable charm as she blew on the locks of hair that came to cover the left side of her face.
It was a type of charm any man could go crazy over, and one couldn't be sure whether she was doing it intentionally or not!
|I don't know what it is about you that was able to cause Weavings of existence that led nowhere to actually have possible destinations...but all right. Have a seat.|
She straightened up while pointing to the area before her.
Noah read the weavings of Extremes and Existence flowing in this region as he also focused on this unique entity, his obsidian pants stretching as he came to sit down opposite to Sona.
His demeanor was that of a regal Emperor as opposite to him, Sona emanated such a profound aura that was actually able to match it!
In her seated position, an aurora of golden Dignity covered Sona head to toe as her right hand rose, her palm pointing towards Noah.
She looked into his eyes as if seeking answers to innumerable questions.

|Noah Osmont...I do not know you, nor do you know me. I had long since given up due to the impossibilities of every path I looked at, but I am putting myself into action once more due to your emergence. Are you ready?|
Was the Weaver of Extremity ready?
Was this even a question that had to be asked?!
A tyrannical light of Dignity arced around Noah as his own palm moved out, coming inches away from Sona's until ultimately...
HUUM!
Their palms touched.
An eruption of Dignity burst out as Noah's eyes released innumerable radiance.
And his intent weaved out.
|Show me.|
WAA!
Show me.
His intent was simple, and Sona did not need help in understanding it as she knew what this being wanted most right now.
With their palms connected, she began undulating with waves of pristine light, her red lips opening as her eyes locked onto the unique nine pupils within Noah's.

|Omniversal Authorities...the very makeup of the Omniverse that many try to study and manipulate, with those in the Teracosm Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm finding success as their existence has at that point been elevated to a critical threshold.|
|But then...there are those like you.|
She felt something from his palm.
His skin felt soft and rough at the same time, and it seemed to hold eons of transformations.
But through it, she could see a glimpse.
|You...have already begun to glimpse them, haven't you?|
A question that wasn't a question.
She nodded to it herself as she continued.
|Good, this will make it easier then. I'll expose you to a semblance of what I see. Doing this to others may harm them and overwhelm their existence, but yours seems big enough.|
BZZT!
Her palm began to buzz.
Along with it, all of the surrounding space began to twist and distort as it felt like everything was converging around them!

chapters.title: Chapter 3018 Omniverse 101! I
paragraphs: 3018 Omniverse 101! I
As if existence itself was converging around them.
Sona's expression became stern as she continued.

|The makeup of the Omniverse is something very few can understand precisely due to its stability. It doesn't naturally allow others to influence or control its weavings. And it's even harder to control its weavings as the makeup of the Omniverse...is made up of trillions of possibilities.|

|It is made up of countless combinations and transmutations of the Existential Domains that make it up. A single Omniversal Authority could be made up of the weavings of a thousand Existential Authorities, a hundred thousand...or a million Existential Authorities. This is why it is so exceedingly hard to even influence a single Omniversal Authority and affect the surrounding Omniverse to aid you in expressing your extremes, or in altering reality how you see fit.|
Noah's eyes shone brightly as from the palm of Sona, her fingers spread his wide open before they interlocked.
And through this interlock, he felt a pull of hundreds of existential authorities from Sona's hand.
Hundreds!

It didn't mean she held all of these, it simply meant she could influence them to an extent that they followed her will somewhat, and through it...she was able to gain access to an authority with the very makeup of the Omniverse around them!

|Funny, isn't it? Most people's Dominiums can hold a few Existential Extremity Authorities, with the more powerful one's Dominium is allowing them to expand this number. And yet there are millions of Existential Extremity Authorities weaving together to form the makeup of the Omniverse.|

One could work their whole life, utilizing countless Fruits of Existence, and they may never be able to have within them even a percentage of the Existential Authorities within the makeup of an Omniversal Authority!
As Noah listened to this....
HUUM!
His Dominium began to buzz.
More accurately, his Dominium Soul felt his Primordium Core begin to spin with immeasurable heaviness, Noah feeling something new blooming from it at this time.
[A Boon of your Primordium Core has been unlocked fully.]
[You have attained Omniversal Sense.]
Sense.
Starting from his Primordium Core, a sight seemingly expanded as if many things were foggy before.
As if he was a newborn baby opening up his eyes to something wondrous.
And as his eyes- as his Omniversal Sense opened...he began to see countless threads.
Countless strings.
Strings so numerous and so heavy that they could overwhelm a weak Dominium and destroy it just from them being observed!
Noah saw these countless threads weaving together in seemingly chaotic ways, and at the same time with an unknown order he could not place as he realized something!
He entered a state of epiphany as he spoke.
|The crux of their power...lies in how they come together, not simply what they're composed of.|
Sona raised her eyes and blinked at such words as she nodded with appreciation.

|Mmm, the same 1 million Existential Authorities weaved in different combinations and transmutations could yield the power of an entirely different Omniversal Authority, which makes it clear that any Omniversal Authority...can't necessarily have an owner.|
As she said this, her eyes flickered as she gazed in the far distance.
|Though if there is someone who fully grasps the countless combinations of authorities that make up even a single Omniversal Authority and they're able to make it there's...
well, that's a level of power to be feared. But...|
Her head turned back to Noah.
|The crux of influencing Omniversal Authority is this.|
Through their interlocked fingers, Noah felt waves of hundreds of Existential Extremity Authorities course through this area- as if they were invisible to him before but they were visible now.

|Because one's Dominium can barely handle a number of them, if we want to Influence Existential Extremity Authorities by the hundreds or thousands, a prerequisite is a strong and perceptive enough Dominium- this the Teracosm Stage, and...weaving your own Existential Extremes and Dominiums into the complex and chaotic weavings of the Omniversal Authority you wish to influence.|

|In this manner, let's say for example Dignity...I could mix it with the weavings of hundreds or thousands of Existential Extremes whose transmutations make up an Omniversal Authority, and it will seem like the very reality around me is magnifying Dignity and making it unshakable. But it is merely me borrowing the power of something I may not even know the name of.|
Yes!
Most didn't even have the power to understand the names of the Omniversal Authorities they borrowed the influence of.
And the more complex an Omniversal Authority was, the less was known about it.
A Teracosm Stage Entity may be able to influence the complex weaving of an Omniversal Authority made up of hundreds or thousands to achieve a shocking effect of power.
But what if one could influence the transmutations of weavings of hundreds of thousands? Of millions of Existential Authorities that made up the truly heavy Omniversal Authorities?
The answer was a terrifying one.
From Sona's hand, Noah felt the golden strings of Dignity mix in with the torrential flow of an unknown authority, and through this...
BOOM!
Sona's figure became unfathomably more brilliant.
Massive tendrils and seas of Dignity erupted all around her as the pressure she radiated far exceeded a Teleios Stage Entity!

|Of course, the successful weaving of your authority in an already complex weaving of hundreds or thousands is extremely hard, with such a thing taking a tremendous toll on one's Dominium as to offset this and for other uses, some forces designed something like...the Codex of Extremity.|
WAA!

|Something to act as an intermediary. Even if your Dominium Soul isn't strong enough to sense or understand how to influence Omniversal Authority, you could still borrow a semblance of their power through it. But at most, it would be the influence of an Omniversal Authority made up of hundreds or thousands of Existential Authorities.|
The Codex of Extremity!
The Tool of the Imperium!
Sona only just mentioned this before blinking and continuing.

|When I peer into the possibilities of weavings of the future paths, I glance at the movements of the complex existential authorities flowing all around me, and those from afar. From them, I was able to learn that the weavings to come show existence itself twisting and turning, and turning again, until the weavings of countless existences and non-existences fade all the same...|

Splendorous light erupted from Noah as Sona said her last words- his Dominium buzzing while recalling the prophecy the Protagonist had uttered after it was influenced by something foreign around Noah!
[Twist and turn, and turn again, all existence and non-
existence shall bend all the same!]
Similar words also appeared from Sona who had been peering into the weavings of Omniversal Authorities much earlier than Noah!

chapters.title: Chapter 3019 Omniverse 101! II
paragraphs: 3019 Omniverse 101! II
The Prophecy of the Protagonist.
It stated and repeated about twists and turns, and turns again over and over- and it was too distinct for Noah to hear the same phrasing from another Entity for him to ignore!

Towards the midpoint of the Protagonist stating his prophecy, his Primordium Core that had now given birth to his [Omniversal Sense] had buzzed and emulated an interference from the surroundings themselves.
From the Omniverse itself.
From the complex weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities that Sona had been looking at in a distant area!
The latter part of the Prophecy Noah had produced...was influenced by either an Omniversal Authority or multiple Omniversal Authorities.
Or specific weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities mixed in with Omniversal Authorities!
There were too many possibilities.
There were too many unknowns.

As these thoughts surged within his head, Sanctus Princess Sona continued, her interlocking fingers grasping down with even greater force as she channeled tendrils of weavings of hundreds of Existential Extremity Authorities through her hand and towards Noah's.

|The difficulty of influencing Omniversal Authorities never eases, with it being difficult to always locate a single Omniversal Authority you are familiar with all the time. Thus, those who truly understand things take the stance of not familiarizing themselves with a single or a few Omniversal Authorities, but making themselves proficient in learning and grasping the weaving of any Omniversal Authority around them to influence reality on their behalf.|
This was a lifelong journey.
Ultimately, it came down to understanding the complexity and how countless transmutations of weavings came together.
When this was under control, one could influence any Omniversal Authority, wherever they were, at any time.
|Do you get it?|
Sona blinked her bright eyes while looking at Noah who seemed lost in thought.
Yet in the next moment...
HUUM!
His eyes closed.
His Omniversal Sense stemming from his Primordium Core then took center stage as he didn't rely on his vision, on his will, aura, or any other senses!
Just the Omniversal Sense.
Akin to this being his only tool to see!
And he saw countless weavings of tendrils and strings all around him.
He felt like if he sent his Existential Authority up to these weavings, he could pull them down just slightly for them to support whatever he wanted to do.
But, there were already hundreds of Tendrils that Sona had already called down flowing between his fingers.
He caught a glimpse of their weavings.
Each one seemed to take its own unique path, with its own vibrations and constant snake-like looping as if it formed a set of coordinated flows of data!

And Noah...had to insert his own data into all of this, have it not be buried down into oblivion, and instead integrate with the flow of whatever Omniversal Authority in order to borrow its influence.
In order to borrow the influence of hundreds of Existential Extremity Authorities!

To accomplish such a feat required one's Dominium to first even be capable of seeing and following these complex weavings, and to then be strong enough, have an existential authority that was strong enough...or skip multiple parts of this process by relying on something like the Codex of Extremity.
Noah had the Omniverse Sense as he grasped the tumultuous waves and vibrations of hundreds of authorities.
And now, his Primordium Core began to buzz as he channeled an authority through it.
The milky white light it released became even thicker as its spinning connecting all three of his Dominiums churned faster!
[You have arrived at a fantastical precipice!]
[You have seen the weavings of the Omniverse.]
[Now, you seek to borrow a semblance of their power.]
HUUM!
Vibrations boomed.
And tendrils of a cerulean blue authority rose.

[The weavings of Infinity flow out from you and towards the chaotic weavings of hundreds of authorities concentrated in a single Omniversal Authority amidst a deluge of an unknown number of Omniversal Authorities.]
[The cost is high.]
[But you emanate the weavings of Infinity!]
BOOM!
An action capable of heavily draining the reserves of a Teleios Stage Entity, leaving them without another move momentarily.
Behind Noah, tendrils of Infinity unfurled like gorgeous blue rivers of light, and his hand clasping Sona's moved in control for the first time as the gorgeous cerulean tendrils of Infinity...
flowed into the complex weavings of hundreds of other Existential Extremity Authorities.
Into the heavy force and power of an Omniversal!
SAA!
It didn't crack. It didn't get devoured.

It stably followed the weavings, twists and turns of the few hundred authorities as an instant later...Infinity began borrowing the force of what all of these Existential Authorities made up- as it was the only sentient weaving here!
At such a time.
Sona's eyes blinked.
Behind Noah, she first saw the blooming of a few tendrils of Cerulean light that after a moment disappeared into the weavings of the Omniverse itself.
And thereafter...an aggressive, mighty, and utterly unfathomable blue sea instantly bloomed behind him!
It bore such a heavy pressure as it was something that would be able to suffocate a common Teleios Stage Entity!
The suppression of a Teleios Stage Entity was possible only because this power normally belonged to those above this Stage- and thus they couldn't truly defend against it.
Before Noah gorgeously and successfully infused his authority to borrow the Influence of an Omniversal Authority for the first time, Sona had asked Noah where he was getting it.
At this moment, surrounded by a vastly stretching blue sea of Infinity that could come crashing down on his enemies, his eyes opened as he replied to Sona.
|Yeah, I think I got it.|
Sona quietly blinked.

She unhooked her palm from Noah and stared at the vast blue ocean behind him, seeing how the icy source of Psychros in the surroundings began to weave cheerfully towards the endless sea and begin to turn its brilliance into glaciers, only to have even vaster swathes of these seas proliferate.
She nodded with appreciation while giving two thumbs up.

|Nice work, big guy. I told you that I wouldn't start getting into epileptic shock if you say or do something amazing in front of me- even if it's the instant initial understanding of how to influence your power with Omniversal Authorities. But now, you've gained the first boon from me as...are you ready to get started with the work of the Initiative?|

Or specific weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities mixed in with Omniversal Authorities!
There were too many possibilities.
There were too many unknowns.

As these thoughts surged within his head, Sanctus Princess Sona continued, her interlocking fingers grasping down with even greater force as she channeled tendrils of weavings of hundreds of Existential Extremity Authorities through her hand and towards Noah's.
|The difficulty of influencing Omniversal Authorities never eases, with it being difficult to always locate a single Omniversal Authority you are familiar with all the time.

Thus, those who truly understand things take the stance of not familiarizing themselves with a single or a few Omniversal Authorities, but making themselves proficient in learning and grasping the weaving of any Omniversal Authority around them to influence reality on their behalf.|
This was a lifelong journey.
Ultimately, it came down to understanding the complexity and how countless transmutations of weavings came together.
When this was under control, one could influence any Omniversal Authority, wherever they were, at any time.
|Do you get it?|
Sona blinked her bright eyes while looking at Noah who seemed lost in thought.
Yet in the next moment...
HUUM!
His eyes closed.
His Omniversal Sense stemming from his Primordium Core then took center stage as he didn't rely on his vision, on his will, aura, or any other senses!
Just the Omniversal Sense.
Akin to this being his only tool to see!
And he saw countless weavings of tendrils and strings all around him.
He felt like if he sent his Existential Authority up to these weavings, he could pull them down just slightly for them to support whatever he wanted to do.
But, there were already hundreds of Tendrils that Sona had already called down flowing between his fingers.
He caught a glimpse of their weavings.
Each one seemed to take its own unique path, with its own vibrations and constant snake-like looping as if it formed a set of coordinated flows of data!

And Noah...had to insert his own data into all of this, have it not be buried down into oblivion, and instead integrate with the flow of whatever Omniversal Authority in order to borrow its influence.
In order to borrow the influence of hundreds of Existential Extremity Authorities!

To accomplish such a feat required one's Dominium to first even be capable of seeing and following these complex weavings, and to then be strong enough, have an existential authority that was strong enough...or skip multiple parts of this process by relying on something like the Codex of Extremity.
Noah had the Omniverse Sense as he grasped the tumultuous waves and vibrations of hundreds of authorities.
And now, his Primordium Core began to buzz as he channeled an authority through it.
The milky white light it released became even thicker as its spinning connecting all three of his Dominiums churned faster!
[You have arrived at a fantastical precipice!]
[You have seen the weavings of the Omniverse.]
[Now, you seek to borrow a semblance of their power.]
HUUM!
Vibrations boomed.
And tendrils of a cerulean blue authority rose.

[The weavings of Infinity flow out from you and towards the chaotic weavings of hundreds of authorities concentrated in a single Omniversal Authority amidst a deluge of an unknown number of Omniversal Authorities.]
[The cost is high.]
[But you emanate the weavings of Infinity!]
BOOM!
An action capable of heavily draining the reserves of a Teleios Stage Entity, leaving them without another move momentarily.
Behind Noah, tendrils of Infinity unfurled like gorgeous blue rivers of light, and his hand clasping Sona's moved in control for the first time as the gorgeous cerulean tendrils of Infinity...
flowed into the complex weavings of hundreds of other Existential Extremity Authorities.
Into the heavy force and power of an Omniversal!
SAA!
It didn't crack.
It didn't get devoured.

It stably followed the weavings, twists and turns of the few hundred authorities as an instant later...Infinity began borrowing the force of what all of these Existential Authorities made up- as it was the only sentient weaving here!
At such a time.
Sona's eyes blinked.
Behind Noah, she first saw the blooming of a few tendrils of Cerulean light that after a moment disappeared into the weavings of the Omniverse itself.
And thereafter...an aggressive, mighty, and utterly unfathomable blue sea instantly bloomed behind him!
It bore such a heavy pressure as it was something that would be able to suffocate a common Teleios Stage Entity!
The suppression of a Teleios Stage Entity was possible only because this power normally belonged to those above this Stage- and thus they couldn't truly defend against it.
Before Noah gorgeously and successfully infused his authority to borrow the Influence of an Omniversal Authority for the first time, Sona had asked Noah where he was getting it.
At this moment, surrounded by a vastly stretching blue sea of Infinity that could come crashing down on his enemies, his eyes opened as he replied to Sona.
|Yeah, I think I got it.|
Sona quietly blinked.

She unhooked her palm from Noah and stared at the vast blue ocean behind him, seeing how the icy source of Psychros in the surroundings began to weave cheerfully towards the endless sea and begin to turn its brilliance into glaciers, only to have even vaster swathes of these seas proliferate.
She nodded with appreciation while giving two thumbs up.
|Nice work, big guy.

I told you that I wouldn't start getting into epileptic shock if you say or do something amazing in front of me- even if it's the instant initial understanding of how to influence your power with Omniversal Authorities.
But now, you've gained the first boon from me as...are you ready to get started with the work of the Initiative?|

chapters.title: Chapter 3020 Omniverse 101! III
paragraphs: 3020 Omniverse 101! III
Was he ready to get started with the work of the Initiative?
Hearing such a question, Noah waved his hands to pull back the weavings of Infinity carefully from the complex transmutations of data around him.
His first successful entry and exit into borrowing the influence of the Omniverse itself!
He nodded in appreciation while replying to Sona.
|You speak as if I've already joined your club.|
Sona blinked sharply for a moment, a silent aura rising around her as she placed her hand on her chin once more in a carefree manner while voicing her intent.
|I see. You're the big bad Omniversal Anomaly who doesn't have the Mark of Damnation, so you wouldn't just be added under someone else's thing...is that it?|
At her words, Noah smiled brightly while nodding with appreciation.
|I like how you catch onto things fast, it saves me a lot of the taking.|
His visage emanated unbound majesty and tyranny as he spoke, causing Sona to sigh as she waved her hands.
|All right- partners. How about Founders of the Initiative? You can stomach that? After all, I do take the lead in who the stronger one is between us at this moment.|
|Oh?|
Noah asked while recalling how this Entity, at the Teleios Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm, had been whipping the ass of a Teracosm Stage Elder Queen!
And as if to further cement her words as the truth, she nodded towards Noah as she raised her hands and...
The purple light of her Dominium Soul...began to blaze with a golden brilliance!
WAA!
A glorious golden brilliance of Teracosm!
This ridiculous Entity really lived up to her distinction as an anomaly as she began taking her Dominium from one stage to another at will.
At will!
Others spent eons forever remaining at the Teleios Stage.
Others had to resort to an enormous amount of Fruits of Existence if they could afford it!
Yet she...
Even Noah couldn't help but nod towards her with appreciation as she smiled with a sense of mischief and confidence.

|Sometimes, one's Dominium can be unique by nature, or forcefully made to be so. One can accumulate so much existence within themselves to the extent that what others find hard, for them, it is simple. One's Existential Extremity Authorities are a factor, their Foundations, the type of Dominium.|
As she spoke, the golden aura of Teracosm around her only blazed brighter as nearly 10% of her purple aura was already turned into liquified gold!

|It's been established that the easiest Dominium to raise is one's Body, followed by Origin, and then of course the Soul. It's why most of those you will meet have a Dominium Soul even though it's the hardest to raise, but its cruciality remains undeniable when it comes to Extreme and survivability. But of course, you have some terrifying beings who take the easier path of the Dominium of the Body and become living weapons- faster than one can even weave anything with their Origins or Souls as theyfind themselves dead before they even know it. So really...it doesn't matter in the end.|
Her explanation was lengthy as she did something that would be impossible for others.
Noah nodded at her intent as he replied with his own.
|Very well, Founders of this Initiative.|
A brief silence came as Sona closed her eyes momentarily.
A small decision for some may be a tremendous moment for others.
A small smile appeared on Sona after the first members of the Initiative were decided, her eyes soon becoming determined as her intent flowed.
|So, Founders, and the perks I mentioned before.|
The perks she mentioned before...
Noah's eyes curved into smiles at this as he rose up while stretching his body.
|And when do I get to have the perk right in front of me?|
He unabashedly looked at her gorgeous figure as Sanctus Princess Sona actually rose up and turned around to show her curves and blessed chest with a serious face of contemplation!
It was enough to cause the Dominiums of weaker men to turn weak, yet the Weaver of Extremity observed calmly.

|I know I'm stunning. But you won't get to have any of this just yet as I have to keep dangling something in front of you, don't I? Let the tension build. Can you imagine the anticipation and finally getting something you really want that's been in front of your eyes this whole time? Oh, and you mentioned you have multiple others just as stunning as me right? Then I'm even more confident in your strength in waiting- let's get some work done first.|
Her face was filled with shamelessness and confidence as she spoke, with her right hand rising to punch the air above the Source of Psychros they were in as a massive portal began to form.
Noah looked at it as he could see the statues of the 9 Dragons gazing forward menacingly, auras of multiple Entities filled with mad power still raging as he nodded.
|I did come here for the Sanctus Populi...|
He came for the possible knowledge and opportunity of the Sanctus Populi, and he instead found Sona and her Initiative, along with an introduction of the overall Omniverse and Omniversal Authorities!
At his words, Sona nodded as she began to float upwards.

|Yes. As much as I wish to ignore everything unnecessary, your name has to begin carrying weight and distinction at least within the Sanctus Populi, otherwise those old crooks will begin making things more annoying.|
Her eyes were placid.
Noah had no issues with her intent as he also floated up, his intent coming out slowly.
|Since you claim to be familiar with me and my character, it's safe to assume you aren't about to come out and say that I've been chosen as your Knight to serve you?|
Sona's eyes twinkled at his words.
As her figure filled with mesmerizing golden Dignity surged up, her icy glow of Psychros covered her intent entirely as she only smiled!
HUUM!
Space twisted and tore as they left the Source of Psychros.
Leaving was always faster than coming in as within moments...
WAP!
They disappeared from the Source of Psychros.
Now the question was...what status would Noah have within the Sanctus Populi?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3021 The Existential Omniversal Guider! I
paragraphs: 3021 The Existential Omniversal Guider! I
From the Source of Psychros.
Back into the Source of Dignity where the Sanctum of Dignity was contained!
The transition happened quickly as at this moment, Sanctus Princess Emilliana was surrounded by three Elder Queens who hard sharp regal expressions.
Elder Queen Ariana was at the center as she repeated a name again and again.
|Osmont...you just go ahead and pick someone up while trusting your weavings, and it just so turns out that he is someone with Dignity nearly rivaling that freak?|

Emilliana shook her head with a wry smile as she wanted to remind the Elder Queens that they still stood between the 9 statues, with Trainee Knights and other Dragon Knights present as by now, a few other Sanctus Princess had come due to the commotion.
But before Emilliana could even reply.
|That freak?|
An intent came up behind them as nine had discerned it.
|Yes, a Frea-...!| Elder Queen Ariana didn't continue as her expression instantly became stern while turning around.
The sparkling eyes of Sona burning with a myriad of lights stared calmly towards her as moments later, the visage of Noah whom she had left with also appeared to her right.
No intents weaved out.
And just as they were about to...
The pupils of the Elder Queens dilated.
Sanctus Princess Emilliana and others soon followed as at the forefront, Elder Queen Ariana pointed towards the liquified golden glow on Sona's body as she couldn't finish her words!
|You...you...!|
Not a purple glow around her Dominium.
It was a glorious glow of gold beginning to form as it represented Teracosm!
But in such a moment of shock and surprise about something that should in no way be possible...
|Yeah yeah...| Sona waved her hands dismissively while coming to point at Noah and continuing.
|I shall complete my duties as Sanctus Princess by taking on another to join me.|
Her proclamation caused those before her to be dazed before their expressions changed greatly.
Sanctus Princess Emilliana was more baffled than all as even though she set this up, she didn't think it would truly unfold this way!
The shock of her somehow achieving the Teracosm Stage so freely was suffocated and pressed down as they were all forced to now focus on this issue.
What had moved her staunch little sister to take a Dragon Knight? What quality did she see within Osmont after she had a genuine glimpse at him apart from his exceedingly high Dignity?
For him to be her first Dragon Knight...
|He will not be joining me as a mere Dragon Knight, but as a Sanctus Prince at this moment. I have already completed the rituals and bound my Dominium to his.|
What?
The minds of those nearby stopped working briefly.
They thought they misheard.
They must have misheard!
And yet the nonchalant expression on Sona made it clear that they had not misheard!

Immense silence descended in the surroundings as nearly all were momentarily too shocked to reply, this silence only becoming broken as a dazzling Golden light bloomed from Elder Queen Ariana akin to an all-engulfing volcano.
|You unholy fucking brat!|
An event of immense significance occurred within the Sanctum of Dignity as the Elder Queens couldn't help but erupt.
Sanctum Prince.
A distinction of heavy weight that held too many meanings- and one that could only be granted after the permission from the Elder Queen Mother and the Sanctus Empress herself.
Yet Sona...
Oh, Sona!
The unfolding reality within the Sanctum of Dignity unfolded before Noah's Dominium Soul as he kept a close eye on it.

Back within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, his main body was watching the stabilization of his son's Dominiums as like him, he was leading him towards the path of eventually forming a Primordium Core of his own!
But at this time, there were also the gains from him gaining the capability to influence his first Omniversal Authority to express his own Extremes in a fundamentally shocking manner.
His mind was filled with the workings of Omniversal Authorities and their makeup of thousands or even millions of Existential Extremity Authorities that no single being could grasp.
No single being...could hold that many Extremes as those starting at the Teracosm Stage could only allow their own extremes to flow in the complex weavings of these authorities to borrow their power.
No single being could do it.
But then, there was him.
When he arrived here, Noah had to ask himself and ponder regarding his Omniversa Emperor Lineage.
It held a wondrous Creed that recorded as many Existential Extremes as those who had Noah's lineage held!
If his Lineage spread far and wide.
If his Creed began to proliferate and countless millions Recorded their own unique Existential Extremes.
The possibilities were endless.
But for this, his people had to also be capable and proficient in forming their own Existential Extremes.
For this....
[The Extremity of Cheats rises and states that it has an answer.]

A wondrous extreme stood up amidst Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities, flowing its heavy tendrils of brilliance within his Primordium Core where a dense number of Dominium Rules were being set up even now!
[Cheats looks back through time and remembers.]
[Cheats remembers the distinctions of the Unruly Guide, of the Golden Guider, of the Dark Guider...]
[The Extremity of Cheats urges the spinning of your Primordium Core and puts to use all Existential Extremity Authorities for another Existential Distinction to be brought to fruition.]
[The Extremity of the Protagonist rises with unbound regality and states that this is his specialty!]
His extremes began to work.

In the surroundings, Henry woke up from his stupor as he stabilized his Dominium- and he along with all others could only observe as a brilliant light bloomed from Noah and shot up to the distant space far above the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed...and beyond it.
The reason for this was because for what Noah's extremes sought to accomplish...even the aid of the influence of the Omniverse was sought after!
Being the first extreme to experience the complex weavings of an Omniversal Authority, massive tendrils of blue light surged upwards first as...
[The Extremity of Infinity forges the road towards a new Distinction.]
[The Extremity of Cheats states that the Distinction shall be known as The Existential Omniversal Guider!]
