chapters.title: Chapter 3022 The Existential Omniversal Guider! II
paragraphs: 3022 The Existential Omniversal Guider! II
The Existential Omniversal Guider.
This was the Distinction that Cheats sought to bring to fruition as none of Noah's extremes denied it.
They worked in conjunction like a well oiled machine as at the center point of his Dominiums, his Primordium Core radiated the most potent milky white light!
A light that even seemed ready for the jump into the next Stage soon- so long as enough resources were granted to it.
As it rotated, it released a gravitational pull that was seemingly pulling on the surrounding space itself- the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed and the Omniverse itself outside of it!
Within moments, Noah's Will felt itself melding with the countless threads and strings of the Omniverse.

It was an overwhelming sensation as he didn't focus on the complex and heavy clusters of thousands or millions of strings that made up a single Omniversal Authority- with his will likely being crushed the moment it tried to enter those as he focused on the clusters of a few hundred Existential Extremity Authorities.
He focused on Omniversal Authorities with the lost numbers of weavings as within moments...
HUUM!

As if the Omniverse dipped and came towards him, an indescribable flow had its momentum carried by Noah, his Extremes beginning to follow the flow of its weaving ever so slowly as his body began to vibrate with a heavy light of power!
A power that made his Vassals in the surroundings feel as if he had become some massive giant of an existence, and they were as small as ants.
It was but a mere glimpse of the manifestation and difference of their power.
After his Extremes pulled on the influence of the Omniverse itself...
[The distinction of the Existential Omniversal Guider is being etched onto your Existence.]
[The features of the Existential Omniversal Guider are being defined in real time.]
[Your existence is not yours alone for you to benefit from.]
[You hold the connections and intricate weavings of countless others as even before you held this distinction, you were their Guider.]

[On this day, under the influence of an unknown Omniversal Authority, this distinction has been fully carved out as you can begin your path. You can guide the lost Existences out there who know nothing of being at the center of a grand Fable!]

Stemming from far above, a pillar of blinding golden light smashed on Noah as it contained the affirmation and authority of the Existential Omniversal Guider, his eyes opening wide at such a moment as in the background, he could hear the Extremity of Cheats cackling.
He looked at his people.
And he saw those who could look at him in the eyes even with his blinding glory, and those who had to avert their gazes.
He looked at his son stabilizing his Realm, and at his partners gazing at him with unfathomable profundity.
He gazed at all of them before he waved his hands and voiced out.
|Gather.|
HUUM!

With a beckoning of his hands and his intent, a force wrapped around all of his people here as they were converged towards a central space before him- a miniature Aletheian Haven forming below their feet.
His son, the Queens of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, and those with the purest concentration of his lineage, and those most powerful were at the forefront.
And Noah came to float in front of them all, his royal Emperor's Robe fluttering with brilliance as existential light was leaking from him!
And then, his intent weaved out.
[What is Extremity? What are Records? And just what is Existence?]

As he spoke, his body seemed like a center point where sparkling existential authority that looked like swirling galaxies were emanating from, and these galaxies of pure Existential Authority came to bathe his people ahead of him.
And in front of their eyes, shocking prompts rose.
[You are blessed to be receiving the first Quintessential Guidance of the Existential Omniversal Guider!]
The first prompt was the same for everyone.
Thereafter, they varied based on who they were and their level of power!
In front of the eyes of the Daughter of Hatred, Lilith.
[You have achieved the Ninth Gradation of Extremity as there lies a thin barrier between that and the endless Dominium Skies.]
[Listen to the words of the Existential Omniversal Guider, and this thin barrier will break as if it never existed.]
WAA!
Drops of Existential Authority landed on her as she felt an inflow of information.
Information from someone who had entirely scaled the Gradations of Extremity in a manner very few others could even compare to!
And even as this information flowed, the intent of the Guider continued to echo out.

|The crux of the Existential Dominium Realm lies within your own Existence. Have you defined it with the concept that matches you the most? Have you lived up to the extremes of that concept to take it to the Existential level?|
The words caused Lilith to tremble as if she were in a trance.
Had she lived up to Hatred? Was it what filled her existence fully?
When she really thought about this, she couldn't help but nod towards herself as the moment she did so...
BOOM!
She felt Hatred exploding within her and beginning to transform.

The particles of Existential Extremity Authority all around her stemming from the Guider flowed into her calmly as in the next instant...Hatred began to shine with the initial brilliance of the Existential level!
But it wasn't her alone.
From the ancient visage of Steel.
The Existential Extremity Authority of Steel began to rise.
From Ishtar
From Sargon.
From Barbatos...obsidian skulls of existential light began to surround her as Necromancy surged towards the Existential level!
From Athena, an illusion of a massive golden spear shot from her and tore the space above as the Existential light covered the Extremity of the Spear!
One by one, all of Noah's people were bathed with ridiculous guidance as one by one, they each attained their own Existential Extremity Authorities!

chapters.title: Chapter 3023 The Existential Omniversal Guider! III
paragraphs: One after another.

Within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, multiple entities in the Gradations of Extremity attained their first Existential Extremity Authority as after this...they just had to reinforce and anneal their existence.
Thereafter, the Existential Dominium Realm waited.
An Endless Dominium Sky waited!
While voicing out his intent, Noah looked at this scene with sharp eyes as while they were receiving their own prompts and climbing up, so was he!
{Under your Guidance, multiple extremes are being shown the way towards the Existential level.}

{Those who have taken the lessons of the Existential Omniversal Guider will gain the permanent buff of Quintessential State of Epiphany- with their existence prone to epiphanies that aid them towards the Dominium Sky and across it.}
{An existential corrective effect is applied to all those under your guidance once they attain a single Existential Extremity.}
{The process of annealing and reinforcing the Existence of those under your Guidance is increased by 10,000%}
{The chances of successfully forming their Dominium is increased by 50%}
{Once in the Dominium Realm, the construction and release of Dominium Rules will be smoother, increasing their Existential effect by 100% and cutting their resources cost by 80%}
{All those Guided by you who manage to step into the Primordium Dominium Realm will be granted the distinction of Existential Supporting Character.}
{For Existential Supporting Characters, all prior relevant boons are increased by two times, while their progression across the Dominium Sky is elevated by another 1,000%}

{Depending on the gulf between the Existential Omniversal Guider and the Existential Supporting Characters, their elevation across the Stages of the Dominium Skies can remain 1,000%, or be skewed as high as 1,000,000%. The larger the gulf of power and realm, the greater the percentage of progression generated.}
A wondrous array of boons came from the Existential Omniversal Guider as it sought to make his people into living weapons.
Into characters that wouldn't be forgotten and discarded!

And this was shown more closely by Noah's own Son as he was the first and only one after him to enter the Primordium Stage, and he found his three Dominiums to be shaking while pulling upon his Existential Extremity Authority of Destiny, rapidly beginning to reinforce themselves as they hungrily sought resources.
And his existence began to rise!
He...would merely be the first.
Yet another dazzling prompt befell Noah amidst all this.
{Your Lineage is pulsing with excitement as the Creed of the Existential Omniversal Emperor is facing the inclusion of multiple Existential Extremity Authorities.}
His lineage which was already heavy became even heavier.

He began to amass access to a large number of Existential Extremity Authorities even if they weren't bound to his own Dominium, and he looked far into the future for a possibility others couldn't even fathom.
Could he...be capable of forming his own Omniversal Authority after gaining access to hundreds of Existential Extremity Authorities within his Creed? Within his lineage?!
The question was one for the future.
But for now, he continued to guide them towards greater strength as a lesson by the Existential Omniversal Guider continued!
Within the Sanctum of Dignity.
Behind the statues of the nine massive dragons, there were clusters of many planes of Existences that held an uncountable number of people with their own dreams and beliefs.
At this moment, within one of the largest Planes of Existence towards the center of the Sanctum of Dignity.
Inside a garden hidden somewhere within the weavings of this Plane of Existence, a woman who seemed to be in her 50s could be seen- her demeanor that of utmost regality and maturity.

Her hair was verdant gold as she was adorned in a white robe currently, her hands holding a pitcher of water that gushed out rivers of liquids that pulsed with more existential authority than the body of a Teleios Stage Entity!
The garden around her was the size of ten football fields as there were multicolored plants all around, their branches budding to show dazzling Fruits of Existence coming to light.
It was the ultimate scene of peace and serenity that moments after...
WAP!
Was interrupted as a figure appeared behind the gorgeous and regal entity tending to her garden.
|Elder Queen Mother...something has happened.|
An Elder Queen of Ariana's caliber bowed whole speaking like this, her intent continuing.
|Lady Sona has...|
|I know.|
Her words didn't finish.
The Elder Queen Mother tending to her garden didn't even turn around as she stated that she knew, surprising the Elder Queen bowing as they shifted their stance before nodding and continuing!
|She has proclaimed to take a newly entering Entity as her Sanctus Prince, and she has already ignored all Elder Queens to bring him to the Sanctus Sea of Rebirth, Queen Mother, this...|
The words were those of hesitation as the Elder Queen didn't know how to proceed.
Do they try to stop Sona?
When someone like her could already thrash Elder Queen Ariana when she was in the Teleios Stage Realm, and now she was stepping into the Teracosm Stage.
Towards her worries...the Elder Queen Mother waved her hands dismissively.
|Let her do as she wishes. She must have a good reason to do so...|
The bowing Elder Queen was astounded as she grit her teeth and bowed down even further.
Sometimes, even she didn't understand the stance that the Queen Mother took when it came to Sona.
But she would listen and obey. For that was her job.
|Yes, Queen Mother.|
With a glimmer of light, the Elder Queen disappeared to let the will of the Queen Mother be known.
The gorgeous woman left behind only smiled as she sensed everything occurring within her Sanctum of Dignity.
Was she always giving Sona too much free reign?
This was a question amongst many Elder Queens as they didn't know what she knew.
They truly didn't understand the extent and terror that this girl represented, to the extent that even the Sanctus Empress far, far away from here was paying attention to her!

chapters.title: Chapter 3024 The Sanctus Sea of Rebirth!
paragraphs: They truly didn't understand the thing named Sona as the day she was born and almost caused the Source of Dignity to change owners, it wasn't because the Elder Queen Mother had managed to reign it in and stabilize it.
It was because Sona herself grasped the weavings of existence seconds after being born, and she grasped what she was doing as she simply stopped.
The Elder Queen Mother did not have the power to keep her own Source of Dignity in front of a newlyborn chick!
This was terrifying in itself, but it was merely one of the things others didn't know about the Entity distinguished as Sona.
The Elder Queen Mother raised her head while observing the thousands of plants holding tens of thousands of Fruits of Existence across the fields before her.
|I know her...so what does that make you, Noah Osmont?|
She knew Sona and her capabilities. So what exactly did Osmont have to make her begin moving like this?
The eyes of the Elder Queen Mother fluctuated with brilliance.
The scene of the garden she saw all around her very quickly became obscured as hazy illusory screens appeared in front of her.

At the very center was a massive screen that showed two figures arriving in a plane of existence also towards the center of the Sanctum of Dignity- not too far from the one that the Elder Queen Mother was in!
But they were in a plane of existence rich in vitality and life- and this was where the Sanctus Sea of Rebirth was located!
The Elder Queen Mother's eyes focused on the figures going towards this Sea as both emanated immense immense waves of Haki that pulsed with Dignity.
In a Plane known as the Sanctus Rebirth Plane.
The surroundings were filled with verdant pathways floating in space, with lustrous greenish black holes floating around these paths like ornaments.
Many of them seemed to come from one central direction and converge downwards towards a vast green sea down below!

On one of these descending verdant paths, Noah was about to arrive at a location with the lead of Sona who simply warped them away from the cluster of Elder Queens, Sanctus Princesses, and Dragon Knights who were shocked at her actions.

At this time, Noah's senses that were freshly beginning to borrow the influence of Omniversal Authorities felt a tug as he raised his head and looked behind him, his eyes sharp as he felt like there was a pair of eyes watching him even though there was nobody behind them for light years!
|Don't worry about that...| Without even turning around, Sona waved her hands dismissively as she continued forward.

|...it's just an old lady who likes to peep at others since she has so much time on her hands. But I'm glad you're already beginning to expand your senses to merge with the weavings of the Omniverse after influencing an Omniversal Authority not too long ago. This little pool here should also help.|
The first portion of her words affirmed Noah's intuition that there was a gaze behind them, and the latter portion spoke about a 'pool'!
The place she referred to was the dazzling green sea below them as the closer towards the center they went, the greater the concentration of existential authority Noah felt.

And at this moment, their steps halted as they arrived at a junction where all the stellar verdant paths converged- a circle forming at the center where they met as down below...was the absolute center of the Sanctus Sea of Rebirth!
And right at its entry was a woman adorned in a full verdant gold armor emanating heavy sharpness- a golden aura of the Teracosm Stage blazing around her.
To her sides, three stern faces of Dragon Knights also at the Teracosm Stage could be seen- staunchly guarding her sides as they emanated a profound aura of Dignity!
They were the ones guarding the Sanctus Sea of Rebirth.
A unique type of an Omniversal Treasure that was in the form of a sea, continuously generating Fruits of Existence over the years as its waters were filled with potent Existential Authority.
And then, all of it was magnified and further enhanced over the years!

The Sanctus Populi would have its Sanctus Princesses undergo a transformation within a treasure like this once in their lifetimes- with the concentration of existential authority only growing over the years.
It was one of the reasons why Sanctus Princesses were a cut above the rest!
Far above the sea, Noah could already see its verdant viscous waters filled with densely swirling Fruits of Existence.
And the only way to truly access it was to be given the right to do so, and pass the four Teracosm Stage Entities standing at this central area!
The face of the Elder Queen adorned in an Armament was hardened as in front of her, Sona freely walked forward with Noah in tow while her intent weaved out.
|A Sanctus Prince is here to undergo his rebirth. I assume that won't be a problem?|
The Elder Queen remained silent.

And an instant later, the verdant spear in her hand smashed down in a signal, the three Teracosm Stage Dragon Knights beside her making way and allowing a passage to form towards the center point that looked like a deep abyssal hole towards a dazzling sea!
Directions had already been given by the Elder Queen Mother, and all others obeyed!
Sona nodded at this scene and nodded towards Noah who at this moment breathed out while unbuttoning his sleek white dress shirt.
Within moments, his bare muscular chest and toned abdominal muscles were visible, his steps calm and filled with Dignity as he walked towards four Teracosm Stage Entities!
They gazed at him with sharp eyes filled with pressure and suffocation that may have crushed the Dominiums of weaker beings, but Noah bore it all until he came to stand on the path they had made.
A Teracosm Stage Entity to his left and right.
A terrifying Elder Queen nearby!
In such an enclosure, Noah merely threw his white shirt back as Sona caught it with raised brows, and he then dove towards the deep hole leading towards the center of the exceedingly verdant sea!
A sea thick with Existential Extremity Authority. A sea filled with dazzling Fruits of Existence like shimmering galaxies.
It was the sea that told Noah he had found the resources he needed to devour to get past the Primordium Stage!

They gazed at him with sharp eyes filled with pressure and suffocation that may have crushed the Dominiums of weaker beings, but Noah bore it all until he came to stand on the path they had made.
A Teracosm Stage Entity to his left and right.
A terrifying Elder Queen nearby!
In such an enclosure, Noah merely threw his white shirt back as Sona caught it with raised brows, and he then dove towards the deep hole leading towards the center of the exceedingly verdant sea!
A sea thick with Existential Extremity Authority.
A sea filled with dazzling Fruits of Existence like shimmering galaxies.
It was the sea that told Noah he had found the resources he needed to devour to get past the Primordium Stage!

chapters.title: Chapter 3025 What Lies Beyond! I
paragraphs: His fair skin reflected the brilliance below.
He dove into the hole that would carry one to the center of the Sanctus Sea of Rebirth as far below was the swirling eye of the sea!
Thick.
Dense with Fruits of Existence.
The accumulation of eons that only Sanctus Princesses received.
He wondered just how much damage he would do to it as he wasn't the only one.
Far above him from where he just jumped, the visage of Sona came close to the other Teracosm Stage Dragon Knights and the armored Elder Queen as she spoke calmly.
|Some crazy things may happen below. So be prepared and don't be too baffled or shocked when it does happen...|
As if she could see the tumultuous weavings to come.
The Elder Queen stared at her silently before her will came to follow Noah's figure that at this moment...
POP!
Entered the distant center of the thick verdant sea.

|The Sanctus Sea of Rebirth is an Omniversal Treasure that has existed for eons, with Princesses undergoing their transformations within as even they can barely handle absorbing a percentage of its power before their Dominiums and Authorities are saturated. What can this supposed Prince do?|
The voice of the Elder Queen rang out as towards this, Sona only gave a light smile!
Down below.
The interminable waves of the green waters wobbled.

After diving in, Noah felt like he was at the center of a massive singularity that was applying infinite pressure all around, his head and chest becoming visible while the rest of his body remained submerged!
All around, he felt the crushing waves of extremely pure existential authority as when he simply raised his hands from the sea, a cluster of fruits of Existence would rise with him.
HUUM!
He could feel his Primordium Core beginning to pulse with excitement.
It was the one that would devour all authority and spread it across all his Dominiums equally!
His Dominium Soul was here, but with it came a representative portion of his Primordium Core where the authority would flow through.
And at this moment...
|Let loose.|
WAA!
His intent was made clear.
His body began to tremble.
His Primordium Core flashed within his depths as it began to spin with a radiant white light!
And after a single spin was completed...
A heavy gravitational pull emanated from Noah as the waters around him began to churn.
They began to circle and flow towards him.
HUUM!

The Primordium Core began to spin faster as it soon began to absorb verdant liquid and dozens of Fruits of Existence, and within seconds...it seemed like Noah was becoming the center of the sea as all waters began to collect and be devoured by his figures- the affected areas only expanding as time passed!
And very soon, it felt like Noah was the center point of a rotating galaxy- drawing everything into himself as all three of his Dominium began to surge with potency and power!
{Your Primordium Stage was the initial and earliest stage of development into the Existential Dominium Realm.}
{Within it, an Existential Primordium Dominium Core was formed as it granted an Omniversal Sense towards the very weavings of the Omniverse.}
HUUM!
The verdant sea began to churn.

Like an endless black hole, Noah began stripping this Sea of its dense and thick verdant hue, hundreds of Fruits of Existence being swallowed up by him as all parts of his Dominiums radiated a lustrous light!
And the Primordium Core...its white light soon began to gain color.
{The Completion of the Primordium Stage indicates complete development and acclimation in the Existential Dominium Realm as now, you have to set up what path you will pioneer hereafter.}
Yes.
He wasn't following the Stages of Neonate, Sequor, Teleios, and Teracosm.
His path was his own as if he could equate them to others, his Primordium Stage at the peak included both Neonate and Sequor Stages!
But for his next path that he had to decide on himself...would it follow this principle?
He was pioneering it.
He was trekking new paths others could not fathom!
Naturally, he could make such a path as obscene and broken as possible.
So...
{Quintessence rises with imperishable majesty as stares at the path ahead.}
At the very center of his existence.
A Colorless authority rose.
{Quintessence pulls upon all Existential Extremity Authorities.}
{Quintessence pulls upon the Extremity of Cheats!}
Quintessence rose with wild abandon on this day as it decided to define and delegate the stage forward!
Noah was Quintessence, and Quintessence was him as at this moment, it was given free reign.
{Quintessence states that after the initial stage of development is completed, the stage that follows should be one where you spread your wings and fly.}
{Quintessence states that in this next stage, you must be undefeatable in power and stature.}
{Quintessence states that in this next stage, you must be unconquerable.}
Hues of vibrant green shone.

Above the sea, the figures of the Teracosm Elder Queen and Dragon Knights began looking down with somber eyes as they saw waves churning across all of the Sanctus Sea of Rebirth...and going towards a single being.
This...this Sea carried eons of worth of accumulation you know?
Why was it churning and swirling towards him as if he could swallow it whole?
A grand question.
But even this didn't have an answer as the visage of the bare chested entity they locked onto down below...began to flicker with a deeply purple radiance at this moment!
From its white milky brilliance, the Existential Primordium Dominium Core instantly gained a milky purple radiance as its circular form...instantly began to break.
It was blooming into something else!
{The Primordium Core is budding into its next stage which allows it to rapidly and efficiently scale the endless Dominium Skies.}
{Quintessence burns with brilliance and asserts the distinction of the next stage.}
{Undefeatable.}
{Unconquerable.}
{Quintessence asserts that the next stage of your Dominium Realm shall be known as the Invictus Stage!}
BOOM!
His Primordium Core instantly shattered and collapsed into itself as the moment it did so, a quarter of the Sanctus Sea of Rebirth was instantly swallowed as it disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 3026 What Lies Beyond! II
paragraphs: His Primordium Core shattered and collapsed!
Along with this action, it also devoured a quarter of the Sanctus Sea of Rebirth to use as its fuel, a singularity forming in its place as it bloomed into something else.
Invictus!
A grand and heavy distinction.
One that truly had to be lived up to as at this time, Quintessence wasn't done.
{The Existential Primordium Dominium Core is transforming into the Existential Invictus Dominium Organ.}

An Existential Invictus Dominium Organ! Inside his very existence, Noah felt the collapsed Primordium Dominium Core begin to transform into something else entirely at this moment. A golden aura rose and began to permeate all around as the Existential Extremity Authority of Ascension blazed with brilliance. Ascension caused this entire transformation to enter a new realm of Quintessence.
From the collapsed Primordium Core, Noah began to see the formation of what seemed like...purple colored wings. An organ in the shape of wings!
{The Existential Invictus Dominium Wings have been born.}
{The Existential Invictus Dominium Wings will carry you across the endless Dominium Skies!}

The newly forged Organ was truly in the form of wings as the moment they formed in the very center of Noah's existence, his back also sprouted dazzling purple wings that radiated tremendous Existential Authority. This wasn't all as on his feet, a pair of purple wings rose, each one being more dazzling than the other. A pair of wings deep in his existence. A pair of wings behind his back. And a pair of wings on each of his feet. He looked like an entirely new entity coming to fruition as the pressure his body radiated was one that may cause even a Teleios Stage entity to feel a sense of suffocation!
In the next moment, all the wings within his existence flapped, releasing a terrifying gravitational devouring force that caused another quarter of the Sanctus Sea of Rebirth to disappear.
And this large portion of sea that disappeared went on to become the fuel that caused his wings to shine ever brighter, as if he was ready to soar into a grandiose endless sky.
{The next path has been outlined.}
{All that is left to do is for you to utilize the tools you have brought to fruition to scale the Dominium Skies.}
{The capabilities of the Existential Invictus Dominium Wings are for you to discover and understand.}
HUUM!
Noah felt the wings pulse as if they were always an intricate part of him- like a second beating heart.
Just by existing, they drew in heavy concentrations of Existential Extremity Authority and magnified it before allowing it to course across his Dominiums.

Inside his Body, massive mountainous passages cheered all the incoming authority while gushing out even more, and it was at this time that Noah felt the waves of authority all around him begin to calm.
As if the verdant sea around him that was part of an Omniversal Treasure was sentient, and that it had deemed his transformation was over.
But he...had taken half of the Sanctus Sea of Rebirth towards his transformation whole Sanctus Princesses would normally take a single percentage!
Feeling the slowing absorption around him and the vibrating sense of power of his existence, he finally opened his eyes and looked up.
Far above, the four Teracosm Stage Entities were gazing towards him and the sizeably reduced sea with incredulity- and only the gaze of Sona was calm and unblinking as she nodded.
Noah's eyes were glazed with a tyrannically purple hue as the vibrant wings on his feet and back flapped.
And....
WAP!
He instantly disappeared from the sea below and traversed great distances in an instant, his visage materializing as a flash of light in front of Sona!
The Elder Queen and her three Teracosm Dragon Knights turned back to him the moment he warped behind them as this speed...it caused their eyes to rise in alarm.
It was not a speed a common Teleios Stage Entity could show.
It was a speed that nearly neared those at the Teracosm Stage!

With his bare chest and face looking even more chiseled and glorious, Noah motioned towards Sona for his sleek white shirt- only to have this daring woman smile and walk forward...and actually begin putting his shirt on him with her own hands.

|You're living up to expectations and exceeding them at the same time. Thanks for not going overboard and devouring the whole sea- I had that as a possibility. Who knows how many days the Elder Queens will scream if that happened...|
She spoke nonchalantly as she went around Noah and then came in front of him, beginning to button his shirt that phased through the radiant wings on his back.
Unbuckling the belt of his obsidian pants, she then tucked his shirt in at a shockingly fast speed as before one could even blink, the Weaver of Extremity was clothed and adorned spectacularly.
Sona smiled and nodded in appreciation while the Teracosm Stage Entities behind them...felt like they were watching a scene they shouldn't be privy to!
Sanctus Princess Sona was actually this bold?
Without missing a beat, she nodded towards the Elder Queen ahead, a golden light of her terrifying Teracosm Stage wrapping around her and Noah as she paid her goodbyes.
|Thanks for not making it complicated...|
WAP!
With a glimmer of light, the two of them disappeared- leaving behind astonished Teracosm Stage Entities who began staring at each other.
Their figures were traversing across the Source of Dignity currently, with Sona taking the lead as her intent weaved out.
|With that done, we can get started with the first task of the initiative- obtaining the twins belonging to the Imperium.|
A task lay ahead.
One that Noah raised his brows at while replying.
|The Imperium is hunting me down as far as I know, and the Sanctus Populi are sworn enemies. How exactly is this task to unfold?|
He had butchered Imperium Knights and even used his Illusory Weavings to do so even in their home Existential Domains, and the Sanctus Populi were their sworn enemies!
So what plan did Sona have exactly?
Towards such a question, this entity only smiled while replying mischievously.
{That's where the fun part comes in. And if we were to somehow run across any of those hunting you...who's to say exactly which party is the hunter, and which one is the hunted?|
Terrific words rang from her.
And Noah could only smile while beginning to read the weavings of the possible paths of Existence and Extremes, a majority of his will still focused on uncovering the boons of his new Organ.
The Existential Invictus Dominium Wings!

chapters.title: Chapter 3027 What Lies Beyond! III
paragraphs: Invictus.

As Noah attained the Invictus Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm, he also attained an Organ in the form of wings that even at this moment, he felt like he hadn't grasped a percentage of their usage.
In the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, the rest of his Body was acting as the Existential Omniversal Guider- and it also erupted with the same glorious Organ.
On his back.
On his feet.
Dazzling purple wings blazed as his people who were in a stupor as each one attained an Existential Extremity Authority...gazed at him in a daze!
As if they were asking him, did you really just sprout wings on your feet?
On your back, sure, we've seen that before. But why the hell were there purple wings on his feet?!
Noah saw their astounded gazes as towards this...
|There are many forms of Authority in existence...|
He simply continued his guidance as he began to delve into an extremely heavy topic.
And at the same time he did so, the bodies of his people began to feel rapid changes as a prompt appeared before them.
{The one who guides you has just made a substantial breakthrough, his power vastly jumping forward.}
{The increased percentage of progression towards your Dominium and beyond it is being skewed towards the upper limit.}
It took time to anneal one's Aspects of Existence and prepare them to form their Dominiums. It took resources.

But Noah's people would have their work ridiculously cut short as it became clear a batch of Primordium Stage Entities would be born sooner rather than later within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
Alongside Noah's people, behind them where they couldn't even see...his Illusory Weaving Legion with three Teleios Stage Entities at the forefront was also listening to his guidance!

The records of these defeated enemies followed the progression of those they were made from as subtly, their existence also began to change and be elevated towards the direction of the Existential Omniversal Guider.
And Noah continued his guidance as for the first time, he introduced a certain concept to his people.

{Among the many myriad forms of Authorities, there exist those that hold the structure of the Omniverse itself. Composed of dense amounts of Existential Extremity Authorities, they are Omniversal Authorities...}
HUUM!

As he spoke, a shocking scene occurred out of even his own control as the Invictus Dominium Wings behind his back flapped, and his intent instantly gained the weight and influence of an Omniversal Authority!
Above him, space instantly looked like it twisted and distorted to converge on him as if he did any action right now, he would carry the influence of an Omniversal Authority with it.
His people were now privy to his words, and they also saw firsthand what their Guider was teaching them about as before their eyes, new prompts arose!
{You have been exposed to a shocking form of authority.}
{You have entered a state of Quintessential Epiphany for the next day, with the chances of successfully elevating extreme to the Existential level rising to the highest.}
{Ever so slowly, the breadth of your existence is being expanded!}
The boons were immense.
But as this occurred, Noah also got to understand something about the root cause of what had just happened!
{You have grasped a feature of the Existential Invictus Dominium Wings.}
{This Organ can resonate and instantly connect to the influence of a nearby Omniversal Authority that consists of a range of Existential Extremity Authorities by the hundreds with no delay}
{Elevation across the Dominium Skies will allow for the instant connection to the influence of even more complex Omniversal Authorities.}
A feature of instantly connecting to an Omniversal Authority.
It was something that made Noah think about another tool that allowed one to access Omniversal Authorities- the Codex of Extremity!
But his Invictus Dominium Wings were much faster as when he felt what they could do, he thought of the half-completed Codex he held in his hands.
And then, an idea and possible path bloomed.
Initially, he would complete the Codex by going to the forces of the Imperium and obtaining it from those powerful enough to be granted such a tool.
But if he had something that could do what the Codex could right now, and in an even grander way, could he not take another path for the Codex?
Could he not...create this tool himself for his people?
As soon as this idea bloomed, Noah turned his will towards the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
And his intent flowed.
|What would it take for us to begin the production of our own Codex of Extremity? A Quintessential Codex of Extremity?|
He asked the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
And...
He received no answer.
His eyes became sharp as his intent weaved out to understand, and...
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed has entered a state of Existential Quintessential Omniversal Epiphany after the demonstration of influencing Omniversal Authority from the Guider.}
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed ponders- can it not make its own dozens or hundreds of Existential Extremity Authorities and begin forming its own Omniversal Authorities?}
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed sees a possible pathway for it to sprout from a mere Seed.}
A wondrous development.
The distinction of the Existential Omniversal Guider was so potent that its targets...weren't limited to just his people alone.
Even the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was listening.
Even it received guidance!
And in its state of epiphany...
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed dares to dream, taking the next steps as the Extremity Dreams is being elevated towards the Existential level.}
A golden Aletheian Haven gravitating around a dazzling Extremity Vein trembled at this moment, a golden Aurora of light radiating across the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
But it wasn't the only one.
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed ponders upon its humble beginnings and elevates the Extremity of Genesis towards the Existential level.}
A milky white brilliance shone.
{The Extremity of Relativity...}
{The Extremity of Entropy...}
{The Extremity of Gravitation...}
{The Extremity of Polarity...}
One after another.
As if possessed by unfathomable urgency, the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed took the pillars that held it together and culminated them towards a grand Apex!

sentences.text: Invictus.

As Noah attained the Invictus Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm, he also attained an Organ in the form of wings that even at this moment, he felt like he hadn't grasped a percentage of their usage.
In the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, the rest of his Body was acting as the Existential Omniversal Guider- and it also erupted with the same glorious Organ.
On his back.
On his feet.
Dazzling purple wings blazed as his people who were in a stupor as each one attained an Existential Extremity Authority...gazed at him in a daze!
As if they were asking him, did you really just sprout wings on your feet?
On your back, sure, we've seen that before.
But why the hell were there purple wings on his feet?!
Noah saw their astounded gazes as towards this...
|There are many forms of Authority in existence...|
He simply continued his guidance as he began to delve into an extremely heavy topic.
And at the same time he did so, the bodies of his people began to feel rapid changes as a prompt appeared before them.
{The one who guides you has just made a substantial breakthrough, his power vastly jumping forward.}
{The increased percentage of progression towards your Dominium and beyond it is being skewed towards the upper limit.}
It took time to anneal one's Aspects of Existence and prepare them to form their Dominiums.
It took resources.

But Noah's people would have their work ridiculously cut short as it became clear a batch of Primordium Stage Entities would be born sooner rather than later within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
Alongside Noah's people, behind them where they couldn't even see...his Illusory Weaving Legion with three Teleios Stage Entities at the forefront was also listening to his guidance!

The records of these defeated enemies followed the progression of those they were made from as subtly, their existence also began to change and be elevated towards the direction of the Existential Omniversal Guider.
And Noah continued his guidance as for the first time, he introduced a certain concept to his people.
{Among the many myriad forms of Authorities, there exist those that hold the structure of the Omniverse itself.
Composed of dense amounts of Existential Extremity Authorities, they are Omniversal Authorities...}
HUUM!

As he spoke, a shocking scene occurred out of even his own control as the Invictus Dominium Wings behind his back flapped, and his intent instantly gained the weight and influence of an Omniversal Authority!
Above him, space instantly looked like it twisted and distorted to converge on him as if he did any action right now, he would carry the influence of an Omniversal Authority with it.
His people were now privy to his words, and they also saw firsthand what their Guider was teaching them about as before their eyes, new prompts arose!
{You have been exposed to a shocking form of authority.}
{You have entered a state of Quintessential Epiphany for the next day, with the chances of successfully elevating extreme to the Existential level rising to the highest.}
{Ever so slowly, the breadth of your existence is being expanded!}
The boons were immense.
But as this occurred, Noah also got to understand something about the root cause of what had just happened!
{You have grasped a feature of the Existential Invictus Dominium Wings.}
{This Organ can resonate and instantly connect to the influence of a nearby Omniversal Authority that consists of a range of Existential Extremity Authorities by the hundreds with no delay}
{Elevation across the Dominium Skies will allow for the instant connection to the influence of even more complex Omniversal Authorities.}
A feature of instantly connecting to an Omniversal Authority.
It was something that made Noah think about another tool that allowed one to access Omniversal Authorities- the Codex of Extremity!
But his Invictus Dominium Wings were much faster as when he felt what they could do, he thought of the half-completed Codex he held in his hands.
And then, an idea and possible path bloomed.
Initially, he would complete the Codex by going to the forces of the Imperium and obtaining it from those powerful enough to be granted such a tool.
But if he had something that could do what the Codex could right now, and in an even grander way, could he not take another path for the Codex?
Could he not...create this tool himself for his people?
As soon as this idea bloomed, Noah turned his will towards the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
And his intent flowed.
|What would it take for us to begin the production of our own Codex of Extremity?
A Quintessential Codex of Extremity?|
He asked the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
And...
He received no answer.
His eyes became sharp as his intent weaved out to understand, and...
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed has entered a state of Existential Quintessential Omniversal Epiphany after the demonstration of influencing Omniversal Authority from the Guider.}
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed ponders- can it not make its own dozens or hundreds of Existential Extremity Authorities and begin forming its own Omniversal Authorities?}
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed sees a possible pathway for it to sprout from a mere Seed.}
A wondrous development.
The distinction of the Existential Omniversal Guider was so potent that its targets...weren't limited to just his people alone.
Even the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was listening.
Even it received guidance!
And in its state of epiphany...
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed dares to dream, taking the next steps as the Extremity Dreams is being elevated towards the Existential level.}
A golden Aletheian Haven gravitating around a dazzling Extremity Vein trembled at this moment, a golden Aurora of light radiating across the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
But it wasn't the only one.
{The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed ponders upon its humble beginnings and elevates the Extremity of Genesis towards the Existential level.}
A milky white brilliance shone.
{The Extremity of Relativity...}
{The Extremity of Entropy...}
{The Extremity of Gravitation...}
{The Extremity of Polarity...}
One after another.
As if possessed by unfathomable urgency, the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed took the pillars that held it together and culminated them towards a grand Apex!

chapters.title: Chapter 3028 What Lies Beyond! IV
paragraphs: Every pillar of authority that helped it become what it is today!
From natural laws to Decreta, to past Havenly and Infernal authorities, and even more.
Such an action was so immense that the Extremity Vein began to shake and tremble, the Aletheian Havens all around it pulsing as if they were cheering!
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed took them all towards the Existential level as with these actions alone, many things would also fundamentally change with it.
The rate at which it produces Fruits of Existence would soon explode as enough of these resources would be there to aid Noah's vassals in forming their Dominiums.
And there would be even more to aid in the heavy resource cost of rising across the Dominium Skies!
This was just a single aspect.
This wasn't to mention its defensive features.
Its offensive features.
Its Alchemy Hall or Blacksmith's Forge.
Too many things would continue to undergo changes as it was hard to say whether there would be a time when the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed sat still.
Where its aspects remained calm and at a stable stage.

It felt like changes would constantly continue to occur as Noah could only observe and try to see just what weavings and changes would come from the current actions- especially since the sources of all the Authorities being taken towards the Existential level were connected to him!
|...| He computed countless thoughts in an instant.
He was always doing many things concurrently as now was now different.

His path was an illustrious one that would only continue to be so, and never once did he stop looking forward to what weavings he could uncover and what broken levels of strength and power he could reach!
So...he reached ever higher.
Across the endless expanse of the Omniverse.
There were countless Planes of Existence strewn out around the Imperium, each of them under the banner of Legacies and Enclaves that farmed unfathomable amounts of Fruits of Existence over the eons.
All of these resources went towards the Imperium.
All of these resources are what allowed the Imperium to reign with an iron grip across the Omniverse!
Their forces were powerful.
Their Enclaves were immense Behemoths that controlled vast stretches of life and workings across the Omniverse- mainly through the Existential Imperium Exchange.
In return, they themselves enjoyed even more resources and power.
Towards the region of the Omniverse where the power of the Imperium was concentrated.
Past a few thousand Existential Domains, there was a blinding expanse of golden light that seemed to stretch out endlessly.
It was the sheer expression of the power of the Imperium as this...was the Source of the Imperium.
The Exclusive Existential Extremity Authority of the Imperium!
Within such a location, many behemoth Enclaves resided within and carved their homes as among them, there was a certain enclave respected within the Imperium.
It was an Enclave that focused on the weavings of Records, Existence, and Extremes of the very Omniverse itself.

It was known as the Visionary Enclave, itsit's listing in the Existential Imperium Exchange was always increasing in value over the eons- with many citizens and royals of the Imperium choosing to invest their resources into this Enclave for the products and services they provided!
The discovery of Unique Existential Domains.
Knowledge of the weavings of the future.
Knowledge on exactly what path one should take to advance their Dominiums.
Products increased the efficacy, output, and longevity of one's existence.
There were too many things to count as the Visionary Enclave was one of the few Triple Royal Imperium Enclaves everyone invested in!
Within the depths of the Source of the Imperium.
Past countless planes of existence.
Within one of the compounds of the Visionary Enclave.

An old man shining with the liquid gold light of the Teracosm Stage was surrounded by eighteen different colored Codexes of Extremity, each one brimming with a different authority as this entity exuded brilliance.
He was within a massive dome shaped building floating in a golden sea amongst other dome shaped buildings, each brimming with a heavy authority.
Within the dome shaped structure this entity was in, surrounded by the various different Codexes...this entity of immense power was actually trembling at this moment as his eyes were glazed gold.

Swear trickled across his head as his golden white hair was damp, the wrinkles on his face trembling with a sense of fear and trepidation as soon enough...the Codexes around him began to crack and tear!
Tendrils of multicolored brilliance surged around him.
Space converged around him on all sides as he had been utilizing the influence of Omniversal Authorities this whole time.
But even while surrounded with such authority...
He began to croak out a petrified scream as his glazed eyes showed fear.
|AAH!|
His yell became louder and turned into a bellow, his authority running rampant and wild as it exploded out from his dome and alarmed others in their own domes.

Instantly multiple figures of Teracosm Stage Entities appeared within his dome with alarmed looks, a woman going towards the bellowing man who looked crazed as a golden light flowed from her to stabilize him.
|What happene-|
BOOM!

She didn't even finish her words before the crazed entity she was holding onto exploded with existential light, his whole body shaking instantly with the influence of Omniversal Authorities as his intent bellowed out like grinding bells.
|Genocide! Genocide!|
Crazed bellows rang out from him as others became even more alarmed!
|The Imperium fractured! The Sanctus broken! Countless Dominiums lost! Oh! Oh!|
He spoke of something he had seen as the subject matter was so incredulous that the faces of many changed, even more coming forward to hold down his limbs as this entity trembled unstably.
|The Wheel of Existence shattered and broken! Countless twists and turns! Oh! We shouldn't have sought them! We shouldn't have enraged them! Genocide! Genocide!|
HUUM!

The surrounding space fractured and tore as a renowned Imperium Martial King on an Enclave proficient in reading weavings of the future...seemingly went crazy as unfathomable words were uttered from him!

chapters.title: Chapter 3029 Expansion I
paragraphs: An Imperium Martial King from the Visionary Enclave trembled with unstable authority and ravings!
Ravings of genocide and destruction that when others heard them, they couldn't help but swarm towards him to stabilize everything.

Within moments, a Teracosm Stage Martial King came up behind the crazed old man as she cradled his head forcefully between her lap- dazzling rivers of white light flowing from her hands and onto his head as she spoke sternly.
|What genocide? Who are you referring to? Who shouldn't be enraged?|
Her words were like melodies as other Teracosm Stage Entities also circled in the surroundings, pulling on Omniversal Authorities as everything nearby gained a sense of stability.
The glazed eyes of the old man slowly calmed as he breathed heavily.
The woman cradling his head spoke once more.
|Who, Lucas? Who should not be enraged?|
The words of serenity caused utmost calmness as the old man, Martial King Lucas, opened his mouth as if he were perched and facing extreme dehydration.
|He...his pulsing veins will shatter the wheel of existence.|
As if his eyes could see something others couldn't.
As if he had peered into a far distant future he shouldn't have been able to see!
He blinked as he gained a sense of clarity while continuing.
|The Imperium, the Sanctum, the Omniversal Pillagers...they shall all bend the same. With the expansion of his wings, thousands of Domains will face extinction!|
|There is still time to change things! There is still time!|
|Do not enrage him!|
WAA!
|Do not enrage the Weaver!|
|DO NOT-|
BOOM!
An unimaginably heavy impact bloomed as if this entity had seen what he shouldn't have with the weavings of the Omniverse.
His Dominium Soul instantly faced cracks as the situation turned extremely serious!
Those around him scrambled, while a few others in the distance recorded the weavings of everything occurring before their figures disappeared.
Within the very same Source of the Imperium.
In a Plane of Existence known as the Majesty of the Imperium.

A golden castle made of crystallized reinforced Fruits of Existence floated grandly, a dense number of swirling formations circling across it as just by being inside of this construct, one would gain the effects of swallowing hundreds of Fruits of Existence every minute.
It was a tool very few knew about, and a terrifying Omniversal Treasure among the many under the banner of the Imperium with shocking effects.
Those living inside such a construct wouldn't even need to step out of it to seek the Fruits of Existence, and one couldn't really say how heavy the cost was to build this construct!

Inside such a place, one of the many leading figures of the Imperium stood on a balcony filled with brilliance, gazing out into the expanses of dozens of stellar citadels of the Imperium around this castle.
His hair shone purple gold as he was adorned in an Emperor's Robe, his visage magnificent and handsome as his Dominium...released a silent rainbow colored glow.
Rainbow.
Not Purple of the Teleios Stage. Not Gold of the Teracosm Stage.
Rainbow!
He was someone distinguished, but at this moment, one only needed to know him as the one at the head of the Visionary Enclave!
WAP!
At this moment, three Teracosm Stage Entities appeared behind him on the balcony and kneeled, sending blinding singularities of information forward as they paid their respects.
|Exarch...this is the current state of Martial King Lucas. What he has seen...|
A terrifying possible weavings of the future!
One that spoke of Genocide and destruction of the Imperium, the Sanctus Populi, and the Omniversal Pillagers.
As for those responsible, Martial King Lucas spoke about not enraging them.
Them.
The only thing they had to go on at this moment...was a single distinction.
The Weaver.
There was a very real and possible weaving of existence where this Weaver brought down destruction and genocides across the Imperium, Sanctus Populi, and Omniversal Pillagers!
What exactly would happen? How would...?
There were so many questions to answer as at this moment, the Teracosm Stage entities of the Visionary Enclave gazed towards their Exarch as he proceeded with everything calmly.
His intent came out in waves.
|Do you know how many times we have received and come across possible weavings of destruction for the Imperium?|
His words came in the form of a question as the Teracosm Stage Martial Kings didn't dare to answer.
And he continued.

|Too many occurrences have come and gone over the eons. Weavings of possible destruction by the hands of the Omniversal Pillagers, by the hands of the Sanctus Populi, by anything else. But even in all those weavings, the Imperium has remained standing strong and gotten to its height today.|
WAA!
|Possible weavings are just that. Possibilities. With the power of the Imperium, all unfavorable possibilities have been overcome or crushed. This...will be the same as all others.|
An astounding sense of power and confidence was within his words.
His Emperor's Robe flowed grandly as he began giving orders soon after.
|Let it be known that the Visionary Enclave has gained Paramount Existential Omniversal Information for sale. I will pass it on to the other Exarchs myself.|
|Yes!|
With commanding bows, the Teracosm Stage Entities disappeared and began to make preparations.
This was what the Visionary Enclave did.
It bought and sold information.
Even information on the possible weavings of destruction could be bought and sold!
After those behind him disappeared, the body of the Exarch covered by rainbow colored light pulsed to release an illusory figure of himself that disappeared soon after.
He had to do his part and let other pertinent people know, even if he knew very well that like all others, these possible weavings of Destruction would come to pass.
After all, they were able to pass all others because they were prepared beyond all measures- and they continued to dominate to this day!
With sharp eyes, Exarch of the Visionary Enclave muttered while staring out towards the citadels around him.
|Both the rats within the Sanctus and the dogs of the Pillagers as well...that is an opportunity.|
